31978.s: The bill incorporates the 2009 ministerial regulation designating the new Influenza A (H1N1) virus as a Group A disease into the Public Health Act (Wet publieke gezondheid), by adding it to the list in article 1(e). It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
31978.j: The memorandum justifies incorporation as necessary to act in time to treat patients and prevent further spread of the virus, and to activate all control powers under the Act.
q: Secondly, this activates all control powers under the Wpg.
In de tweede plaats zijn hiermee alle bestrijdingsbevoegdheden uit de Wpg geactiveerd.
p: Incorporating the ministerial regulation into statute activates Group A powers such as quarantine and travel restrictions that the executive can then use, with the bill mainly confirming an executive designation after the fact.

31996.s: The bill sets uniform rules for care, including involuntary care, and admission and residence of people with dementia or intellectual disability who object or cannot consent, replacing parts of the Bopz. It assigns CIZ a role in requesting court authorisations and gives mayors crisis detention powers, with court and complaint safeguards.
31996.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and crisis powers by the need for uniform rules, quality care, and avoiding harm to cliënts and others.
q: This bill aims to introduce a uniform scheme for providing care to people with a psychogeriatric condition.
Dit wetsvoorstel beoogt een uniforme regeling te introduceren voor het verlenen van zorg aan mensen met een psychogeriatrische aandoening
d: additional diseases treated as psychogeriatric or intellectual disability
measures counted as restricting freedom of movement
form and content of care plan
categories of experts whose consent is required
rules on how involuntary care is applied
rules on processing admission applications and decisions
further rules on mayor's crisis detention order
p: A mayor may order involuntary admission without a court authorisation in acute crises, with a lawyer and a court follow-up required within days.
Admission of cliënts who do not object but cannot consent is decided by an assessment body (CIZ) instead of a court.
Care providers may apply involuntary care listed in the care plan when specified harm occurs, subject to necessity and consultation duties.

parties: Questions whether the bill lacks clear criteria for coercion, adequate rights protection for wilsonbekwame clients, and reliance on CIZ indication instead of judicial authorisation.
The bill only provides that coercive care must be 'organisationally feasible' and supervision 'responsible', which they find too vague.
Het wetsvoorstel regelt alleen dat de dwangzorg «organisatorisch haalbaar» en het toezicht «verantwoord» moet zijn.
Asks how the bill relates to the Bopz revision, how client rights and autonomy are safeguarded, and how the bill fits the UN disability convention.
Is there a question of different and unequal systems of legal protection?
Is er sprake van verschillende en ongelijkwaardige systemen van rechtsbescherming?
Worries about the absence of judicial review and reliance on a CIZ indication, and about restrictive measures being applied too readily.
The SP members are concerned about the absence of judicial review, as exists under the Bopz law.
De leden van de SP-fractie maken zich zorgen over het ontbreken van een rechterlijke toetsing zoals dat er wel is bij de Wet Bopz.
Argues the bill lacks an ethical framework and clear criteria for acceptable coercion, gives institutions too much room, and wrongly burdens paid carers for informal care.
By having the CIZ approve coercion on the treating physician's request and annual sign-off by legal representatives, institutions gain unprecedented room to apply coercion as they see fit.

Door het goedkeuren van de toepassing van dwang en drang door het onafhankelijke CIZ, dat dit doet op voorspraak van de behandelend arts, en het jaarlijks laten aftekenen van het zorgplan door wettelijk vertegenwoordigers, krijgen instellingen naar onze mening een ongekende ruimte om naar eigen goeddunken dwang en drang toe te passen.
Objects that the 'ernstig nadeel' criterion is untestable and that the bill would allow coercion such as forced feeding in the home.
This criterion is, in the view of the PVV members, not testable and not acceptable.
Dit criterium is naar het oordeel van de leden van de PVV-fractie niet te toetsen en niet acceptabel.
Asks why the bill is separate from the Bopz revision and what measures will build professional knowledge and culture change.
Why was it not chosen to bring both bills under a single legal regime?
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen beide wetsvoorstellen in één wettelijke regeling onder te brengen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the fourth amendment note to the Dutch care-and-coercion bill for people with psychogeriatric conditions or intellectual disability, concluding that the expanded decision-making procedure for involuntary care is of limited added value, risks juridification and adds administrative burden, and advising reconsideration. The minister's reply accepts several points, adopts changes in a fifth amendment note (clearer procedures, plan adjustments instead of new plans, external expert advice also when the client disagrees, explicit consent for the client-support person, restriction of the international committees' powers), while defending the expanded procedure as a balance between regulation and client protection.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether the expanded decision-making procedure for involuntary care is necessary given the ongoing culture change, and advises reconsideration; the minister defends the procedure but adopts some simplifications in a fifth amendment note.

The Afdeling finds that tripling multidisciplinary consultations and requiring a new detailed care plan at each step is overregulation; the minister concedes that a new plan is not needed each step and clarifies the procedure.

The Afdeling warns that new obligations may raise administrative burden and divert staff from primary care; the minister argues the procedure saves time and money and that implementation guidance will follow.

The Afdeling notes that the procedures of articles 8 to 8c are insufficiently clear and that the link between the consultations is unclear; the minister adjusts articles 8 and 8a in the fifth amendment note.
The Afdeling advises that external expert advice must also be sought when the client, not only the representative, does not consent to involuntary care; the minister accepts this change.

The Afdeling finds that transfer of client personal data (including health data) to the client-support person is too broad and requires explicit consent; the minister narrows the data transfer and makes consent explicit.

The Afdeling advises that the representative, not only the family, should be able to request assistance and that the reasons for excluding family from objecting to information provision be explained; the minister adjusts the text for the representative.
The Afdeling advises that the powers of the international preventive committees under article 49(5) be limited to persons deprived of liberty; the minister amends the bill accordingly.
The Afdeling criticises placing chapter 3A on forensic clients in this bill rather than the forensic care bill and asks for justification; the minister explains the reasons briefly.
The Afdeling offers a list of drafting corrections; the minister adopts most but not all, explaining reasons for those not adopted.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet zorg en dwang for people with dementia or intellectual disability, supporting its aim but raising objections on involuntary admission criteria, procedural safeguards, the position of home-living clients and mantelzorgers, complaints handling and the client file. The minister's nader rapport accepted most remarks, amending the bill on admission assessment by CIZ, representative definitions, complaints (rechter may now decide itself), home-care supervision and the client dossier, while declining some points such as extending inspectorate entry powers to homes.
concerns: Involuntary admission without consent and the 'ernstig nadeel' criterion require independent assessment, which the minister defended as CIZ competence with added expertise rules.
Procedures for admission requests, validity periods and the consequences of objection needed statutory regulation, which was added to the bill.
Court must be able to decide itself on complaints where restrictive measures amount to deprivation of liberty, as required by Article 5 ECHR and Article 15 Constitution.
The open-ended delegation to extend the act to other diseases needed concrete statutory criteria, which were added.
Extending the inspectorate's power to enter private homes without consent is not justified by necessity under the constitutionally protected home right; the minister disagreed.
Mantelzorgers should not bear responsibility for involuntary care; the minister confirmed that only professionals may apply it and added supervision requirements.
Numerous redactional remarks were adopted, including renumbering and terminology changes.

32360-XI.s: This supplementary budget act (slotwet) adjusts the 2009 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment, the Dutch Emissions Authority's operating budget and the Wadden Fund. It also relaxes two Comptabiliteitswet 2001 reporting requirements for the ministry's 2009 annual report.
q: Deviating from article 54, third paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the information referred to in that paragraph is not included per policy article in the 2009 annual report of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment.

In afwijking van artikel 54, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt in het jaarverslag van het Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer (XI) voor het jaar 2009 de informatie, bedoeld in dat artikellid, niet per beleidsartikel opgenomen.
p: Article 2 allows the ministry's 2009 annual report to omit per-policy-article information required by the Comptabiliteitswet and instead link it to priorities designated by the minister, reducing parliamentary budget visibility.

32710-IXA.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the National Debt (Ministry of Finance, IXA) for 2010 by adopting a supplementary budget and final budget adjustment (slotwet) for that year. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and makes the changes retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2010

32780-III.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs and the Cabinet of the Queen by adding EUR 785 thousand to the Ministry's policy article and EUR 58 thousand to the Cabinet's article, as a first supplementary budget tied to the Spring Memorandum. It sets the budget unit in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2011 with retroactive effect where publication is late.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs and of the Cabinet of the Queen (III) for the year 2011

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken en van het Kabinet der Koningin (III) voor het jaar 2011

32869.s: The bill amends the Antarctic Protection Act to implement new Antarctic Treaty measures on environmental emergencies, liability for clean-up costs, insurance or financial security, contingency plans, and tourism rules such as landing limits and biological contamination controls. It introduces ministerial power to take response actions, demand evidence, and set certain amounts and rules by ministerial regulation or general administrative order.
32869.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to implement the Antarctic Treaty measures and Annex VI to the Protocol on environmental emergencies, and notes that enforcement in Antarctica is very limited so preventive oversight before departure is important.
q: If the organiser, in the view of Our Ministers, does not comply with the first paragraph or does not promptly follow the directions, Our Ministers may have such actions or other measures carried out.

Indien de organisator naar het oordeel van Onze Ministers niet voldoet aan het bepaalde in het eerste lid of niet onverwijld gevolg geeft aan de aanwijzingen, bedoeld in artikel 25, derde lid, kunnen Onze Ministers dergelijke acties of andere maatregelen laten ondernemen.
d: measures to prevent adverse effects on Antarctic environment
evidence documents for health and safety measures
rules for setting the amount of cost liability
p: Ministers may themselves undertake response actions or other measures when an organiser fails to act, shifting control of the response to the executive.
Ministers set the amount organisers must pay to the fund, taking into account all circumstances, with rules set by ministerial regulation.
Ministers may request written evidence of health and safety measures at their discretion from organisers.
On request of another party, Ministers may claim payment from organisations established in the Netherlands, enforced through the state's claim mechanism.

parties: Has no need to ask questions on the bill itself but has questions on the Antarctic Treaty measures.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
Questions the necessity of the restrictive landing policy and the 500-passenger and 100-visitor limits, and asks about coordination burdens on operators.
Can the government explain why the landing policy is so strongly restrictive?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom het aanlandingsbeleid zo sterk restrictief is?
Finds the measures insufficient, questions the vague notion of 'state operator' exempt from financial security, and asks how enforcement of visitor caps works.
The concept of state operator is, in the view of the SP members, open to many interpretations.
Het begrip staatsexploitant is naar mening van de leden van de SP-fractie voor velerlei uitleg vatbaar.
Has no need to ask questions or make remarks.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
Asks what 'reasonable preventive measures' and contingency plans entail and how they are reviewed, and objects to the biennial reporting interval to parliament.
Is the government willing to abandon this intention?
Is de regering bereid van dit voornemen af te zien?

32878.s: The bill adjusts child benefit, the child-related budget, survivors' benefits and the WGA follow-up benefit for people living abroad, lowering them by a ministerial-regulation percentage reflecting the cost of living in the country of residence relative to the Netherlands. The percentages are set by ministerial regulation and may be revised annually without statutory anchoring.
32878.j: The memorandum justifies the percentages by arguing that purchasing power parity is the most objective measure of cost of living across countries, and that the percentages will be set by ministerial regulation and revised annually.
q: In the government's view, the cost level, as represented by purchasing power parity, is the best and most objective parameter for comparing the cost of living across various countries.

Naar de mening van de regering is het kostenniveau, zoals weergegeven door de koopkrachtpariteit, de beste en meest objectieve parameter voor een vergelijking van de kosten van levensonderhoud in diverse landen.
d: percentage of child benefit for children living abroad
percentage of survivors' benefit for beneficiaries living abroad
percentage of income disregarded for survivors living abroad
percentage of half-orphan benefit for children living abroad
percentage of orphan benefit for children living abroad
percentage of allowance for survivors, half-orphans or orphans abroad
percentage of survivors' and half-orphan benefit for residents abroad
percentage of child-related budget where a foreign country is the residence country
rules for calculating child-related budget for multiple children, one abroad
percentage of follow-up benefit for insured persons living abroad
p: I.A, II, III.B, IV.B (percentage clauses generally)
Benefit levels for people living abroad are reduced by percentages fixed by ministerial regulation rather than by statute, with the cost-of-living ratio as the only stated basis.
The annual revision principle for percentages is not anchored in law because the government depends on third-party figures.

parties: Asks whether other legal obstacles exist beyond the bilateral treaties and association council decisions, and stresses enforcement cooperation with countries.
Enforcement is, according to the VVD members, of crucial importance for the proposed legislation.
Handhaving is volgens de leden van de VVD-fractie van cruciaal belang voor de voorgestelde wetgeving.
Opposes applying the country-of-residence principle to the WIA because benefits should remain wage-related rather than linked to the minimum wage.
The PvdA members reject introducing the country-of-residence principle in part of the WIA.](Note)
De invoering van het woonlandbeginsel in een gedeelte van de Wet WIA wijzen de leden van de PvdA-fractie af.
Asks why a phased approach was chosen, how long it lasts, whether alternatives were considered, and how the cost-level comparison was made.
Supports the principle but flags treaties with New Zealand, Australia and Macedonia and European Court of Human Rights case law as possible obstacles.
These members find the principle of applying the country-of-residence principle in the proposed cases sensible.
Deze leden vinden het principe van de toepassing van het woonlandbeginsel in de voorgestelde gevallen verstandig.
Questions objective justification, compatibility with the European Convention on Human Rights and the EU-Turkey association council decision, and the fluctuating benefit levels.
These members also ask whether the government can explain why applying the country-of-residence principle is objectively justifiable.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten waarom het toepassen van het woonlandbeginsel objectief te rechtvaardigen is.
Notes the Council of State advised waiting for the Akdas ruling, asks for clarity on the calculation method before entry into force, and questions reliance on GDP per capita.
The D66 members note that the Council of State advisory division recommends waiting for the final Centraal Raad van Beroep ruling in the Akdas case before introduction.

De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat de afdeling advisering van de Raad van State adviseert om te wachten met invoering op de einduitspraak van de Centraal Raad van Beroep (CRvB) in de zaak Akdas.
Asks whether the measures breach the EU-Turkey association decision, equal treatment and anti-discrimination rules, and whether administrative costs outweigh savings.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill adjusting social security benefits paid abroad to the cost level of the country of residence, but advises the explanatory memorandum to address EU-Turkey association agreement rules and CJEU case law, and to await the Akdas judgment. The government reply states the advice on addressing third-country agreements was adopted and the memorandum amended, but holds that the Akdas ruling has no consequences for the bill, so waiting is unnecessary.
concerns: The Council advises addressing the EU-Turkey Association Agreement, Additional Protocol and Decisions 1/80 and 3/80 in the explanatory memorandum, which the government did, but disputes that the Akdas judgment requires waiting or adapting the bill.
The Council advises the explanatory memorandum to be amended for drafting clarity, which the government adopted as a redactional change.

32887.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to change who may file an enquiry request, raising the share thresholds for large companies and adding a commissioner-judge who supervises the investigation. It also tightens the procedure for interim measures and the investigators' reporting and liability rules, and requires a review of the law's effects within three years.
32887.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to the evaluation of the enquiry right, roundtable findings, and empirical research showing that thresholds and procedural safeguards need adjustment.
q: No appeal in cassation is open against decisions of the judge-commissioner.
Tegen beslissingen van de raadsheer-commissaris staat geen beroep in cassatie open.
p: Clarifies that the Enterprise Chamber may order interim measures for the duration of proceedings, subject to a balancing of interests and a requirement that the measure be urgently needed.

Introduces a judge-commissioner who supervises the enquiry investigation and may give directions on request of interested parties, while a decision of the commissioner cannot be appealed in cassation.Tegen beslissingen van de raadsheer-commissaris staat geen beroep in cassatie open.

parties: Questions whether provisional measures can deviate from mandatory law, the scope of the Enterprise Chamber's powers, and how investigator liability and court review are handled.
Can a provisional measure taken in the first phase remain in force in the second phase?
Kan een in de eerste fase getroffen onmiddellijke voorziening van kracht blijven in de tweede fase?
Objects to raising access thresholds for large companies, which would leave small minority shareholders unable to tackle misconduct, and regrets not giving works councils enquiry rights.
This comes at the expense of small minority shareholders, who would then no longer be able to tackle abuses in the company.
Dit gaat ten koste van kleine minderheidsaandeelhouders, die dan niet meer in staat zullen zijn om misstanden in de vennootschap aan te pakken.
Asks how company relations can be improved other than by enquiry, and objects that the criterion of 'a substantial part of other shareholders' is too vague.
These members note that the phrase 'a substantial part of the other shareholders' is vague and not concrete enough.
Deze leden merken op dat de zinsnede «een belangrijk deel van de andere aandeelhouders» vaag en niet concreet genoeg is.

Questions the scope of discretion for admissibility of enquiry requests, the effect of 'or proper course of affairs' wording, and the evidentiary weight of enquiry reports in later liability proceedings.
These members ask whether the words 'or proper course of affairs' may partly undo the effect of the new article 2:349a, third paragraph.
Voornoemde leden vragen of de woorden «of juiste gang van zaken» het effect van het nieuwe artikel 2:349a, derde lid, niet weer deels teniet doen.
Asks why the works council should be excluded from direct access to enquiry when other bodies have it, and how the notion of mismanagement relates to works council advisory rights.
In this light, can the government explain why an exception must be made for the works council?
Kan de regering in dit licht uitleggen waarom voor de OR een uitzondering gemaakt moet worden?
Has no questions on the bill.
They currently have no questions about the bill.
Zij hebben op dit moment geen vragen over het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill amending the Dutch enquiry procedure in Book 2 of the Civil Code but advises extending the enquiry right to works councils or client councils, granting the AFM a hearing right, and adding an evaluation clause. The government's reply largely accepts the advice on the notification duty and evaluation clause, while declining to extend enquiry rights to works councils and client councils and granting the AFM only information rights rather than a hearing right.
concerns: The Afdeling advises extending the enquiry right to works councils and client councils, which the government declines to do.
The Afdeling advises giving the AFM a hearing right in enquiry proceedings; the government grants information rights equal to DNB but not a hearing right.
The notification duty in article 2:349 BW is amended to cover the intention to file a request, as advised.
An evaluation clause is added to the bill, as advised.
The transitional provision (Artikel II) is reformulated as suggested in the editorial annex.

32896.s: The bill clarifies Article 18b of the Minimum Wage Act by requiring employers, on request, to provide the inspectorate with records of wages, holiday allowance and hours worked, and failure to do so is an offence. It adds a rebuttable presumption that a person performing work for an enterprise is an employee of that enterprise, shifting the burden of proof onto the presumed employer, and applies the old wording to facts before entry into force.
32896.j: The memorandum justifies the change by arguing that inspectors cannot enforce the Act without records, and that a rebuttable presumption is a reasonable distribution of the burden of proof compatible with the presumption of innocence.
q: Rebuttal evidence by the employer is therefore expressly possible.
Tegenbewijs door de werkgever is derhalve uitdrukkelijk mogelijk.
p: The inspectorate may presume an employment relationship and sanction employers who fail to produce records, with the burden of rebuttal placed on the employer and the presumed employee.

parties: Asks how the presumption of employment is established, what counter-evidence employers can offer, limitation periods, and how inspectorate enforcement is targeted.
These members further ask whether the government can give examples of the counter-evidence the employer can submit to prove its innocence.
Deze leden vragen voorts of de regering voorbeelden kan geven van het tegenbewijs dat de werkgever kan overleggen om zijn onschuld te bewijzen.
Fully supports the amendment as closing loopholes for minimum wage evasion, while worrying about the government's enforcement effort.
The PvdA members fully support the legislative amendment.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie steunen de wetswijziging volledig.

Asks how article 18b was applied before the Raad van State ruling, whether fines must be revised, whether workers must cooperate with employers' counter-evidence, and how culpability is assessed in fines.
These members note that under the presumption of employment in this bill, counter-evidence may be submitted and responsibility no longer rests with the employer.

Deze leden constateren dat bij het vermoeden van werkgeverschap als gevolg van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel de mogelijkheid bestaat dat tegenbewijs wordt geleverd en de verantwoordelijkheid niet langer bij de werkgever komt te liggen.
Asks about the criteria for high-risk sectors, why the normal working hours obligation was dropped given a temporary enforcement instruction, and whether facts must be assessed jointly.
These members are therefore curious why the government does not leave open in the submitted bill the possibility of being obliged to provide documents on normal working hours.
Zij zijn daarom benieuwd waarom de regering in het ingediende wetsvoorstel niet de mogelijkheid openlaat om verplicht te worden om bescheiden te verschaffen over de normale arbeidsduur.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised in March 2011 that the proposed amendment to article 18b WML (minimum wage act), creating a rebuttable presumption that an employer of persons working in a business is liable for a fine for non-production of records, needed reconsideration on its structure and transitional law, as it raised proportionality and presumption-of-innocence (ECHR art. 6(2)) concerns. The minister's reply of September 2011 accepts the transitional-law point, defends the proportionality and the rebuttable presumption, and reports changes to the wording, the explanatory memorandum, and the draft text.
concerns: The Council considered that the double rebuttable presumption and the high fine made the provision disproportionate and incompatible with the presumption of innocence under ECHR art. 6(2); the government defended proportionality, clarified the rebuttable character and sharpened the reasonable-suspicion wording.

The Council objected that the broader definition of employer and worker in art. 18b(3) diverges from the definitions in arts. 4 and 5 WML without justification; the government clarified that the extended definition applies only to supervision and fine imposition, and added explanation in the memorandum.
The Council advised that the amended provision should not apply to facts established before entry into force, and the government added an explicit transitional provision.
The Council made editorial remarks on the title, considerans, wording of art. 18b(3) and (4), and the government incorporated them.

33240-IXB.s: This bill is the Dutch slotwet (closing budget act) that amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the 2011 budget statements for the Domeinen Roerende Zaken and Rijksvastgoed- en Ontwikkelbedrijf operating units, reconciling realised figures with the adopted budget. It changes appropriations in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Closing-budget changes are explained where they exceed 5% of the available amount at article level and also exceed EUR 2.5 million.

Slotwetmutaties worden toegelicht voorzover deze op artikelniveau groter zijn dan 5% van het beschikbare bedrag na de suppletoire begroting samenhangend met de najaarsnota en daarnaast groter zijn dan € 2,5 mln.

33280-IV.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statement for Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties IV) following the spring memorandum, changing expenditure and commitment amounts for the policy articles on the guarantee function and autonomy of Kingdom partners. It sets the amendment in force from 1 June 2012 and fixes budget figures in thousands of euros.
q: The budget statement Kingdom Relations for the year 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33280-VI.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice, changing expenditure and revenue lines for the first supplementary budget tied to the Spring Memorandum. It does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight, review or citizens' protections.
33280-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by lower projected intake for legal aid and courts, fewer traffic stops after the abolition of ticket quotas, and higher employer contributions for police and judiciary under the income-dependent contribution.
q: Partly (about EUR 29 million) this is possible because the recently revised intake forecast (PMJ) for 2012 is lower than the available capacity.
Voor een deel (circa € 29 mln.) is dat mogelijk doordat de recent bijgestelde prognose van de instroom (PMJ) voor het jaar 2012 lager is dan de beschikbare capaciteit.

33589.s: The bill amends the Dutch Financial Supervision Act (via the AIFMD implementing bill) so that national, regional and local governments and bodies managing social security and pension funds fall within the scope of the AIFMD supervision regime. It provides for two alternative versions depending on which of the two bills enters into force first, and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33589.j: The memorandum justifies the change as necessary to correctly implement article 2(3)(b) and (e) of the AIFMD and avoid supervisory gaps and possible infringement proceedings by the European Commission.
q: This bill implementing the directive on alternative investment fund managers provides a harmonised framework for licensing and supervision of managers of investment institutions.

Dit wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van de richtlijn voor alternatieve beheerders van beleggingsinstellingen voorziet in een geharmoniseerd kader voor de vergunningverlening aan en het toezicht op beheerders van beleggingsinstellingen.

parties: Asks whether ESMA advice was requested and what it says, and why the exemption for pension-fund-only managers was adopted despite concerns about the directive.
Has ESMA, at the request of the Dutch government, drawn up advice on the question just mentioned?
Is er door de ESMA op verzoek van de Nederlandse regering een advies opgesteld ten aanzien van de zojuist genoemde vraag?
Asks about the likelihood of an EU infringement procedure, the need for EU-level supervision and subsidiarity, and whether affected pension administrators should be consulted.
Why is it necessary to organise this supervision at European level, the PVV members ask.
Waarom is het noodzakelijk dit toezicht op Europees niveau vorm te geven, zo vragen de leden van de fractie van de PVV.
Questions the risks of the absence of direct supervision of pension asset managers, supervisory cost increases and staffing capacity of AFM and DNB, and the Commission's position.
The SP members ask whether the government can explain what risks attach to the fact that no direct supervision is exercised over managers of pension assets.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering uiteen kan zetten welke risico’s kleven aan het feit dat er geen direct toezicht wordt uitgeoefend op beheerders van pensioenvermogen.

33598.s: The bill lets administrative boards of publicly run schools (verzelfstandigde besturen) decide on closing their own public schools, instead of only the municipal council, and allows parents to initiate the founding of new public primary schools by submitting signed declarations. It amends the Primary Education Act, the Expertise Centres Act and the Caribbean Netherlands primary education act accordingly.
33598.j: The memorandum justifies the change by aligning the powers of public and private school boards, as required by the duality principle in article 23 of the Constitution, and by the need for boards to be able to close schools whose quality cannot be guaranteed.
q: Founding and closing schools is an essential part of running an education organisation.
Het stichten en opheffen van scholen is een wezenlijk onderdeel van het besturen van een onderwijsorganisatie.
p: Gives administrative boards of public schools and parents a right to propose new public schools, and removes the municipal council's sole competence over closing public schools.
Lets an administrative board close its own public school, with the municipality given notice and the option to take over the school within a set period.

parties: Asks whether the bill allows public schools to cooperate with private legal entities and who counts as 'parents' for the fifty-parent prognosis.
To what extent does this bill offer public schools enough room to cooperate with private legal entities, ask the members of this group.
In hoeverre biedt dit wetsvoorstel voldoende ruimte voor openbare scholen om samen te werken met privaatrechtelijke rechtspersonen, zo vragen de leden van deze fractie.

Welcomes the parent initiative right but worries about the duration of the procedure, the municipality's lack of instruments and influence over school planning, and the risk of children being forced into special education.
These members ask whether municipalities should not gain more influence over establishing cooperative schools that guarantee both public and special education supply.

Deze leden vragen of gemeenten niet meer invloed zouden moeten krijgen bij het realiseren van samenwerkingsscholen, waarbij het aanbod van openbaar onderwijs en bijzonder onderwijs gewaarborgd kan worden.
Supports the need for a parent initiative right and school policy autonomy.
The members endorse the need for a parental initiative right in founding schools and for schools' own policy.
De leden onderschrijven de noodzaak tot het initiatiefrecht voor ouders bij het stichten van scholen en het beleid van de scholen zelf.
Asks what added value the parent right has beyond the existing feasibility study, whether the law fits Caribbean Netherlands, and whether two kinds of public schools in one municipality is desirable.
What added value does this new article have, since parents can already express the need for a new public primary school, ask these members.
Welke meerwaarde heeft dit nieuwe artikel, aangezien ouders ook nu al de behoefte aan een nieuwe openbare basisschool kenbaar kunnen maken, zo vragen deze leden.

Supports wider parental involvement but questions the claimed equivalence of public and special education, since the Constitution places responsibility for public education with the municipality, and asks whether municipalities keep enough freedom under mandatory plan rules.
They note that this equivalence concerns quality requirements, whereas the bill concerns the planning of school supply.
Zij merken op dat die gelijkwaardigheid betrekking heeft op de eisen van deugdelijkheid die de kwaliteit betreffen, terwijl het wetsvoorstel toeziet op de planning van het scholenaanbod.

33640-IV.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statement for Kingdom Relations (chapter IV) by reallocating amounts across policy articles, including a EUR 7.8 million increase for autonomy promotion and a EUR 6.2 million increase for nominal and unforeseen expenses. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2013
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV), voor het jaar 2013

33640-VI.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice, adjusting expenditure and revenue lines following the spring memorandum. It makes the changes effective from 1 June 2013 and sets amounts in thousands of euros.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice (VI) for the year 2013
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2013

33697.s: The bill digitises enforcement of common traffic offences by removing the requirement to hand over a paper notice of the sanction and allowing it to be left on the vehicle or omitted. It also amends the Criminal Procedure Code and the Municipalities Act so that notices may be given digitally and parking tax assessments may be attached to vehicles identified by licence plate.
33697.j: The memorandum justifies the discretion as necessary for phased introduction of digital enforcement and argues that photographs give offenders adequate evidence to contest notices.
q: The bill provides room for this because the competent officer is given discretionary power so that, where digital enforcement has not yet been introduced after the entry into force date, he can and will continue to use the paper fine.

Het wetsvoorstel biedt hiervoor ruimte doordat aan de bevoegde ambtenaar een discretionaire bevoegdheid is gegeven zodat op de plaatsen waar na de datum van inwerkingtreding nog niet digitaal wordt gehandhaafd, hij gebruik kan en zal blijven maken van de papieren bekeuring.
d: officer's discretion whether to hand over or leave a notice of sanction
p: Enforcement officers gain discretion to leave a notice on the vehicle instead of handing it to the person concerned, reducing direct notice to the offender while policy guidance is explicitly not restricted.
Municipalities may attach parking tax assessments to vehicles naming only the licence plate instead of the taxpayer's name, a departure from the normal service rule.

parties: Asks whether a paper or electronic standard notice alternative could preserve citizens' ability to defend themselves while still enabling digital enforcement.
However, it also reduces the defence options of the person concerned, which these members find less positive.
Het vermindert echter ook de verweermogelijkheden van de betrokkene en dat vinden deze leden minder positief.
Asks how citizens can defend themselves when records or evidence are lost, and whether officer errors can be contested.
How can an affected offender defend themselves if evidence (parking receipt) on their side has also been destroyed?
Hoe kan een betrokken overtreder zich verweren als ook bewijs (parkeerbon) van zijn kant is vernietigd?
Doubts the explanatory memorandum justifies the effects on citizens' legal sense and the police's public standing.
The members speaking are of the view that the explanatory memorandum provides insufficient justification for this.
De aan het woord zijnde leden zijn van mening dat de toelichting onvoldoende onderbouwing biedt voor dit gegeven.
Argues that without any notice citizens cannot gather counter-evidence in time, and that the government's rejection of a standard notice is too brief.
Without notice there is a chance it will be destroyed before the decision is delivered to the person concerned.
Zonder kennisgeving is de kans aanwezig dat dit vernietigd wordt voordat de beschikking bij de betrokkene wordt bezorgd.
Believes the benefits outweigh drawbacks but asks what guarantees exist that data entry is reliable, that information to citizens is clear, and that the notice period is shortened.
These members ask what guarantees there are that digitisation actually shortens the submission period from sixteen to seven days and that information to citizens is sufficiently clear.

Voornoemde leden vragen welke garanties er zijn dat door de digitalisering de aanlevertermijn daadwerkelijk wordt verkort van thans zestien naar straks zeven dagen en dat de informatie en communicatie naar de burger voldoende helder is.
Worried that citizens may be accused of facts they cannot remember and that the government has not adequately answered advisory bodies' objections on proportionality.
Why does the government consider that limiting citizens' evidentiary position outweighs the benefits of digital enforcement?
Waarom weegt volgens de regering het beperken van burgers in hun bewijspositie op tegen de voordelen van de digitale handhaving?
Concerned about legal position and evidence-gathering for citizens; asks for a notice in some form and for the Raad van State's objections to be addressed.
They believe the bill must be more substantively justified on this point and that alternatives should be examined, with some form of notice remaining.
Zij menen dat het wetsvoorstel op dit punt meer dragend moet worden onderbouwd en dat er naar alternatieven moet worden gekeken, waarbij een kennisgeving in enige vorm blijft bestaan.
Asks whether a standard paper notice could be retained alongside digital enforcement and whether the four-month delivery period could be shortened.
They ask whether a standard paper notice, which the Council of State's advisory division also mentions, could not still serve a useful function.
Zij vragen of een papieren standaardaankondiging, waarover ook de Afdeling advies van de Raad van State spreekt, niet toch een nuttige functie zou kunnen blijven behouden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division, in its opinion of 16 May 2013, advised that the bill enabling digital enforcement of common offences by (extraordinary) enforcement officers be justified and partly adapted, mainly because dropping the paper notice weakens citizens' ability to defend themselves in parking cases and at traffic stops. The government's reply of 8 July 2013 largely rejects the objections, defending proportionality, the rejection of mini-printers and a phased introduction, while adding explanatory motivation and some clarifications.
concerns: Dropping the paper notice may unduly limit citizens' defence options, so the proportionality of the administrative burden reduction versus citizens' rights must be explicitly justified in the explanatory memorandum.
Absent defendants and those stopped on the spot need an adequate way to verify the record and prepare their defence, which the government addresses only partly through photos and faster delivery.
The rejection of mini-printers and the cheaper alternative of a standard notice on the vehicle are insufficiently reasoned, and the government added cost specification and motivation.
Article II refers broadly to all strafbeschikkingen, which is wider than the intended scope; the government kept the broad wording and motivated it.
The discretionary power to hand over a notice ('kan worden uitgereikt') departs from the current duty to do so where possible; the government justified it in the commentary on Article II.
The explanatory memorandum should indicate how many police regions and municipalities will switch to digital enforcement, which the government added in the phased-introduction section.

33787.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Groesbeek, Millingen aan de Rijn and Ubbergen into a new municipality of Groesbeek from the date of reorganisation, and makes transitional arrangements for elections, taxes, regional safety and electoral districts. The explanatory memorandum justifies the merger by the weak financial and administrative position of Millingen aan de Rijn and the aim of a stronger municipality.
33787.j: The memorandum justifies immediate entry into force, departing from the usual reorganisation calendar, because postponement would cause excessive disadvantage to the municipalities.
q: the bill opts for immediate entry into force, departing from the Fixed Change Moments system
in het wetsvoorstel is gekozen voor onmiddellijke inwerkingtreding, waarmee wordt afgeweken van de systematiek van Vaste Verandermomenten

parties: Sees the voluntary merger to strengthen administrative capacity and raises no remarks or questions.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD- fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Welcomes the merger as a solution to Millingen's problems and asks for swift decision-making, while asking about a care home split by a municipal boundary.
They hope for a swift completion of the decision-making on this reorganisation so the parties involved can continue preparations.
Zij hopen op een spoedige afronding van de besluitvorming rond deze herindeling, zodat de betrokken partijen de voorbereidingen kunnen vervolgen.
Asks why no referendum or representative survey was held to establish whether residents want the merger, arguing merger should only happen if a majority wants it.
These members believe a merger should only proceed if a majority of residents in the municipalities concerned want it.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat er pas tot herindeling moet worden overgegaan als dit is wat de inwoners van de betreffende gemeenten in meerderheid willen.

Questions the lack of representative research into public support, the basis for claimed capacity gains, the financial effects, and whether local democracy is being hollowed out before a final decision.
Does the government share the view of these members that representative research is necessary to obtain a clear picture of this support?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat representatief onderzoek noodzakelijk is om een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van dit draagvlak?
Endorses the government's premise that municipalities are primarily responsible for raising their own capacity and can agree to the merger.

These members endorse the government's starting point that municipalities are primarily responsible for taking measures to increase administrative capacity and can therefore agree to the proposed merger.

Deze leden onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van de regering, dat gemeenten primair zelf aan zet zijn om maatregelen te nemen indien dat wenselijk dan wel noodzakelijk wordt geacht om de bestuurskracht te vergroten en kunnen daarom instemmen met de voorgestelde samenvoeging.

Stresses the importance of public support and of a merger at the request of the municipalities, asks how the merger fits the government's scale policy, and asks why the name chosen by the municipal councils is not followed.
The SGP members would like to know the government's response; why is the name chosen by the municipal councils not followed, as is usual?
Graag vernemen de leden van de SGP-fractie wat de reactie van de regering hierop is? Waarom wordt de door de gemeenteraden gekozen naam niet gevolgd, zoals wel gebruikelijk is?

33796.s: The bill caps the improvement period for very weak primary and secondary schools at one year and requires the inspectorate to inform the minister when a school's quality remains seriously deficient for longer than a year. It amends the Wet op het onderwijstoezicht, with entry into force set by royal decree.
33796.j: The memorandum justifies the shorter period by the need for quality education for pupils, the falling number of very weak schools, and the sufficiency of procedural safeguards such as objective norms, consultation and appeal rights.
q: It must be clear that this concerns a power of the Minister.
Helder moet zijn dat het hier een bevoegdheid van de Minister betreft.
d: fixing the date of entry into force by royal decree
p: Shortens the maximum improvement period for very weak schools to one year, narrowing the time schools have to correct deficiencies before the minister decides on closure or other measures.
Requires the inspectorate to inform the minister when school quality remains seriously deficient beyond one year, feeding the minister's closure decision.

parties: Asks how the Inspectorate will communicate the new rules and why the previous two-year period was not codified, and questions why the Inspectorate only alerts boards after three years of poor results.
Apparently Inspectorate supervision does not work sufficiently preventively during those three years at present.
Kennelijk werkt het Inspectietoezicht in die drie jaren niet voldoende preventief op dit moment.
Asks for monitoring of how many weak schools improve within one year and about the Inspectorate's preventive supervision results and whether parents and works councils should be informed.
How are parents and the works council informed of declining results in the preventive phase, the members ask.
Hoe worden de ouders en de mr 8 op de hoogte gesteld van de dalende opbrengsten in de preventieve fase, vragen de leden.
Questions whether the Inspectorate's paper reality matches actual reality and whether it judges 'how' rather than 'what', and asks for review of the Inspectorate's functioning.
to what extent does the Inspectorate concern itself with the 'how' while, in these members' view, it should only focus on the 'what'.
in hoeverre bemoeit de Inspectie zich met het «hoe» terwijl zij zich naar de mening van deze leden slechts moet richten op het «wat».
Stresses that intervention should be in the child's interest and closure only a last resort, and asks how the Inspectorate defines learning results and whether the norm is absolute or relative.
They do emphasise that full efforts must be made to improve these schools rather than close them.
Wel benadrukken zij dat er ten volle naar moet worden gestreefd deze scholen te verbeteren, in plaats van te sluiten.
Doubts the bill is necessary given recent improvements and that the instrument may be too severe, and asks whether closure remains an ultimum remedium.
They doubt however whether the bill is necessary and whether the instrument is not too severe to achieve this aim.
Zij betwijfelen echter of het wetsvoorstel noodzakelijk is en het middel niet te zwaar is om dit doel te bereiken.
Questions the scientific basis for drawing hard conclusions and sanctions from school learning results given confounding factors, and asks how the legal grounds for sanctions hold up.
In their estimation this displaces the most crucial question, namely the basic assessment of whether hard conclusions and even sanctions can justifiably be attached to school learning results.

Naar hun inschatting wordt hiermee de meest cruciale vraag verdrongen, namelijk de basale beoordeling of op goede gronden aan leerresultaten van scholen harde conclusies en zelfs sancties kunnen worden verbonden.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised that the bill to fix a one-year improvement period for very weak schools and to make the Inspectorate's advice to close a school mandatory should be reconsidered, because the inspection's assessment framework includes indicators without a statutory basis and the necessity of the measure was insufficiently motivated. The government's reply accepted removing the mandatory content of the Inspectorate's advice and the redactional remarks, but defended the one-year term as necessary to give schools clarity and address persistent problems.
concerns: Indicators in the inspectorate's framework that underpin a closure measure should have a formal statutory basis under Article 23 of the Constitution and be set by general administrative order, which the government did not fully accept.
The explanatory memorandum insufficiently motivates why a statutory one-year improvement period is necessary given recent reforms and the declining number of very weak schools.
The mandatory content of the Inspectorate's advice to the minister is superfluous and should be dropped from the bill, which the government accepted.
Redactional remarks on the wording of the bill were adopted.

33859.s: The bill approves a 2013 headquarters agreement between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Residual Mechanism for the Special Court for Sierra Leone, which applies to the European part of the Netherlands. It sets the entry-into-force date of the approval law, two months after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The headquarters agreement applies only to the European part of the Netherlands.
Het Zetelverdrag geldt uitsluitend voor het Europese deel van Nederland.

parties: The VVD supports the establishment of the Residual Special Court but asks the government to specify the treaty provisions covered by the Act of 1947 authorisation, and how detention facilitation and its costs are arranged.
They support the establishment of the Residual Special Court for Sierra Leone and have some further comments and questions regarding the bill.
Zij steunen de oprichting van het Restmechanisme voor het Speciaal Hof voor Sierra Leone en hebben nog enkele opmerkingen en vragen naar aanleiding voor het wetsvoorstel.

33886.s: The bill extends from five to seven years the transitional period during which designations of military aerodromes under the Aviation Act keep their validity, by amending Article XVIII of the 2008 aviation regulation law. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33886.j: The memorandum justifies the extension because the five-year period proved too short to adopt an aerodrome decision for all eight military aerodromes in time, partly due to a court annulment of a permit.
q: The reason for this is that the five-year period proves too short to adopt an aerodrome decision in time for all eight military aerodromes.
Reden hiervoor is dat de termijn van vijf jaar te kort blijkt te zijn om tijdig voor alle acht militaire luchthavens een luchthavenbesluit tot stand te brengen.

parties: Supports the extension for technical and bureaucratic reasons but is critical of Natura 2000 rules and asks about extra costs of the Woensdrecht delay.
The VVD members are very critical of Natura 2000.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn zeer kritisch ten aanzien van Natura 2000.
Agrees with the bill but asks the government to explain the causes of delay at De Kooy, the noise effects, zoning consequences and feasibility of the timetable.
The PvdA members note that the bill does not address the possible factual and legal consequences of the two-year extension, including existing noise complaints around the airfields.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie constateren dat het wetsvoorstel niet ingaat op de mogelijke feitelijke en juridische gevolgen van de verlenging van de termijn met twee jaar voor onder meer de bestaande geluidsklachten rond de vliegvelden.

33976.s: This omnibus repair bill (Reparatiewet infrastructuur en milieu 2014) makes many technical and corrective amendments across infrastructure and environment laws, including moving tariff-setting from ministerial regulations to executive agencies (RDW, CBR), shifting enforcement of drinking-water competition rules to the ACM, and widening entry powers for water boards and ministers. It also contains transitional provisions for the T-driving licence and various consequential corrections.
33976.j: The memorandum justifies moving tariff and cost-setting to executive bodies or ministerial regulations as more efficient and practical, and the entry powers as needed for water levy enforcement.
q: The bill provides that in two cases amounts are set by the RDW instead of by ministerial regulation.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet erin dat in een tweetal gevallen bedragen door de RDW worden vastgesteld in plaats van bij ministeriële regeling.
d: ARTIKEL XVI, onderdeel B (art. 4q, tweede lid, Wegenverkeerswet 1994)
fixing a charge amount now set by the Dienst Wegverkeer instead of ministerial regulation
ARTIKEL XVI, onderdeel AA (art. 121, eerste lid, Wegenverkeerswet 1994)
fee for driving licence issuance set by Dienst Wegverkeer
ARTIKEL XVI, onderdelen BB, CC, GG, HH (art. 132a, 132c, 133, 134 Wegenverkeerswet 1994)
costs and tariffs for educational measures, alcohol lock and examinations set by CBR
rules on traffic signs and measures on roads, including licence-plate data processing by technical means
ARTIKEL XVI, onderdeel D (art. 14, lid 2 en 3 Wegenverkeerswet 1994)
further rules and specifications on traffic signs and the technical aid for plate data
ARTIKEL XVI, onderdeel L (art. 50, eerste lid, Wegenverkeerswet 1994)
rules for establishing identity of applicant for registration by other means
tariff for shipping-related charge moved from AMvB to ministerial regulation
ARTIKEL VI (art. 6a, zesde lid, Instellingswet ACM)
system for cost allocation to market organisations and data they must provide to ACM
Kadaster service sets rules on fees instead of ministerial regulation
ARTIKEL XV, onderdeel C (art. 5.20, lid 2 Waterwet)
minister or water board may grant authorisation to enter dwellings without occupant consent
water board officials' powers to enter premises and take samples for levies
ARTIKEL XVIII, onderdeel A (art. 1 Wet aanvullende regels veiligheid wegtunnels)
designation of the Trans-European road network
ARTIKEL XIX, onderdeel B (art. 11b, eerste lid Wet beheer rijkswaterstaatswerken)
designation of road network subject to road safety management
RDW may refuse type approval for vehicles posing serious danger
p: Allows road managers to process vehicle plate data using technical aids, subject to rules set by AMvB and ministerial regulation.
ARTIKEL XIV (art. 128a Waterschapswet) and ARTIKEL XV, onderdeel C (art. 5.20 Waterwet)

Permits officials and designated persons to enter dwellings without occupant consent, with entry-power limits for residences that are not part of a water works and requirement of an authorisation under the Algemene wet op het binnentreden."}],

parties: Asks whether traffic-survey data collected for Beter Benutten is retained, anonymised, or shared with employers, and which organisations receive privacy-sensitive RDW register data.
These members ask whether it is possible that all data collected for a traffic survey for example for Beter Benutten are kept for the entire duration of the programme.
Deze leden vragen of het mogelijk is dat alle gegevens die verzameld zijn voor een verkeersonderzoek voor bijvoorbeeld Beter Benutten bewaard worden voor de gehele looptijd van het programma.
Supports ANPR for traffic management under privacy conditions but asks about the CBP's recommendations and wants to know the scope of ACM oversight and alcohol-lock and tunnel safety rules.
These members would like to know which recommendations the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) made in the context of privacy protection and what influence this had on the bill.

Deze leden horen graag welke aanbevelingen het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft aangedragen in het kader van de privacybescherming en welke invloed dat heeft gehad op het wetsvoorstel.

33985.s: The bill approves the 2013 Dutch-US FATCA intergovernmental agreement on international tax compliance and data exchange, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33985.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as necessary to meet obligations under the NL IGA, relying on existing reporting systems and the WIB and Belastingwet BES delegation provisions.
q: To meet the obligations under the NL IGA, it is necessary that financial institutions provide the required data to the Tax Authority.
Om aan de verplichtingen op grond van de NL IGA te voldoen, is het noodzakelijk dat FI's de benodigde gegevens verstrekken aan de Belastingdienst.
d: Memorie van toelichting (Wet IB/Belastingwet BES delegation)
designation of administrative obligors required to supply information to the tax authority

parties: Asks whether persons born to US parents who briefly lived in the US, with little other connection, become subject to US tax filing obligations, and how far the agreement reaches.
Isn't that going quite far, especially for someone who only lived there as a baby and has no personal ties to the United States?
Gaat dat niet erg ver, zeker als het gaat om iemand die er enkel als baby woonde en verder persoonlijk geen banden heeft met de Verenigde Staten?
Asks why the Netherlands acted late on FATCA, whether the exchanges are symmetrical, and seeks confirmation that the CBP found the agreement compatible with data protection law.
Can the government explain the reason for the seemingly reticent Dutch stance in the fight against international tax avoidance?
Kan de regering toelichten wat de verklaring is voor deze ogenschijnlijk terughoudende opstelling van Nederland in de strijd tegen internationale belastingontwijking?

Doubts the reciprocity of the US commitment, asks whether the Netherlands will hand over far more data than it receives, and asks how US persons will keep access to Dutch financial services and how compliance will be supervised.
Particularly on the point of reciprocity, the SP members still have many questions.
Met name op het punt van de wederkerigheid leven er nog veel vragen bij de leden van de SP-fractie.
Asks what data the Netherlands will receive in return, whether US data protection is equivalent to Dutch law including article 67 AWR, and raises the absence of an ACTAL administrative burden test.
The CDA members are missing an ACTAL test on this bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie missen een ACTAL-toets op dit wetsvoorstel.
Supports the aim of combating tax avoidance but asks about the legal status of the agreement, its fit with EU data protection directives, and consequences for dual nationals living abroad.
Regarding the Treaty, the members wonder what the legal status of the Treaty is and what rights can be derived from it.
Ten aanzien van het Verdrag vragen de leden zich af wat de juridische status van het Verdrag is en welke rechten hieraan kunnen worden ontleend.
Asks whether Dutch citizens born in the US with passive US citizenship would be reported to US authorities and required to file US tax returns retroactively, and whether they can opt out.

Are these people now reported to the US government under FATCA and obliged to file declarations of income and assets in the United States, even when their citizenship is purely passive and they have never relied on US financial resources?

Worden deze mensen nu op grond van FATCA bekend bij de Amerikaanse overheid en worden zij nu verplicht om aangifte van inkomsten en vermogen te doen in de Verenigde Staten, zelfs als het om een puur passief burgerschap gaat en zij nooit een beroep hebben gedaan op financiële middelen van de Verenigde Staten?
Asks what consultation took place with the banking sector and how feasible the new FATCA rules are for Dutch banks and financial institutions.
How does it assess the feasibility of the new FATCA legislation for Dutch banks and other financial institutions?
Hoe beoordeelt zij de uitvoerbaarheid van de nieuwe FATCA-wetgeving voor de Nederlandse banken en overige financiële instellingen?
Asks whether the Ministry of Finance actually holds financial institutions to their FATCA obligations and what steps it takes if they do not comply.
The D66 members ask whether this actually happens and what steps the ministry takes in that case.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of dat dan ook daadwerkelijk gebeurt en welke stappen het ministerie in dat geval zet.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the FATCA intergovernmental agreement bill with remarks on the exchange of letters (including a 30 September 2015 target and the risk of 30% withholding), the completeness of the explanatory memorandum, and the timing of implementation guidance. The government's nader rapport accepts these remarks and reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented, though the international FATCA handbook was dropped as no longer opportune.
concerns: Advice to clarify in the explanatory memorandum the other exchange-of-letters commitments, including the 30 September 2015 fallback and the possibility of withholding continuing, was followed by supplementing the memorandum.

Advice that the implementation handbook be completed and published quickly was addressed by stating when the Dutch handbook will be ready, but the international OECD handbook was dropped as no longer opportune.
Advice to explain undefined treaty definitions, reporting of payments to non-participating FIs, and conditions for local client-base FIs was followed by adding explanations to the memorandum.
Advice to clarify references to foreign regulation and concepts in the explanatory memorandum was followed where it improves readability.

33994.s: The bill adds and tightens criminal offences for bankruptcy fraud in the Penal Code, including failure to provide information, failure to keep records, and excessive spending or asset removal before or during bankruptcy. It also extends pre-trial detention eligibility to these offences in the Code of Criminal Procedure and aligns the Economic Offences Act accordingly.
33994.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as needed to enable effective investigation of bankruptcy fraud and to close a legal inequality in punishing materially similar conduct.
q: To increase the possibilities for investigating these criminal offences, the offences of articles 340, 342, 344a, 344b and 347(1) of the Penal Code have been included in article 67 of the Code of Criminal Procedure as offences for which pre-trial detention can be applied.

Teneinde de mogelijkheden tot opsporing van deze strafbare feiten te vergroten zijn de misdrijven van de artikelen 340, 342, 344a, 344b en 347, eerste lid, Sr in artikel 67 Sv opgenomen als misdrijf waarvoor voorlopige hechtenis kan worden toegepast.
p: Extends pre-trial detention and special investigative powers to the new and amended bankruptcy fraud offences, expanding prosecutorial and investigative discretion.

parties: Warns that criminal liability for unreasonable but commercially normal risky conduct must not be created, and asks about the nemo tenetur implications of the information duty.
They wish to stress once more that this must not result in criminalising conduct that is risky but not unreasonable within commercial trade and business practice.

Wel willen zij nogmaals onderstrepen dat dit niet mag uitmonden in het strafbaar stellen van gedragingen die weliswaar risicovol zijn, maar binnen het commerciële handelsverkeer en een bepaalde bedrijfsvoering niet onredelijk zijn
Supports an effective approach to bankruptcy fraud but asks where lawful restructuring ends and criminal conduct begins and whether the penalty should be raised for dumping staff or creditors.
They strongly support an effective approach to bankruptcy fraud and see the present bill as an important further step.
Zij zijn groot voorstander van een effectieve aanpak van faillissementsfraude en zien het nu voorliggend wetsvoorstel als een belangrijke verdere stap daarin.
Asks whether curators and prosecutors will have sufficient money and capacity, and how proportionality and prosecutorial discretion operate.
These members share the government's view that a curator must have sufficient powers to be able to detect bankruptcy fraud.
Deze leden delen de mening van de regering dat een curator voldoende bevoegdheden moet hebben om faillissementsfraude te kunnen signaleren.

Questions the removal of the requirement of actual creditor prejudice and the Supreme Court's case law on conditional intent, and raises concerns about the evidentiary difficulty of judging mismanagement and about the Estro case.
They ask about the legal possibilities as well as the financial-economic and political desirability of separating these two in the proposed way.
Deze leden vragen naar de juridische mogelijkheden maar ook de financieel-economische en politieke wenselijkheden om deze twee op de voorgestelde wijze van elkaar te scheiden.
Asks whether the new wording requiring actual creditor prejudice will make the offence less often applicable, and how curators' willingness to report fraud will be increased.
Therefore the members ask how the willingness of the curator to file reports will be increased.
Daarom vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden hoe de aangiftebereidheid van de curator verhoogd gaat worden

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill reforming bankruptcy fraud criminal provisions but raises concerns about the undefined 'endangering continuity' element of new article 347 Sr, the coherence with the related curator and bankruptcy-law bills and the nemo tenetur (self-incrimination) issue, and the capacity for investigating and prosecuting bankruptcy fraud. The minister's reply amends the explanatory memorandum to clarify the criterion, limits use of compelled information for prosecution, and describes capacity and chain-approach measures.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not explain when the element 'continuity of the company is endangered' is met; the minister added clarification that a substantial risk of bankruptcy or outside intervention suffices.

Use of compelled information from the bankrupt under the information duty raises self-incrimination concerns; the minister now restricts such information to the bankruptcy process except in cases of false or incomplete statements.

Coherence with the related bills on curator position and the bestuursverbod is hard for outside advisers to assess; the minister states the coherence is sufficiently ensured and that advisers could consider the combined inputs.

Effectiveness depends on police and prosecution capacity and expertise; the minister describes extra investigative capacity, prioritisation agreements and a chain approach, which the Afdeling considered useful but not sufficient.
Editorial remark that the explanatory memorandum should also refer to article 47 of the EU Charter when EU law is implemented.

34000-VII.s: This is the 2015 Dutch budget act (Rijksbegrotingswet) that formally fixes the departmental expenditure and revenue budget for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and the operating budgets of agencies such as the Basisadministratie Persoonsgegevens en Reisdocumenten. It also sets out the ministry's policy plans and the parliamentary commitments attached to them, with the explanatory memorandum covering the Agenda Stad, a consultative referendum, constitutional revisions and oversight of the intelligence services.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this act for the year 2015 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34085-III.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of General Affairs, adjusting appropriations and receipts across its policy article for the general government policy unit. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force as 1 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the 2014 budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken voor het jaar 2014

34399.s: The bill adds a paragraph to article 9 of the Zorgverzekeringswet allowing health insurers to provide the health insurance policy and proof of it electronically instead of in writing, departing from the Civil Code requirement, unless the policyholder or insured objects. In that case the insurer must provide the documents in writing free of charge.
34399.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a simplification of providing health insurance policies electronically, while noting that the written-proof obligation aims to let policyholders always have a written record of the contract.
q: Notwithstanding article 156a, second paragraph, of the Civil Code, the health insurer may provide the policy and the proof referred to in the second paragraph in a form other than writing

In afwijking van artikel 156a, tweede lid, van het Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering kan de zorgverzekeraar de zorgpolis en het in het tweede lid bedoelde bewijs op een andere wijze dan bij geschrift verschaffen

parties: Asks whether DigiD should be mandatory for insurers' online portals, what safeguards exist for third-party access, and how vulnerable groups such as elderly and low-literate people will be informed.
Positive about the change but insists on guaranteeing access to paper policies, no extra conditions or costs for requesting paper, and questions the fraud risk of emailed PDF policies.
They think policyholders should be able to make a free choice here and that insurers should not impose any conditions when requesting a paper policy.
Zij vinden dat verzekeringnemers hier een vrije keuze in zouden moeten mogen maken en dat door zorgverzekeraars geen voorwaarden opgeworpen zouden mogen worden.
Opposes opt-out approach, fearing the health system becomes opaque for low-skilled citizens; demands opt-in, no surcharges for paper, and a rigorous cost-savings justification.
They are of the view that the default for the digital policy should remain 'electronic, provided consent is given' rather than 'electronic, unless objection'.
Zij zijn van mening dat het uitgangspunt voor wat betreft de digitale polis «elektronisch, mits toestemming» dient te blijven, in plaats van «elektronisch, tenzij bezwaar».

Questions the necessity of the change given existing opt-in, worries about weakening position of digitally less skilled insurees, asks about authenticity of PDF policies and information quality, and questions the 5-minute time-saving calculation.
They are of the view that this unnecessarily worsens the position of insurees who are insufficiently digitally skilled.
Zij zijn van mening dat hiermee de positie van verzekerden die onvoldoende digitaal vaardig zijn onnodig wordt verslechterd.
Supports digital policies voluntarily but considers making them the default a step too far; asks the government to reconsider in favour of opt-in.
They support the use of digital health policies, but making the digital policy the default seems to these members a step too far.
Zij zijn voorstander van het gebruik van digitale zorgpolissen, maar het standaard invoeren van de digitale polis lijkt deze leden een stap te ver.
Welcomes the bill as implementing a motion, supports opt-out, but asks why implementation was delayed and how the minister will ensure adequate information to insurees.
In what way will the Minister contribute to adequate information provision so that insured persons are informed of the transition from a paper to a digital policy?
Op welke wijze gaat de Minister bijdragen aan een adequate informatievoorziening, zodat verzekerden op de hoogte worden gesteld van de overgang van een papieren naar een digitale polis?
Asks for justification of the shift from opt-out to opt-in reasoning, evidence on trends, safeguards for information quality and vulnerable groups, and consultation of elderly organisations.
These members would like further substantiation of this signal.
Deze leden zouden graag een nadere onderbouwing van dit signaal willen ontvangen.
Asks for data on digital versus paper policies, savings projections, and how insurers will inform policyholders who are less digitally skilled.
Although the bill explicitly provides that a policyholder must remain able to receive a paper health policy free of charge, these members have concerns about communication to policyholders.

Hoewel in het wetsvoorstel expliciet is opgenomen dat het voor een verzekeringnemer mogelijk moet blijven kosteloos een papieren zorgpolis te ontvangen, hebben deze leden zorgen over de communicatie richting verzekeringnemers.

Doubts the savings and public support, fears access to care is undermined for people with weak digital skills, and asks about costs of qualified certificates and the involvement of private firms that lobbied for the bill.

34475-X.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (Article X) and the budget statements of the three defence operating agencies (DTO, DVD, Paresto) through technical, accounting and audit-driven adjustments. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to parliamentary, judicial or citizen oversight.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34489.s: The bill approves a 2016 Protocol and Supplementary Agreement with Morocco amending the social security convention, introducing the residence-country principle so that certain benefits are no longer exported to Morocco. The explanatory memorandum says the revision is needed because earlier residence-based rules were found by courts to conflict with the convention, and it provides a financial compensation scheme for beneficiaries.
34489.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the need to align the convention with new legislation that courts had found incompatible with the existing treaty.
q: Applying the residence-country principle under the Dutch law to beneficiaries living in Morocco could not withstand judicial review, since the treaty stands in the way.
