Het toepassen van het woonlandbeginsel op grond van de Wet woonlandbeginsel in de sociale zekerheid voor gerechtigden woonachtig in Marokko bleek de rechterlijke toets niet te kunnen doorstaan aangezien het Verdrag hieraan in de weg staat.

parties: Asks about Moroccan ratification status, timing of the Association Decision, yearly revenue effects, and entry-into-force date; prefers that payments to pre-2012 beneficiaries wait until Morocco ratifies.
Given the history, the VVD prefers that this compensation is only paid after Morocco has ratified the amendments to the Treaty and Protocol.

De leden van de VVD-fractie geven er de voorkeur aan dat, gezien de voorgeschiedenis, deze tegemoetkoming pas wordt uitgekeerd nadat de wijzigingen van het Verdrag en Protocol door Marokko zijn geratificeerd.

Asks about Moroccan parliamentary status, whether implementing agencies raised bottlenecks, the intended entry-into-force date, and how the government will respond to incorrect information spread on social media.
Has an implementation test been carried out by the implementing agencies? If so, did it reveal any bottlenecks?
Is er een uitvoeringstoets door de uitvoeringsinstanties opgesteld? Zo ja, bleken hier nog knelpunten uit?
Can agree with the amendment and asks only for the new target date, since the 1 October 2016 date was missed.
The treaty was to enter into force on 1 October 2016. That date was not met. What is the government's new target date?
Het verdrag zou ingaan per 1 oktober 2016. Deze datum is niet gehaald. Wat is de nieuwe streefdatum van de regering?

Asks whether the Moroccan parliament will approve the amendment, the timing and budget consequences of the EU-Morocco Association Decision, and why a provision on compensation for war or terrorism-related urgent care was included.
The first question these members have is whether the Moroccan parliament also approves this amendment.
De eerste vraag die deze leden hebben, is echter of het Marokkaanse parlement ook met deze wijziging instemt.

34498.s: The bill implements the 2016 Netherlands-Kosovo agreement by enabling the Kosovo Specialist Chambers to operate in the Netherlands, including arrest, surrender and transit of persons and compelled attendance of witnesses. It excludes Dutch law and habeas corpus review for detention under Specialist Chambers orders and makes the Hague district court exclusively competent for surrender requests, with no cassation appeal.
34498.j: The memorandum justifies the exclusions by treating the Specialist Chambers as a foreign-style criminal tribunal similar to those established in the Netherlands, with the surrender procedure kept short and limited to identity and jurisdiction questions.
q: Dutch law does not apply to deprivation of liberty ordered by the Specialist Chambers in premises made available to the Specialist Chambers in the Netherlands.
De Nederlandse wet is niet van toepassing op vrijheidsontneming, ondergaan op last van de Speciale Kamers binnen aan de Speciale Kamers in Nederland ter beschikking gestelde ruimten.
d: transit and transport of persons by designated Dutch officials
p: Dutch law and habeas corpus review do not apply to detention ordered by the Specialist Chambers, removing Dutch judicial protection for detainees in designated facilities.
Surrender decisions are limited to a single instance, excluding cassation, and the grounds for refusal are narrowed to the marginal test set out in the bill.
Dutch authorities may apprehend persons in the Netherlands and hand them over to the Specialist Chambers on their order, including with use of coercion.
Witnesses and experts are granted immunity from prosecution or detention in the Netherlands for prior acts, subject to a fifteen-day loss clause.
Persons without immunity before the Specialist Chambers likewise cannot claim immunity before the Dutch court or in enforcement of its decisions.

parties: The PvdA supports establishing the Kosovo Specialist Chambers in the Netherlands for justice on serious crimes and wants the implementing law to enter into force quickly.

Therefore the PvdA fractie supports the establishment of the Kosovo Specialist Chambers and Specialist Prosecutor's Office in the Netherlands and looks forward to swift entry into force of the implementing law.

Daarom ondersteunen de leden van de PvdA-fractie de vestiging van de Kosovaarse Speciale Kamers en Speciale Aanklager in Nederland en zien uit naar een spoedige inwerkingtreding van de uitvoeringswet.

34588.s: The bill replaces the Wiv 2002 with a new framework for the Dutch intelligence and security services (AIVD and MIVD), modernising their powers, notably by allowing bulk 'investigation-directed interception' of cable-bound communications, and coordination, data processing, and oversight. It adds stronger safeguards, including a new independent Toetsingscommissie inzet bevoegdheden (TIB) that must approve ministerial authorisations before certain powers are used, and binding complaint rulings by the CTIVD.
34588.j: The memorandum justifies the new interception and hacking powers by the need to detect unknown threats in the digital domain, and cites partner services' experience and European comparisons.
q: With this bill our intelligence and security services will be given the power to carry out so-called investigation-directed interception in the cable-bound domain.
Met dit wetsvoorstel krijgen onze inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten de bevoegdheid om zogenoemde onderzoeksopdrachtgerichte interceptie te verrichten in het kabelgebonden domein.
d: rules on organisation, working methods and management of the services
rules on DNA research, DNA profile processing and handling of cell material
assigning additional tasks to the CVIN by joint ministerial decision published in Staatscourant
p: Allows bulk interception of cable-bound communications for investigation-directed purposes, expanding executive discretion over surveillance of communications.
Permits services to hack into automated systems and compel decryption assistance from third parties, with ministerial authorisation.
Establishes an independent judicial-style pre-authorisation review commission whose binding opinion can void ministerial authorisations.

parties: Asks how cable interception contributes to protecting deployed soldiers and how the TIB relates to ministerial responsibility.
The VVD members wonder how research-task-oriented interception will contribute to the safety of our deployed soldiers.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af hoe onderzoeksopdrachtgerichte interceptie gaat bijdragen aan de veiligheid van onze uitgezonden militairen.
Wants statutory safeguards on bulk data handling and automated analysis as urged by the CTIVD, and stresses democratic control cannot be fully public.
Doubts the proportionality and subsidiarity of the bill and questions the lack of TIB involvement and of statutory guarantees for future data sources.
These members are not convinced that the bill in this form meets these principles.
Deze leden zijn er niet van overtuigd dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel in deze vorm aan deze uitgangspunten voldoet.
Supports modernised powers but insists expanded powers be matched by expanded rights safeguards and adequate oversight; asks about budget and the coordinator's role.
The CDA members endorse the government's premise that expanding powers must go hand in hand with expanding fundamental-rights safeguards and adequate oversight.

De leden van de CDA-fractie onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van de regering dat uitbreiding van bevoegdheden gepaard dient te gaan met uitbreiding van grondrechtelijke waarborgen en adequaat toezicht.
Applies a 'no, unless' principle to new powers, demands transparency on interception statistics and warns against NSA-style bulk practices.
For these members the starting point is that the services are equipped with adequate powers that go no further than necessary and that these are balanced with the safeguards opposite them.
Voor deze leden staat voorop dat de diensten met adequate bevoegdheden zijn uitgerust, die niet verder gaan dan noodzakelijk, en dat deze in balans zijn met de waarborgen die daar tegenover staan.
Accepts new powers may be needed but warns techno-neutral drafting could stretch powers beyond what legislators foresaw and asks how the Chamber will be informed.
They acknowledge that new powers may be necessary.
Zij erkennen dat nieuwe bevoegdheden noodzakelijk kunnen zijn.
Not yet convinced each new power is necessary and proportionate; objects to large-scale interception of communications of uninvolved citizens and requests BIT review.

At the same time these members note that the bill grants the security services far-reaching powers that allow them to intercept on a large scale the communications of Dutch citizens against whom there is no suspicion.

Tegelijkertijd constateren deze leden dat in dit wetsvoorstel verregaande bevoegdheden aan de veiligheidsdiensten worden toegekend, die het hen mogelijk maken om op grote schaal communicatie van Nederlandse burgers waar geen verdenking op rust, af te luisteren.
Asks for clarity on the coordinator's role, the status of the explanatory memorandum and how safeguards against misuse are ensured.
These members find it important that this act pays attention both to rule-of-law safeguards and to protecting the security of our society.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat er in deze wet zowel aandacht is voor de waarborgen van de rechtsstaat als voor de bescherming van de veiligheid van onze samenleving.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the draft Dutch intelligence services act (Wet op de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten), finding the bulk interception powers justified but the supervision system ineffective and the three-year retention period for unexamined data doubtful under the ECHR, recommending dropping the TIB pre-authorisation body and concentrating oversight in the CTIVD. The minister's reply rejects the recommendation to drop the TIB, argues the TIB and CTIVD have distinct roles, and explains why the three-year retention period is justified.
concerns: Bulk and big-data collection raises proportionality concerns under ECHR Article 8, with serious doubts about the three-year retention period for unexamined data; the government justifies the period by historical analysis needs.

The TIB pre-authorisation body risks an alibi function and undermines ministerial responsibility; the advisory division advises dropping it and concentrating oversight in the CTIVD, which the government rejects.
The oversight system as a whole is not effective enough and fragmented between TIB and CTIVD; the government contends the two bodies have distinct, complementary roles.

The advisory division considers binding complaint handling by the CTIVD too absolute a requirement and advises keeping the existing complaints arrangement with the ombudsman; the government instead introduced binding complaint handling.

34597.s: The bill amends the Wet kinderopvang and the quality rules for peuterspeelzalen to harmonise childcare and playgroup quality standards, add pedagogical policy staff and higher-education qualifications in preschool education, and clarify the mayor's power to withdraw operating permits from childcare centres, childminding agencies and playgroups. Most quality rules are shifted to lower regulation (AMvB) with parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang).
34597.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegations to lower regulation as allowing concretisation of pedagogical quality norms that must keep pace with social views, with a parliamentary pre-consultation procedure attached.
d: quality conditions for childcare, pedagogical staff, qualifications
further rules on aspects of responsible childcare
categories of preschool educators and their qualification and training requirements
categories of preschool educators and their qualification and training requirements for playgroups
calculation year and continued childcare allowance after end of employment
further rules on removal of childcare centres from the register
further rules on removal of playgroups from the register
p: Municipal authorities (college) may withdraw operating permits for childcare centres and playgroups where operation no longer complies with rules, clarifying an existing discretionary power.
Removes the first paragraph of the provision and makes 'Onze Minister' references also cover the college, altering who processes registration data.

parties: Asks for justification of the bill's necessity, timing of parliamentary involvement in lower-level regulation, financial and regulatory burden effects, and whether inspection will remain proportionate to tailored care.
The VVD members wish to ask the government for further justification of the necessity of this bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen de regering een nadere onderbouwing vragen bij de noodzaak van onderhavig wetsvoorstel.

Asks how the Gunning commission recommendations are being implemented, how the quality requirements leave room for tailored care without compromising safety, and how cost and regulatory burden will be monitored during lower-level regulation.
The PvdA members finally request the government to make clear what effect this law has on anchoring the Gunning commission's recommendations, whether better or not.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie verzoeken de regering tenslotte om inzichtelijk te maken wat het effect van deze wet is op het – al dan niet beter – verankeren van de aanbevelingen van de commissie Gunning.
Supports the bill as underlining the importance of quality childcare for child development.
The members are of the view that this proposal underlines the importance of quality childcare.](/)
De leden zijn van mening dat dit voorstel het belang van kwalitatief goede opvang onderstreept.

Objects to removing the possibility of using volunteers at playgroups and out-of-school care, citing higher costs for municipalities not compensated; asks whether existing rules were reviewed for superfluous requirements.
They therefore object to removing the possibility of using (partly) volunteers at playgroups and out-of-school care.
Zij hebben dan ook bezwaar tegen het schrappen van de mogelijkheid om (deels) vrijwilligers bij peuterspeelzalen en buitenschoolse opvang in te zetten.

Asks for per-recommendation account of the Gunning commission follow-up, requests a careful follow-up process with stakeholder involvement in lower regulation, and asks about vaccination-related information and whether daycare may refuse unvaccinated children.
Given that many matters still have to be laid down, the members see a great interest in a careful follow-up process.
Gezien het feit dat veel zaken nog vast gelegd moeten worden, zien de leden een groot belang bij een zorgvuldig vervolgproces.

Criticises broad delegation to lower regulation for the definition of responsible childcare and the mentor role, which they say is a fundamental choice that should be in the law itself; questions the pedagogical mandate exceeding legal basis and the mandatory pedagogical staff role.
In the view of these members, this concerns a fundamental choice that cannot be laid down solely on the basis of lower regulation.
Naar het oordeel van deze leden betreft dit een fundamentele keuze die niet enkel op basis van lagere regelgeving kan worden vervat.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet innovatie en kwaliteit kinderopvang, urging a reasoned justification for equalising quality standards for kinderopvang and peuterspeelzaalwerk, compensation for municipalities, and a concrete, consensus-compatible definition of the pedagogical aim of transmitting generally accepted values and norms. The minister's nader rapport explains the harmonisation rationale, argues the financial impact is covered by federal savings, and adopts a revised formulation of the pedagogical aim, while rejecting additional compensation and removing some technical provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a reasoned justification of why identical quality standards are needed for kinderopvang and peuterspeelzaalwerk given their different aims; the minister explains the shared 2-4 age group and pedagogical mission but does not fully accept the difference in purpose.

The Afdeling asked how municipalities will be compensated for the abolition of formative volunteer deployment and higher quality costs; the minister argues federal savings cover it, while adding text on budget relationships.

The Afdeling asked that the vague pedagogical aim of transmitting generally accepted values and norms be concretised so it is workable yet does not impose contested norms; the minister proposes a concrete formulation in the AMvB with explanation in the nota van toelichting.
The Afdeling noted the transitional discrepancy with the harmonisation bill abolishing peuterspeelzaalwerk; the memorie van toelichting was supplemented to explain the parallel tracks.

34669.s: The bill sets the entry into force of the 2015 Act approving the EU-Euratom-Ukraine Association Agreement to coincide with the entry into force of this bill, which itself enters into force the day after Staatsblad publication. It is a short timing bill implementing the obligation under the Consultative Referendum Act to submit a bill regulating entry into force after a rejecting referendum result.
34669.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as a necessary implementation of the obligation under the Consultative Referendum Act to submit a bill regulating entry into force after a rejecting advisory outcome.
q: By submitting this bill regulating the entry into force of the approval act, the obligation in Article 11 of the Consultative Referendum Act is implemented.
Met de indiening van dit wetsvoorstel houdende regeling van de inwerkingtreding van de goedkeuringswet wordt uitvoering gegeven aan de verplichting in artikel 11 van de Wet raadgevend referendum

parties: Asks whether Ukraine accepted the declaration and how it fits the Raad van State's view that the declaration is not legally binding on Ukraine.
The government states that, strictly speaking, the legal binding force of the decision does not extend to Ukraine.
De regering meldt dat strikt genomen de juridische verbindendheid van het besluit zich niet uitstrekt tot Oekraïne.
Supports the agreement and asks the government to justify the four elements of the declaration and the choice of form.
Can the government again justify as fully as possible why this form was chosen (a decision attached to the treaty), and what the options were?
Kan de regering nogmaals zo uitgebreid mogelijk onderbouwen waarom voor deze vorm is gekozen (besluit bij het verdrag), en wat de opties hieromtrent waren?
Argues the referendum no must be respected, that the declaration does not change the treaty, and that corruption concerns remain unaddressed; wants a withdrawal law.
As far as the SP members are concerned, no remains no, and a withdrawal bill should have been sent to the House as soon as possible after the result.
Wat de leden van de SP-fractie betreft blijft nee derhalve dan ook nee, en had er na de uitslag zo spoedig mogelijk een intrekkingswet naar de Kamer gestuurd moeten worden.
Questions the government's claims about the declaration's effect, the basis for the referendum concerns, Ukraine's acceptance, and the Brexit and corruption implications, demanding documents.
The CDA members therefore request the government's confirmation that Ukraine has not accepted this declaration and that it therefore does not bind Ukraine in any way.
Graag ontvangen zij van de regering dan ook de bevestiging dat Oekraïne deze verklaring niet aanvaard heeft en dat deze Oekraïne dus op geen enkele wijze bindt.
Objects that the bill ignores the valid referendum result and asks whether Ukraine's EU membership ambitions contradict the declaration.
Do you consider it normal to completely ignore a valid referendum result?
Vindt u het volledig negeren van een geldige uitslag van een referendum «normaal»?
Welcomes the declaration's clarifications and asks for elaboration on Vienna Convention acceptance and the binding effect on member states.
Can the government confirm that this decision binds the European member states to an interpretation of the treaty?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat dit besluit de Europese lidstaten bindt aan een interpretatie van het verdrag?
Critical of the delay in process, questions what the declaration adds if it changes nothing, and asks about Ukraine's non-acceptance.
Can the government explain the added value of a declaration that substantively changes nothing in the agreement and also does not constitute a reservation to it?
Kan de regering toelichten wat de meerwaarde is van een verklaring die inhoudelijk niets verandert aan de overeenkomst en ook geen voorbehoud vormt ten aanzien van de overeenkomst?
Rejects the bill outright, arguing the democratic referendum result must not be ignored and calling for a withdrawal law.
The democratic voice of the Dutch population must not be ignored.
De democratische stem van de Nederlandse bevolking mag niet worden genegeerd.

The CDA asks the government to answer its numbered questions on the scope of the declaration, its legal effect under the Vienna Convention, and whether Ukraine accepted it, pressing for accountability to parliament.
These members have the impression that the government has overlooked a large number of questions.
Deze leden hebben de indruk dat de regering een groot aantal vragen over het hoofd gezien heeft.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum to the bill regulating entry into force of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement approval act needed clarification on the legal nature and legal significance of the 15 December 2016 European Council decision, particularly since Ukraine was not a party to it. The government's reply states the memorandum has been supplemented on these points, referring to the Council legal adviser's view that the decision neither changes the agreement nor constitutes a reservation.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must clarify the legal nature of the 15 December 2016 decision given that Ukraine did not adopt it, including whether Ukraine recognised it as an instrument under Article 31(2)(b) of the Vienna Convention.
The memorandum must be more explicit about what the decision legally does and does not mean, and the Afdeling asks it to be supplemented accordingly.

34678.s: The bill converts the associate degree from a programme within a hbo bachelor programme into an independent associate degree programme with its own profile, and adjusts the WHW, student finance and related laws accordingly. It also sets transitional rules for existing Ad-programmes and student finance entitlements.
34678.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated ministerial and royal decree rules as technical implementation of the new associate degree, such as admission requirements and degree titles, to be set in regulations.
d: approval of partial delivery of associate degree by MBO institutions
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel AA (artikel 7.10a WHW, derde lid)
designation of degree addition in ministerial regulation
admission and study choice procedures for associate degree
ARTIKEL II, onderdeel N (artikel 12.1b Wet studiefinanciering 2000)
transitional student finance rules by royal decree timing
timing of transitional arrangements by royal decree
entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article

parties: Asks how the associate degree relates to the bachelor pathway and about accreditation and governance details, without raising checks on executive power.
How can a mbo student know whether to start a hbo bachelor or an associate degree?
Hoe kan een mbo-student weten of hij aan een hbo-bachelor of associate degree moet beginnen?
Asks how programme quality is safeguarded through the new-programme and macro-efficiency tests and whether dropping the requirement to demonstrate labour-market functions weakens the review.
Does dropping this requirement not unintentionally ensure that the associate degree does not get a full independent character, the members ask.
Zorgt het loslaten van deze eis er niet onbedoeld voor dat de associate degree juist niet een volwaardig eigenstandig karakter krijgt, zo vragen de leden.
Supports the associate degree but asks how employers will be informed and whether too much selection at entry should be avoided.
Does the government agree that it is undesirable to apply too much selection to associate degree programmes given the need to stimulate progression between mbo and hbo, they ask.

Is de regering het met de leden eens dat het onwenselijk is om teveel selectie toe te passen op associate degree-opleidingen gezien de noodzaak om doorstroom tussen het mbo en hbo te stimuleren, zo vragen zij.
Asks whether the Minister must give weighty reasons to depart from the new commission's advice and whether the Chamber must be informed in writing of such a decision.
Does the Minister intend, in case of such a decision, to inform the Chamber in writing of the decision and the reasoning, as well as the commission's advice.
Is de Minister voornemens om bij een dergelijk besluit de Kamer schriftelijk te informeren over het besluit en de argumentatie bij dat besluit, als ook het advies van de commissie.
Asks about risks of perverse selection by universities and about student financing and age limits for lifelong-learning credit.
Does the government consider such a state of affairs a perverse effect?
Vindt de regering een dergelijke gang van zaken een pervers effect?
Welcomes the bill and asks about projected growth, labour-market links and why employer and union organisations were not consulted earlier.
Why was the bill not also submitted earlier to employer organisations and trade unions and only discussed with education organisations?
Waarom werd het wetsvoorstel niet eerder ook voorgelegd aan werkgeversorganisaties en vakbonden en alleen met onderwijsorganisaties besproken?
Asks about the labour-market value of the associate degree, progression to hbo, and budget and tuition consequences.
Does the government see the associate degree as a separate diploma of great value on the labour market or as a preparatory stage for hbo?
Ziet de regering de associate degree als afzonderlijk diploma met grote waarde op de arbeidsmarkt of als vooropleiding tot het hbo?

Questions the composition and expertise requirements of the new advisory commission, its scope beyond equal treatment, and the absence of a stated standard for departing from its advice, and whether the Awb applies.
In the view of these members some clarification from the standpoint of due care would be obvious.
Naar het oordeel van deze leden zou enige duiding vanuit het oogpunt van zorgvuldigheid voor de hand liggen.

34687.s: The bill amends the Trade Register Act 2007, the Civil Code and the Chamber of Commerce Act to strengthen legal certainty and register quality, including grounds for dissolving legal entities, a new employment-count indicator, LEI identifiers, and expanded access to register data for public bodies. It delegates several matters, such as the authorisation to query data by natural persons, to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
34687.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of data-access authority to an AMvB by the long lead time needed to add bodies by statute, while noting the Bibob-based purpose limitation and case-by-case review remain.
q: This means a lengthy process, in which it is not possible to respond quickly to the need to add a public body to the list of authorised bodies.
Dit betekent een langdurig proces, waarbij niet snel ingespeeld kan worden op de behoefte om een bestuursorgaan aan de lijst van de geautoriseerde instanties toe te voegen.
d: rules on compiling and recording the employment-count indicator
designation of public bodies authorised to query data by natural persons
registration of subunits of public-law legal persons
rules on bodies paying fees for register data access by subscription
designation of bodies with access to recorded bans and dismissals
temporary designation of bodies exempt from the notification duty for non-authentic data
Artikel II, onderdeel F (artikel 16b lid 1 en LEI-tarief)
fees for LEI issuance and renewal
p: Authority to grant public bodies access to data on natural persons moves from statute to a general administrative order, lowering the bar for widening access to personal data.
The Chamber of Commerce may dissolve legal entities on objective grounds, with notice, objection and appeal available under the General Administrative Law Act.
Court-imposed director bans and dismissals are recorded in the register and remain accessible to designated bodies for eight years after the ban expires.
Fees become due without a formal decision and the Chamber may enforce payment by a dwangbevel.

parties: Asks whether organs must report inaccuracies in data, the meaning of 'gerede twijfel', and what the KvK can do when a body does not report, with a procedural time limit requested.
These members ask what the definition of this term is.
Deze leden vragen wat de definitie is van dit begrip.
Asks which bodies (FIOD or other investigative services) take over from KvK supervision to detect and intervene in malafide conduct, and when KvK passes signals to supervisors.

Can the government indicate what role the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service (FIOD) or another special investigative service has in detecting and, where necessary, intervening alongside KvK supervision?

Kan de regering aangeven welke rol er voor de Fiscale inlichtingen- en opsporingsdienst (FIOD) dan wel enige andere bijzondere opsporingsdienst is om naast en in aanvulling op het toezicht van de KvK op te sporen en zo nodig in te grijpen?
Stresses that government information should be as freely accessible as possible for democratic control and business use, questioning the database right reserved to the KvK.
They are of the view that reuse of government information must be as freely accessible as possible because of democratic control.
Zij zijn van mening dat hergebruik van overheidsinformatie zo vrij mogelijk toegankelijk moet zijn vanwege democratische controle
Argues that free, machine-readable company data would help expose misconduct such as tax avoidance and evasion and that citizens and firms currently pay twice for the register.
Moreover, citizens and businesses currently pay twice for the trade register.
Bovendien betalen burgers en bedrijven nu dubbel aan het handelsregister
Asks how the price of register extracts relates to KvK costs and to comparable countries, and how the bill contributes to an open register.
ask the government how the price of information requested from the trade register (copies or extracts) relates to the costs incurred by the KvK.
vragen de regering hoe de prijs van uit het handelsregister opgevraagde informatie (afschriften of uittreksels) zich verhoudt tot de door de KvK gemaakte kosten.
Wants the government to justify omitting a prior-consultation (voorhang) procedure for the related general administrative orders, so Parliament stays involved.
These members attach importance to the involvement of the Chamber and ask for a reasoned consideration of eventually applying a prior-consultation procedure after all.
Deze leden hechten aan betrokkenheid van de Kamer en vragen om een met argumenten onderbouwde afweging om te zijner tijd toch een voorhangprocedure toe te passen.
Asks for transparency on the Chamber of Commerce's cost-recovery and return-on-investment calculations and suggests independent legal advice on whether database rights apply.
These members note that if the Chamber of Commerce wishes to claim this, it must be shown that the Chamber made a substantial investment in developing the Trade Register.

Deze leden merken op dat, indien de Kamer van Koophandel aanspraak hierop wil maken, aangetoond moet worden dat de Kamer van Koophandel een substantiële investering heeft gedaan in het ontwikkelen van het Handelsregister.
Questions whether privacy can be protected if data are opened, and asks for transparency on Chamber of Commerce revenues and costs.
Does the government maintain that there is no way at all to meet the wish to protect privacy if the data are made open?
Houdt de regering vol dat er op geen enkele manier aan de wens om de privacy te beschermen kan worden voldaan als de data wordt opengesteld?
Asks for a breakdown of Chamber of Commerce product revenues by public and private users and for comparisons with other countries' open register data.
These members ask the government to indicate which countries make their trade register data freely accessible in a machine-readable open format.
Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven welke landen hun handelsregistergegevens vrij toegankelijk maken in een open voor machines uitleesbare vorm.
Highlights the tension between financing the Chamber of Commerce's public tasks and making register data freely available, and asks for insight into financing and foregone benefits.

They therefore believe there is a tension between, on the one hand, the wish to finance the Chamber of Commerce's public tasks and, on the other, the wish to make trade register data freely available.

Zij zijn daarom van mening dat er een spanning zit tussen enerzijds de wens om de publieke taken van de Kamer van Koophandel te financieren en anderzijds de wens om de data van het handelsregister gratis beschikbaar te stellen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the Handelsregisterwet amendment bill but asked for changes: the new dissolution ground for non-residence at the registered address was too vague for the Chamber of Commerce to verify, and shortened dissolution deadlines lacked justification. The minister's reply adopted the revised wording 'niet of niet meer bereikbaar gebleken' for the address ground, deferred the shortened deadlines pending a Justice ministry study, and addressed the other technical points.
concerns: The new dissolution ground based on non-residence at the registered address is ambiguous and not easily verifiable, so the Afdeling asked for revision; the minister reworded it to 'not or no longer reachable at the registered address'.
The shortened deadlines for dissolution procedures and cure periods lack a substantive justification and may have serious fiscal consequences; the minister deferred the change pending further study.
The Besluit SUWI must be amended to allow UWV to supply employment-relationship data to the Chamber of Commerce, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The use of the term 'bestuursorgaan' is inconsistent; the explanatory memorandum was extended to justify limiting the authentic-data obligations to a-organen.
Editorial comments were adopted, including removal of an article in connection with the withdrawal of another bill.

34768.s: The bill amends several Dutch health-sector statutes to accompany the introduction of the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders, repealing the admission (toelating) regime and the visie/beleidsregels chapters of the Wet toelating zorginstellingen while keeping a ban on profit-making for certain institutions. It moves supervision of financial transparency, annual reporting and the profit ban from the IGZ to the NZa, and adds rules on financial derivatives and annual accounts in the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg.
34768.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detail on financial transparency, derivatives and annual reporting that matches existing NZa financial-economic supervision, with the ministerial rules to follow existing WFZ conditions and Ministry of Finance policy.
d: Artikel II, C (artikel 40a, eerste lid Wmg)
categories of care providers required to set out financial management responsibilities
Artikel II, C (artikel 40a, derde lid Wmg)
which financial derivatives care providers may take on, for what purposes and conditions
Artikel II, C (artikel 40b, eerste lid Wmg)
categories of care providers obliged to publish an annual accountability report
Artikel II, C (artikel 40b, derde lid Wmg)
content and form of annual accounts, required audit and publication method
persons designated by ministerial decision to supervise compliance with the law
requirements on availability and accessibility of emergency care, varying by provider category
p: Artikel I, E and D (repeal of toelating and winstoogmerk provisions)
Repeals the admission and building-procedure regime of the WTZi, removing an existing licensing check on institutions and shifting some supervisory functions administratively.
Artikel II, B and D (artikel 78e Wmg)
Gives the NZa power to issue binding directions to institutions on the profit ban and to enforce them with orders under administrative coercion or penalty payments.}],

parties: Asks whether the NZa can impose fines for the profit-making ban, whether it can reclaim improperly distributed profits, and what the ministerial rules on derivatives will contain, raising enforcement and oversight gaps.

The CDA members ask whether it is correct that the NZa, when enforcing the profit-making ban, can impose an instruction, an order under administrative coercion or a penalty payment, but cannot impose fines.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of het klopt dat de NZa bij de handhaving van het verbod op winstoogmerk wel een aanwijzing, last onder bestuursdwang of last onder dwangsom kan opleggen, maar geen boetes kan opleggen.

Worries that splitting supervision between the IGJ and NZa may cause misses, asks how the two bodies will cooperate, and requests a ban on existing risky derivatives and clarity on oversight of subsidiaries.
The SP members ask the government why supervision of institutions is now being fragmented.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering waarom het toezicht op instellingen nu wordt versnipperd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division gave an unfavourable opinion on the third amendment note to the Wtza and Awtza, questioning the added value and administrative burden of extending the notification duty to subcontractors and youth-care providers and of extending transparency requirements, and advised reconsidering the proposals. The minister's nader rapport rejects most objections, arguing the measures improve information positions of the IGJ and NZa and are justified, while adding clarifications to the explanatory notes.
concerns: The Afdeling questions the added value of extending the notification duty to subcontractors, since IGJ supervision targets the main contractor, and the government maintains the information gain justifies it.

The Afdeling finds the extended transparency requirements unjustified given the administrative burden and unchanged NZa supervision; the government disagrees but adds justification and proportionality safeguards.

The Afdeling objects that uncertainty over which provider categories will be exempted by AMvB makes assessing necessity, effectiveness and feasibility impossible; the explanatory notes were supplemented with the main categories intended for exemption.

The Afdeling asks whether the amendments are still necessary given the further measures announced in the 9 July 2019 letter; the government says they fit within the Wtza and Awtza and do not harm predictability.
The Afdeling's comments on the explanatory notes were addressed by supplementing the notes and correcting the Wet normering topinkomens citation and the term jaarrekening.

34786.s: This bill makes a large set of technical and fiscal amendments to Dutch tax and related laws for 2018, including changes to the treatment of foster children, tax exemptions, payroll and corporate tax rules, excise and motor vehicle taxes, and collection rules. It also postpones the sunset dates of several temporary tax provisions and gives the tax authorities new powers, such as wider inspection access for excise audits and a changed procedure for garnishment and fiscal objection.
34786.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to the need for technical repairs, postponement of sunset dates pending evaluation, and the need for effective control of tax data and reduction of abusive fiscal objection.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 3.13, eerste lid, onderdeel i, Wet IB 2001)
conditions for exemption of sewage sludge incineration
collection by decision instead of writ for garnishment
manner of notification to pledgees and third parties
p: The tax collector may enforce garnishment more easily and the automatic suspension of fiscal objection proceedings is removed, reducing citizens' and courts' protection against collection.
Artikel XXI (Invorderingswet 1990, artikel 22bis) and Artikel XXII (artikel 19)
Third-party garnishment can be imposed by decision without a prior executorial bailiff step, with a 7-day notice requirement in limited cases.
Artikel XV, onderdeel B (artikel 83 Wet op de accijns)
The excise inspector may examine all parts of buildings except dwellings and all land, not only excise goods premises.
The receiver may withhold payment of advances or allowances from persons classified as departees to join terrorist organisations.

parties: Asks about legal certainty and retroactive effect of several measures, including the pseudo-eindheffing and liquidation loss rules.
Why does this proposal not take effect retroactively from 1 January 2017?
Waarom gaat dit voorstel niet in met terugwerkende kracht tot 1 januari 2017?

Worries that the marital-asset gift tax rule and navorderingsregels are overbroad, reduce legal certainty and may catch legitimate arrangements; questions abolition of suspensive effect and the inkeerregeling.
These members find the immediate effect a heavy measure, since the reduction may already have taken place before 1 January 2018 and the reassessment period may have expired.
Deze leden vinden de onmiddellijke werking een zwaar middel, aangezien de vermindering dan al voor 1 januari 2018 heeft plaatsgevonden en de navorderingstermijn al verstreken kan zijn.

Asks whether expanded Tax Authority powers to access anti-money-laundering information and the relationship with individuals conflict with privacy and the right to legal privilege in a constitutional state.
They ask to what extent this expansion of powers is at odds with our constitutional state, for example regarding the right to privacy and legal professional privilege.
Zij vragen in hoeverre deze uitbreiding van de bevoegdheden op gespannen voet staat met onze rechtsstaat, bijvoorbeeld aangaande het recht op privacy en op het verschoningsrecht.
Welcomes the solution for foster-child partner status and the changes to gift and inheritance tax.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the proposed unlimited extension of the simplified third-party garnishment procedure for tax collection be restricted to concretely described, frequently occurring cases, and questioned the 1 January 2018 entry-into-force date given the tax authority's 2019 feasibility estimate. The government declined to restrict the scope, arguing efficiency gains and unchanged protection for garnishees, but accepted the change of entry-into-force to 1 January 2019.
concerns: The unlimited extension of simplified third-party garnishment is insufficiently motivated and should be restricted to frequently occurring, concretely described cases; the government rejected this and kept the broad scope for efficiency reasons.
The 1 January 2018 entry-into-force date conflicts with the tax authority's feasibility estimate of 1 January 2019; the government adjusted the date to 2019.

34795.s: The bill implements two EU regulations on matrimonial property regimes and property consequences of registered partnerships in the Netherlands, mainly by designating the kort geding judge as competent authority for enforcement declarations and setting appeal routes. It also amends Book 10 of the Civil Code to remove provisions now covered by the EU regulations.
34795.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to implement the EU regulations and says the procedures follow existing practice without new delegated powers.
q: This bill implements the EU regulations of the Council of 24 June 2016.
Dit wetsvoorstel geeft uitvoering aan de verordeningen (EU) van de Raad van 24 juni 2016

parties: Asks about transitional law for couples married before the cut-off date, the relation to the Hague treaty denunciation bill, and the clarity of which regime applies.
They have some questions about the transitional law and some legislative-technical questions.
Zij hebben enkele vragen over het overgangsrecht en enkele wetstechnische vragen.
Welcomes legal certainty but questions the choice of national law for multiple nationalities, party autonomy and the non-automatic change of choice of law, which may create uncertainty.
These members ask whether this does not run directly counter to the desire for uniformity that the regulation aims for and leads to more legal uncertainty?
Deze leden vragen of dit niet juist haaks staat op de wens tot uniformiteit die de verordening wil bereiken en leidt tot meer rechtsonzekerheid?

Raises concerns about the public order exception limited by the EU Charter, possible unequal treatment of same-sex couples, the layering of four international private law sources, and retroactivity of choice of law.
Does the government share the view of the D66 members that people's legal certainty is therefore not paramount, all the more because parties will assume retroactive effect?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de D66-fractie dat de rechtszekerheid van mensen hierdoor niet voorop staat, te meer omdat partijen van terugwerkende kracht uit zullen gaan?

Worried that cooperation and jurisdictional alignment not encroach on member states' own competences; asks whether recognition of same-sex couples could be forced against national law and what consequences follow.
Does this nonetheless mean an important substantive interference in the national law of the member states?
Betekent dit toch een belangrijke inhoudelijke inmenging in het nationale recht van de lidstaten?

34858.s: The bill replaces the 2010 Wet medezeggenschap cliënten zorginstellingen with a new law strengthening client participation in care institutions through tiered councils, extended advice and consent rights, funding, a dispute commission, and public supervision by the IGJ replacing court-based enforcement. It also amends several related laws (Jeugdwet, Wzd, Wvggz, Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders) to align with it.
34858.j: The memorandum justifies the amvb power by saying some forms of care and institution types do not fit the participation model, so exclusion must be possible by general administrative order.
q: This bill therefore allows, via a general administrative order (amvb), these forms of care and categories of institutions to be excluded from the obligations of this law.
Dit wetsvoorstel kent derhalve de mogelijkheid om via algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) deze vormen van zorg en categorieën van instellingen uit te sluiten van de verplichtingen van deze wet.
d: excluding forms of care or institution categories from the law
p: Institutions may not adopt decisions without client council consent unless the dispute commission grants permission, and nullity may be invoked by the council within a month.

parties: Asks how far boards may deviate from client council advice, how consent and advice rights are assessed, and how the threshold of more than ten persons was chosen.
The VVD members ask the government what the advisory right of the client council for the board of a care institution precisely entails.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering wat het adviesrecht van de cliëntenraad voor een bestuur van een zorginstelling precies inhoudt.
Asks about feasibility, overlapping jurisdiction of multiple client councils, the scope of inspraak, and whether the Raad van State's criticism was adequately answered.
These members nonetheless have a number of questions about the feasibility of the law and what can and must be expected of client council members.
Deze leden hebben echter nog wel een aantal vragen over de uitvoerbaarheid van de wet en wat van leden van de cliëntenraden allemaal verwacht kan en moet worden.
Supports the bill's aim to improve medezeggenschap but asks about representativeness of councils, the half-year threshold, and the scope of direct inspraak.
These members therefore wholeheartedly support the main aim of this law, namely improving participation by tackling existing obstacles.
Deze leden ondersteunen dan ook van harte het hoofddoel van deze wet, namelijk de verbetering van de medezeggenschap door de aanpak van de bestaande belemmeringen.
Stresses the importance of strong client participation but questions unilateral organisational control over inspraak, the treatment of small-scale care, and the lack of alignment with the Wor.
The members therefore ask how this inspraak is given shape in practice.
Derhalve vragen genoemde leden hoe deze inspraak in de praktijk wordt vormgegeven.
Finds the bill regulates medezeggenschap rather than zeggenschap, arguing clients and staff should hold decisive power and boards are hard to check; proposes an elected decision-making council.
These members therefore think it is good that a renewed bill is before the House, but they find that the proposal does not go far enough.
Deze leden vinden het daarom goed dat een vernieuwd wetsvoorstel voorligt. Zij vinden het voorstel echter niet ver genoeg gaan.
Welcomes the bill but questions its balance and support among stakeholders, lack of problem analysis, and limited room for local variety and experimentation.
At the same time, an important criticism from participation bodies is that this bill leaves little room for variety and room to experiment.
Tegelijkertijd is een belangrijk kritiekpunt vanuit medezeggenschapsorganen dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel weinig ruimte laat voor variëteit en experimenteerruimte.

Asks why the government ignored the Raad van State's fundamental criticism that formal powers will not achieve effective participation without a culture change, and asks for more variety and differentiation.
In general these members ask why the government sets aside the Raad van State's fundamental criticism on many points.
In het algemeen vragen deze leden waarom de regering de fundamentele kritiek van de Raad van State op veel onderdelen naast zich neerlegt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises against sending the Wmcz 2018 bill to parliament until its objections are addressed, arguing that expanding formal client council powers will not by itself produce effective participation, that the bill is too uniform across care types and insufficiently differentiated, and that enforcement by the IGJ should take account of lack of client interest. The government's nader rapport rejects the claim that extended powers are premature, defends the bill's differentiation options and scope, and accepts the enforcement point by adding clarifying text to the explanatory memorandum, while making several technical amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that expanding formal powers of client councils is an effective response to participation problems and advises first removing bottlenecks and cultural barriers.

The Afdeling considers the uniform application of the rules to all care types and institutions too coarse and advises better differentiation, which the government partly accepts while declining further differentiation.

The Afdeling asks that enforcement by the IGZ take into account that failure to establish a client council may reflect lack of client interest rather than institutional fault; the government adds clarification to the memorandum.

The Afdeling finds the scope too broad, since Wkkgz definitions could capture Wmo 2015 providers; the government relies on parliamentary history and a possible exemption by general administrative order.
The Afdeling's redactional comments on technical articles are incorporated in the bill.

34939.s: This bill amends numerous Dutch statutes to align them with the GDPR (AVG), replacing references to the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens with GDPR and Uitvoeringswet terms and renaming the supervisory body the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens. It also sets out where data-subject rights are restricted for electoral and referendum procedures and in the basisregistratie personen, and gives the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens supervisory powers over those processes.
34939.j: The memorandum justifies the restrictions of data-subject rights by the need for a smooth electoral process and an effective basisregistratie personen under GDPR Article 23, and the transfer of supervision to the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens as required by GDPR Article 51.
q: This bill also provides that supervision of the processing of personal data under the Kieswet is assigned to the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet er ten derde in dat het toezicht op verwerking van persoonsgegevens op grond van de Kieswet belegd wordt bij de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens.
p: Restricts data-subject rights such as rectification and restriction of processing in the electoral process, while giving the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens supervisory powers and keeping judicial remedies available under the GDPR framework.
Sets different response periods for access and rectification requests in the BRP and disapplies the GDPR right to restriction of processing for BRP records, with the restrictions stated in the law.

parties: Asks how far the GDPR's household exemption extends, including camera surveillance, and how the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens interprets it and reports on complaints.
They note that the bill, although large in scope, only makes technical changes to adapt terminology in all laws to the General Data Protection Regulation.

Zij constateren dat het wetsvoorstel, alhoewel fors van omvang, slechts technische wijzigingen doorvoert om de terminologie in alle wetten aan te passen aan de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming.

Asks how the notification duty in the basisregistratie personen will work in practice, whether it will ever occur, and how the government assesses information provision to small associations and SMEs.
Does this restriction mean that in practice notification will never take place?
Betekent deze beperking dat er in de praktijk nimmer kennisgeving zal plaatsvinden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill adapting sectoral laws to the GDPR (AVG), recommending removal of a non-neutral change breaking medical confidentiality, adding justifications and specific provisions for restrictions of data subjects' rights under Article 23 AVG, and clarifying the choice to keep the DNA Act under the GDPR. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted the main advice, deleting the medical confidentiality change and adding justifications and provisions, and adopted most drafting remarks.
concerns: Removing the statutory breach of medical confidentiality in the Wkkgz, a non-neutral change with principled weight, was accepted and the provision deleted.

Restrictions on data subjects' rights (e.g., deadlines in the Wet SUWI and Wet basisregistratie personen) required justification and specific safeguards under Article 23 AVG; some provisions were dropped or added, others only justified in the explanatory memorandum.
Numerous drafting and cross-reference corrections, consistent terminology and sharper explanatory notes were adopted.
The choice to keep the Wet DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelden under the GDPR rather than the criminal-justice data protection directive was further justified in the explanatory notes.

34957.s: The bill amends the Gas Act and Mining Act to minimise gas extraction from the Groningen field, requiring the grid operator to submit annual forecasts and the Minister to adopt binding operational extraction strategies for the field. It adds a new chapter 4A to the Mining Act giving the Minister wide powers to set, change and impose temporary measures on extraction and gas storage, with limited parliamentary involvement and some procedural restrictions on appeal.
34957.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by reference to security of supply, public safety from earthquakes and the need to reduce extraction quickly, while citing the earlier Raad van State ruling and claiming judicial protection through civil claims remains.
q: Immediately reducing extraction from the Groningen field to a lower level also brings risks to safety, because it affects security of supply.
Het onmiddellijk terugbrengen van de winning uit het Groningenveld naar een lager niveau brengt immers ook risico's voor de veiligheid met zich mee.
d: date of forecast, conversion percentage and rules on forecasting
interpretation of safety norm and categories of end users
rules on carrying out the operational strategy and measurements
further rules on proposed operational strategy and its justification
rules on annual reporting by extraction licence holder
p: The Minister alone adopts the binding operational strategy for the Groningen field and may amend it on security or supply grounds, with only advisory input from local authorities and a public comment period.
The Minister may impose temporary measures departing from the adopted strategy, including after an earthquake, without a stated procedure or limit.

Several permit and consent provisions, including the Civil Code strict-liability exception, are disapplied for the Groningen field licence holder, weakening the protection of residents against damage claims.
Security-of-supply considerations are removed as a ground for refusing consent in the Groningen context, narrowing the basis on which the Minister must refuse.
The Minister may attach conditions to, withdraw or change storage plan consent for Norg in order to minimise extraction, outside the general consent rule of art. 36."
The licence holder must carry out the strategy as set, which limits recourse by the holder against the Minister's decisions."

parties: Asks whether liability for future damage shifts from NAM to the State under the new extraction obligation, and whether GTS can carry out its new task.

These members endorse this step-by-step plan, but it raises the question whether, under the new extraction obligation, the State rather than shareholder NAM becomes responsible for future damage caused by gas extraction.

Deze leden onderschrijven dit stappenplan, maar het roept wel de vraag op of door de nieuwe winningsplicht niet langer de aandeelhouder NAM, maar de Staat verantwoordelijk is voor toekomstige schade die ontstaat bij de gaswinning.
Supports regulating the licence holder's property to secure safety, and asks how the extraction plan will be checked against the degree-day system and conversion capacity.
These members hope this will provide more clarity and thereby give residents of Groningen confidence.
Deze leden hopen dat dit meer duidelijkheid geeft en daarmee vertrouwen geeft aan de inwoners in Groningen.
Questions whether GTS advice alone is objective enough and whether independent bodies such as TNO and the Mijnraad should weigh in on the operational strategy.
The D66 members ask whether advice on supply security from Gasunie Transport Services (GTS) alone is sufficient to guarantee objectivity.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of advies over leveringszekerheid van alleen Gasunie Transport Services (GTS) voldoende is om de objectiviteit te kunnen waarborgen.
Objects to equating residents' safety with supply security for foreign buyers and to giving NAM a central role in risk analysis, arguing safety should prevail.
The SP members find it incomprehensible that the safety of Groningers is equated with the supply security of (foreign) customers.
De leden van de SP-fractie vinden het onbegrijpelijk dat de veiligheid van de Groningers gelijk wordt gesteld aan de leveringszekerheid van (buitenlandse) afnemers.
Asks how the Minister weighs the two safety components and whether physical safety of residents indeed prevails, given the Council of State's concerns.
Can the government confirm that the physical safety of Groningers takes priority?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat de fysieke veiligheid van Groningers voorop staat?
Stresses that safety of residents must come first and asks whether the duty to prevent damage and the licence holder's liability remain legally secured.
These members attach importance to the licence holder's obligation to prevent damage from mining activities and/or ground movement remaining firmly anchored in law.
Deze leden hechten aan de verplichting van de vergunninghouder om het voorkomen van schade door mijnbouwactiviteiten en/of bodembeweging wettelijk goed te blijven verankeren.
Wants safety of Groningers made central, a transparent and contestable extraction forecast, public advice rights for interest groups, and a stronger SodM enforcement role.
These members believe the bill and explanatory memorandum can be considerably improved on this point.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat de wet en de memorie van toelichting op dit punt sterk kunnen worden verbeterd.
Supports giving the Minister more powers to steer extraction given safety risks, but asks how liability for reinforcement costs is regulated.
Given the safety risks, they support the proposal to give the Minister more powers to steer gas extraction from the Groningen field.
Zij steunen gelet op de veiligheidsrisico's het voorstel om de Minister meer bevoegdheden te geven om de gaswinning vanuit het Groningenveld te sturen.
Asks whether the liability constraction holds up legally, since the Minister herself called it 'not very tenable', and questions where the ultimate weighing of interests lies.
This does not reassure these members.
Dat stelt deze leden niet gerust.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the bill amending the Gas Act and Mining Act to minimise gas extraction from the Groningen field, urging that resident safety take precedence over the societal interest in supply security and raising concerns about liability and compensation. The government's reply accepted most points, adjusted articles 52d and 52e to define the balancing criteria, and supplemented the explanatory memorandum on liability, though it could not add a public damage-settlement scheme to the bill.
concerns: The Council argued the minister's discretion to weigh safety against supply security was unbounded and advised limiting it so resident safety takes priority, which the government adopted by specifying criteria in article 52d.

The Council considered treating supply security as a fundamental right under ECHR articles 2 and 8 unnecessary and inflationary, and the government deleted that passage from the explanatory memorandum.

The Council asked whether the operator remains liable for future subsidence damage given the extraction obligation, and the government clarified in the memorandum that liability is unchanged but did not add a public damage-settlement scheme to the bill.

The Council requested a supplement on the planned definitive arrangement for public damage settlement and the operator's financial contribution, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.

The editorial annex asked whether the extraction obligation is a public service obligation requiring notification to the Commission under the Gas Directive, and the memorandum was supplemented with a notification statement.

34984.s: The bill amends the Dutch Weapons and Ammunition Act (Wwm) and the Nature Conservation Act to implement EU Directive 2017/853 on firearms control. It adds regulation of weapon brokers, a requirement to join a recognised shooting club for certain semi-automatic weapons, mandatory registration of firearm permits, and designates the chief of police as the controlling authority for deactivated firearms.
34984.j: The memorandum justifies mandatory club membership as a means of social control over firearm holders and states that the directive requires these measures.
q: It is essential that firearm permits are only issued to persons who can handle a weapon carefully.
Het is van wezenlijk belang dat wapenverloven alleen worden uitgegeven aan personen die zorgvuldig met een wapen kunnen omgaan.
d: conditions for recognition of museums and collectors
designation of permits refused without proof of club membership; club recognition criteria
cases of reasonable interest for permits
alternative marking rules for historically significant firearms
personal data and firearm data recorded in registration system
personal data and firearm data exchanged with other member states
p: Firearm and permit data are retained for up to 30 years after destruction and may be consulted by the Minister, police and prosecutors for criminal investigation purposes.

Permits may be refused by general administrative order for applicants lacking proof of membership of a club the Minister has recognised, which the Minister may refuse on vague grounds of suspected misuse.
The chief of police is designated as controlling authority and may process sensitive personal data including ethnicity, political and religious views for the Act's tasks.

parties: Asks why the bill was sent so late before the implementation deadline, why sensitive data such as ethnicity may be processed, and what happened to earlier motions on penalties for illegal weapons.
They note that the bill was sent to the House on 29 June 2018, just before the summer recess and only two and a half months before the implementation deadline of 14 September 2018.
Zij constateren dat het wetsvoorstel op 29 juni 2018 naar de Kamer is gezonden, vlak voor het zomerreces en slechts tweeëneenhalve maand voor de implementatiedeadline van 14 september 2018.

Asks whether restricting processing of sensitive personal data by ministerial order (amvb) is compatible with the GDPR and should instead be in formal law, and questions the police taking on new tasks while already overloaded.
Should this restriction not be established by formal law?
Moet deze beperking niet bij formele wet tot stand komen?

Doubts the necessity and effectiveness of extremely long retention periods and of processing sensitive personal data, and asks for a privacy impact assessment and safeguards against misuse and arbitrariness by the Korpschef.
They have doubts about the necessity and effectiveness of the extremely long retention periods for personal data.
Zij hebben twijfels over de noodzakelijkheid en effectiviteit van de extreem lange bewaartermijnen van persoonsgegevens.
Supports the aim of the bill but asks whether there is enough enforcement and oversight capacity for licensing and for illegal firearm possession.
Is sufficient supervisory capacity available for this?

Questions the justification for further intrusion into private life through processing of sensitive data by the Korpschef, asks how citizens can inspect their data and correct errors, and asks for the privacy impact assessment requested by the AP.
Asks whether the extra hours for police are sufficient and whether alternatives exist for licensing and control, referring to a motion on police capacity.
This is a considerable burden on the already scarce capacity of the police.
Dit is een forse aanslag op de toch al schaarse capaciteit van de politie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division recommends sending the bill implementing EU Directive 2017/853 on firearms to parliament, but asks for further justification or amendment of the shooting-club membership requirement for firearm leave and of the chief of police's data transfer. The government's reply accepts the points, clarifies the club-approval grounds and withdrawal options, and adds a statutory basis for further rules on data exchange.
concerns: Freedom of association is restricted by requiring shooting clubs to be approved and refused where there is fear of misuse by members; the reply adds justification and clarifies the provision in the bill.

Refusal of club approval over fear of misuse by members needed justification, since withdrawing an individual firearm leave was not considered an adequate alternative; the reply explains that club-level safety is at stake.
Withdrawal of club approval and its consequences for individual members were unclear; the reply points to the general withdrawal grounds in the Wwm and clarifies the effects.
Specifications of data to be exchanged under the EU system were not yet known; a statutory basis for regulation by general administrative order was added to article 37 Wwm.
Unclear whether collectors would be subject to the club membership requirement; the explanatory memorandum was clarified and collectors will need recognition under a planned order in council.
Redactional remarks on terminology (goedkeuring replaced by erkenning), the date-based scope in article 32a, and references to the amending directive were all adopted.

35299.s: This omnibus bill (Verzamelwet VWS) makes many technical amendments across health-ministry laws, including medicine verification and pharmacist checks of safety features, the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet on confidential advisers and the Veilig Thuis reporting centres, and the RIVM Act on its oversight committee. It also updates pension, social-insurance and long-term-care provisions, including a temporary power for ministerial regulations on healthcare rights after Brexit.
35299.j: The memorandum justifies the Brexit transitional delegation by the need to avoid unacceptable gaps in healthcare coverage for affected persons and the need for technical implementation of EU rules.
q: To prevent undesirable situations, it is therefore necessary to create the possibility, by ministerial regulation during a transitional period of several months to be determined, of continuing the implementation of the regulations including the right to care benefits.

Om ongewenste situaties te voorkomen, is het daarom noodzakelijk om de mogelijkheid te creëren om bij ministeriële regeling gedurende een nader te bepalen overgangsperiode van een aantal maanden de uitvoering van de verordeningen voort te zetten ook wat betreft het recht op verstrekkingen van zorg.
d: rules on safety-feature database for medicines
rules on safety-feature database for manufacturers
rules on pharmacist and GP checks of safety features
certificate of conduct requirements for confidential advisers
temporary applicable social-security rules and care benefits after Brexit, possibly departing from EU regulations
ministerial no-objection statement before availability payments
appointment of members of central ethics committee
ARTIKEL XIX C (Wet op het RIVM art. 7, lid 4)
minister appoints temporary expert committee members on request of chair
ARTIKEL XXV B (Wet toetsing levensbeëindiging art. 7)
legal status and remuneration of committee chairs
ARTIKEL XXVI C/D (Zvw art. 73a, lid 1 and 75)
content and format of accountability reports and audit requirements for Zorginstituut
content and audit of Wlz fund annual accounts
p: The minister may withhold a no-objection statement only for conflict with law or the public interest, a narrow but discretionary gatekeeping power over the healthcare authority.

Ministerial regulations may set aside EU social-security coordination rules and determine who counts as insured for a transitional twelve-month period after Brexit, with a time limit but broad discretion.
ARTIKEL XXV B (Wet toetsing levensbeëindiging art. 7)
Rules on the legal position and pay of committee chairs are left to general administrative order rather than the statute itself.

parties: Asks whether the change to the blood supply evaluation and the Brexit provisions could create risks, and whether the Veilig Thuis naming introduces risks if lower regulation lags behind.
Does the government see risks of a difference in naming between laws and lower regulations if lower regulations are delayed in being adjusted?
Ziet de regering risico's van verschil in benaming tussen wetten en lagere regelgeving in het geval van eventuele vertraging in het aanpassen van lagere regelgeving?
Asks whether the Raad van State reviewed the later-added amendments and what advice it issued.
The CDA members ask whether the Council of State has looked at these later-added amendments.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de Raad van State naar deze later toegevoegde wijzigingen heeft gekeken.
Asks why the Brexit ministerial regulation power is not subject to parliamentary involvement and what 'unacceptable consequences' means.
These members would like to know what is meant by 'unacceptable consequences in the field of care'.
Graag vernemen deze leden wat wordt verstaan onder «onaanvaardbare gevolgen op het terrein van zorg».
Worries that automatic approval of medicine research after a deadline could weaken protection of trial participants and informed consent.
In addition, these members have serious doubts about the proposal to automatically approve medicine research when the applicable deadline is exceeded.
Daarnaast stellen genoemde leden grote vraagtekens bij het feit dat voorgesteld wordt om geneesmiddelenonderzoek automatisch goed te keuren bij overschrijding van de daarvoor geldende termijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft omnibus bill (Verzamelwet VWS 20XX) and raised no remarks, advising that it be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport adds several technical amendments, including renaming AMHK to Veilig Thuis and minor changes to various health-related laws.

35350-IV.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) through a second supplementary budget, changing appropriations in tables 1 and 2 in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date to the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2019.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the budget statements of Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) for the year 2019
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en het BES-fonds (H) voor het jaar 2019

35350-VI.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the 2019 budget statements of its agencies, in a second supplementary budget, with effect from 1 December 2019. It also states that the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations, citing the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 and the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie.

35398.s: The bill amends the Animal Act to implement EU Regulation 2016/429 on transmissible animal diseases, mainly by replacing the notification duty in Article 2.12 with an enabling power for general administrative orders and by extending the Minister's powers to designate diseases and adopt disease-control measures. It also repeals the Animal Health and Welfare Act and makes conforming amendments to related laws.
35398.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for timely implementation of binding EU rules that change at short notice and by the need to avoid overlap between statute and regulation.
q: Because this is implementing legislation and the underlying European legal framework sometimes changes at short notice, it is proposed to elaborate the notification duty at the level of a general administrative order and ministerial regulation.

Omdat het om implementatieregelgeving gaat en de achterliggende Europeesrechtelijke kaders soms op korte termijn wijzigen, wordt voorgesteld om de meldingsplicht uit te werken op het niveau van algemene maatregel van bestuur en ministeriële regeling.
d: rules on notification duty for animal diseases and zoonoses
designation of diseases and animal species/categories for control measures
defining infection and suspicion of infection per disease
emergency decisions without prior written form, extended to EU-based measures
transitional law for animal health levy decisions
p: The Minister may designate diseases for national control measures where, in his judgement, the EU measures do not suffice.
The Minister may set the date on which suspicion of infection on a farm arose and ended, and which animals are deemed infected or suspect.
I.A and I.B (Art. 2.11 repealed, Art. 2.12 rewritten)
The statutory ban on deliberate infection is removed and the notification duty is moved from the statute to delegated regulation.
Enforcement and cost-recovery powers are extended to measures based on EU acts as well as national designations.

parties: Asks how far the Commission's delegated and implementing powers reach, which member-state influence exists, and whether national rules are being overridden by the EU regulation.
Asks why the bill lacks an evaluation clause given uncertainty about regulatory burden and the pending EU delegated and implementing acts.
Given these uncertainties, the CDA members find it remarkable that the present bill contains no evaluation clause.
In het kader van deze onzekerheden vinden de leden van de CDA-fractie het opmerkelijk dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel geen evaluatiebepaling bevat.
Asks how the removal of the ban on intentionally infecting animals for all keepers will not weaken coverage, and how the new ban will be substantiated under the general measures.
The D66 members wish to ask the government to further explain how it can guarantee that deleting article 2.11 ... does not lead to a weakening or lower coverage of the legislation.

Aan de regering willen de leden van de D66-fractie vragen verder uiteen te zetten op welke wijze zij kan garanderen dat het schrappen van artikel 2.11 ... niet leidt tot een verzwakking of lagere dekking van de wetgeving.
Asks whether the principle of intrinsic animal value should be explicitly tested in preventive measures and whether Dutch discretion to weigh welfare above economic interests is preserved.
Does the government agree with these members that this should not force the Netherlands to be less ambitious?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat dit Nederland niet moet dwingen om minder ambitieus te zijn?
Questions the sanctions available against member states or businesses for poor I&R compliance and asks about the Commission's grounds for granting exemptions from mandatory certification.
The SP members are also curious to what extent there are optional obligations and how member states or entrepreneurs can be sanctioned in case of deficient compliance.

Daarnaast zijn deze leden benieuwd in hoeverre hierbij sprake is van facultatieve verplichtingen en op welke wijze lidstaten of ondernemers kunnen worden gesanctioneerd indien sprake is van gebrekkige naleving.
Asks for status updates on the 28 measures of the bird flu roadmap and for registration of young goat kids to be tightened.
To obtain a complete picture of mortality across all goat sector farms, it is important to adjust the I&R scheme for goats.
Om een volledig beeld te krijgen van de sterfte bij alle bedrijven in de geitensector, is het van belang om de I&R-regeling voor geiten aan te passen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Animal Health Act implementing revised EU animal health legislation, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer.
