The Minister's nader rapport of 13 February 2020 accompanies the transmittal, with no further points to answer.

35479.s: The bill temporarily allows the Minister of Economic Affairs, in agreement with the Minister of Health, to require mobile network operators to provide aggregated, anonymised counts of mobile devices per municipality and hour to the CBS for use by the RIVM in combating COVID-19. The provision lapses after one year, with the possibility of extension by royal decree in two-month steps.
35479.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as urgent COVID-19 response, limited to specified data, minimum aggregation thresholds, a sunset clause and reporting to the House.
q: the provision is temporary and the data are provided solely in the context of the current combating of COVID-19
de bepaling is tijdelijk en de gegevens worden uitsluitend verstrekt in het kader van de huidige bestrijding van COVID-19
d: obligation on mobile operators to provide device count data to CBS
binding instructions on method of data provision and aggregation
start date for information provision (not earlier than 1 January 2020)
royal decree extending the lapse date of article 14.7 in two-month steps
p: Sets aside the protections of the telecommunications and privacy rules (articles 11.5 and 11.5a) to compel operators to share location-derived device counts with a statistics agency for public health use.
Parliament receives only periodic information on effectiveness rather than prior approval of the data obligation.

parties: Questions whether less intrusive alternatives were considered and whether the bill's privacy impact is justified.
Have less intrusive alternatives been considered that could gather comparable insight?
Zijn er minder ingrijpende alternatieven overwogen waarmee een potentieel vergelijkbaar inzicht verzameld zou kunnen worden?
Asks how use of the data for other purposes such as enforcement is prevented and how security is guaranteed.
Questions the necessity and proportionality of the bill and whether data can be traced back to individuals.
Furthermore, the D66 members ask whether the government can rule out that the data received by the CBS and RIVM can be traced back to individuals.
Voorts vragen de D66-leden of de regering kan uitsluiten dat de gegevens die het CBS en het RIVM ontvangen terug te leiden zijn tot individuen.
Argues that extra powers over personal data must be proportionate and asks for a clearly defined problem and an absolute ban on other uses.
At the same time, these members state that extra powers regarding the processing of personal data must be handled with extreme care.
Tegelijkertijd stellen deze leden dat uiterst zorgvuldig dient om te worden gegaan met het toekennen van extra bevoegdheden op het gebied van het verwerken van persoonsgegevens.
Has serious concerns that the measure is disproportionate and lacks a clear purpose.
The SP members see that the government proposes a fairly heavy instrument, large-scale collection and analysis of data without having stated a clear objective.

De leden van de SP-fractie zien dat de regering voorstelt een vrij zwaar middel in te zetten, het grootschalig verzamelen en analyseren van data zonder hierbij een heldere doelstelling te hebben benoemd.
Doubts that individuals cannot be tracked or linked to data and asks for guarantees against identification.
To what extent does it not become technically possible to link traffic and location data to a person?
In hoeverre wordt het technisch niet toch mogelijk om verkeers- en locatiegegevens aan een persoon te linken?
Warns the bill sets a precedent for data requisition from telecom providers and asks how competing interests were weighed.
Opposes the bill as insufficiently justified and questions consent, voluntariness and effects on other fundamental rights.
Has account been taken of the undesirable effects on, for example, the right to demonstrate and the right to freedom of movement?
Is er rekening gehouden met de ongewenste effecten op bijvoorbeeld het recht op demonstratie en het recht op beweging?
Notes the AP's critical opinion, asks whether anonymisation is sound and for a reaction to its objections.
Traceability cannot be ruled out, the AP states.
Herleidbaarheid is niet uit te sluiten, stelt de AP.
Asks whether existing commercial data-analysis systems were considered and how the CBS and RIVM will account for data handling.
Has the government seriously examined and considered using such systems?
Heeft de regering benutting van dergelijke systemen serieus bekeken en overwogen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a temporary bill allowing telecom providers to supply derived mobility data to RIVM for COVID-19 monitoring, raising points on the non-personal-data claim, retention justification, safeguards, task specification and periodic review. The government's reply accepts the points, adding justification, CBS deletion duty, purpose limitation, and a six-monthly evaluation.
concerns: Privacy risks from processing traffic and location data require a fuller explanation of legal limits preventing re-identification, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.
The one-year maximum retention period must be motivated, and the government added justification in the explanatory memorandum.
A statutory deletion obligation for CBS should be added as an extra safeguard, and the government amended the article to cover CBS and RIVM.
The bill should expressly limit provider data processing and CBS and RIVM use to COVID-19 control, and the government restricted the purposes accordingly.
Effectiveness is uncertain, so periodic review during the bill's duration is warranted, and the government added a six-monthly evaluation with reporting to parliament.

35497.s: This second COVID-19 omnibus bill temporarily adjusts several Dutch statutes: it allows universities and colleges to admit students who could not yet meet entry requirements, extends teaching-competence deadlines and study-finance compensation, changes primary-school learning-result assessments, temporarily lets retired judges and judicial deputies serve to age 73, and sets temporary rules for disciplinary hearings and cybersecurity support by the Justice Ministry. The bill mostly sets dates and conditions itself, but leaves important details (such as study-delay compensation and admissions policy) to ministerial regulations and institutional policy.
35497.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need to address study delays, backlogs in the courts and disciplinary bodies, and cybersecurity risks caused by the COVID-19 outbreak.
q: This bill provides the legal basis for implementing these agreements.
Dit wetsvoorstel regelt de juridische grondslag voor de uitvoering van deze afspraken.
d: conditions for enrolment despite missing entry requirements due to COVID-19
scope, eligibility and amount of study-delay compensation
extension of validity of foreign driving licences
Minister's cybersecurity assistance and sharing of threat data with organisations
disciplinary hearings by electronic means and three-member panels chosen by the chair
p: The Minister of Justice gains new tasks to assist designated organisations and to pass cyber threat data gathered under the Act to third parties about other networks, with limited specification of safeguards.
The Minister for Legal Protection, via royal decree, may reappoint retired judges as deputy judges up to age 73, subject to a three-year sunset and a recommendation procedure through the judiciary.
Disciplinary bodies may hold oral hearings electronically and reduce panels to three members, departing from normal composition rules, until 1 September 2020 (extendable by royal decree).

parties: Questions whether bundling unrelated measures into one emergency act, handled very quickly, leaves parliament without proper scrutiny.
The members ask in this context to reflect on the desirability of the phenomenon of an 'omnibus emergency act'.
De leden vragen in dit kader te reflecteren op de wenselijkheid van het fenomeen «Verzamelspoedwet».
Asks technical questions on cybersecurity, student admissions and compensation without raising checks on the executive.
These members still have some questions.
Deze leden hebben nog enige vragen.
Asks about consequences for students admitted conditionally and about the temporary rules for judges and disciplinary hearings.
They ask the government to explain the consequences for a student if the previous education fails to organise the teaching, internship or examinations the student needs for admission.

Zij vragen of de regering toe kan lichten wat de consequenties voor een student zijn als de vooropleiding er niet in slaagt om het onderwijs, stage of de tentaminering te organiseren wat de student voor de toelating ontbreekt.
Stresses that emergency measures need a democratic process and a legal basis, and questions the political choices behind statutory anchoring.
The aforementioned members consider it very important that emergency measures in response to COVID-19 have a statutory basis and go through a democratic process.
Voornoemde leden vinden het van groot belang dat noodmaatregelen naar aanleiding van COVID-19 een wettelijke basis hebben en een democratisch proces doorlopen.
Protests the bundling and rushed timing, and objects that the compensation scheme lets the minister set rules by ministerial regulation without parliamentary involvement.
In short, the members note that this is a subject on which part of the House has already very explicitly stated it wants a debate.
De leden constateren, kortom, dat dit een onderwerp is waar een deel van de Kamer al zeer expliciet over heeft aangegeven een debat te willen.
Asks why the House was not informed in time of the urgent bill and about the position of researchers and international students.
Can the government explain why it did not notify the House in time, the members ask.
Kan de regering toelichten waarom zij de Kamer niet tijdig heeft ingeseind, zo vragen de leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the Second COVID-19 Omnibus Emergency Bill and advised submitting it to parliament, with only redactional remarks. The minister's reply reports that the redactional remarks on articles 7.37c and 3.3 were adopted and that some articles were added to a list.
concerns: The Afdeling made redactional remarks on proposed article 7.37c, first paragraph, under b, which the government adopted.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on article 3.3, which the government adopted and used to clarify the text and explanatory memorandum.

35570-III.s: This bill sets the 2021 departmental budget for the Ministry of General Affairs including the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency, the budget for the Cabinet of the King, and the budget for the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or new executive powers, only budget amounts and entry into force provisions.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) for the year 2021 attached to this law is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) and made no remarks on the proposals, except one non-blank advice on the Ministry of Finance budget. The minister's nader rapport confirms the advice is followed and notes that some budgets are amended in annexes.

35578.s: The bill requires housing associations to propose rent reductions, before 1 April 2021, to tenants with low household income whose rent exceeds the subsidy cap, using income statements from the tax authority. It also lowers the rent levy rate and lets the Rent Tribunal determine the reduced rent when tenants and landlords disagree.
35578.j: The memorandum justifies the income-based reduction and the tax authority's income statements as needed to identify eligible households and does not present a new executive power as such.
q: In this bill a similar power for housing associations and obligation for the tax authority is arranged, but for the purpose of rent reduction for tenants with low income.

In voorliggend wetsvoorstel wordt een soortgelijke bevoegdheid voor woningcorporaties en verplichting voor de Belastingdienst geregeld, maar dan ten behoeve van de huurverlaging voor huurders met een laag inkomen.
d: income statements and rent reduction procedure via tax authority
p: Tenants gain a right to request rent reduction with a fixed procedure and Rent Tribunal recourse, while landlords must propose reductions within set deadlines.

parties: Asks how fraud is prevented, how corporations verify submitted income data, and how the Belastingdienst can supply income verifications within the timeframe.
Which measures will the government, the housing corporation or the Tax Administration take to prevent fraud under this scheme?
Welke maatregelen neemt de regering, de woningcorporatie of de Belastingdienst om fraude voor deze regeling te voorkomen?
Worries that dependence on the Belastingdienst and corporations verifying tenant income data creates administrative infeasibility and fraud risk, and questions why private landlords are excluded.
The CDA members fear that this will lead to abuse.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vrezen dat dat zal leiden tot misbruik.
Asks how tenants will be informed of their right to go to the Huurcommissie and whether that body has sufficient capacity for disputes.
To what extent will the capacity of the Huurcommissie be sufficient for this?
In hoeverre zal de capaciteit van de huurcommissie hiertoe voldoende zijn?
Considers the bill too narrow because it covers only corporation tenants and not those of private landlords with similar incomes.
Why has the government, the GroenLinks members ask, limited this bill to corporation dwellings?
Waarom heeft de regering, zo vragen de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie, dit wetsvoorstel beperkt tot corporatiewoningen?
Calls the bill insufficient, asks why only 8% of tenants qualify, and asks for equal treatment of tenants across sectors.
Why are all other tenants (92%) excluded from a one-off rent reduction?
Waarom worden alle andere huurders (92%) uitgesloten van een eenmalige huurverlaging?
Asks why the bill is limited to corporation tenants, why rent increases above five percent are maintained, and whether a generic solution is planned.
The PvdA members ask why the bill is limited to the group of tenants who pay too much rent at housing corporations.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom de wet beperkt is tot de groep huurders die teveel huur betalen bij woningcorporaties.
Supports the rationale but questions the bill's legal sustainability and the temporary nature of income drops causing structural effects.
How does the government assess the legal sustainability of the bill in this light?
Hoe schat de regering in dit licht de juridische houdbaarheid van het wetsvoorstel in?
Positive about relief for tenants but asks technical questions about the bill.
These members are positive that the government wants to help tenants, especially given the consequences of the corona crisis.
Deze leden zijn positief over het feit dat de regering huurders, zeker gezien de gevolgen van de coronacrisis, tegemoet wil komen.
Welcomes the targeted rent reduction but asks whether the landlord levy reduction affects corporations' investment capacity.
Is it correct that this reduction of the landlord levy does nothing to increase corporations' investment capacity but further pressures that capacity?
Klopt het dat deze verlaging van de verhuurderheffing niets bijdraagt aan een verhoging van de investeringscapaciteit van woningcorporaties maar de investeringscapaciteit juist verder onder druk zet?
Asks whether retroactive rent increases should apply generally and not only based on the 2022 income declaration.
The VVD members read that the housing corporation can raise the rent with retroactive effect if it later appears that income in 2022 was too high to qualify for the one-off rent reduction.

De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat de woningbouwcorporatie de huur kan verhogen met terugwerkende kracht als later blijkt dat het inkomen in 2022 te hoog was om aanspraak te maken op de eenmalige huurverlaging.

Doubts that housing corporations and the Huurcommissie can verify tenant-supplied income evidence, which the Belastingdienst holds objectively, and questions the 2024 fix and the lack of a clear income definition.
Housing corporations and later the Huurcommissie do not have the objective data the Belastingdienst has and therefore can hardly check whether the submitted evidence is correct and complete.

Woningcorporaties en later in het proces de Huurcommissie hebben niet de objectieve gegevens die de Belastingdienst heeft en kunnen dus niet of nauwelijks controleren of de aangeleverde bewijsstukken correct en volledig zijn.
Asks whether tenants will be informed at award about possible later rent increases and how corporations will inform them, and asks for an estimate of the size and number of affected tenants.
They ask whether tenants will be informed of this when the rent reduction is granted.
Zij vragen of huurders hier bij toekenning van de huurverlaging van op de hoogte worden gesteld.

Worries about retroactive rent increases for tenants whose income fluctuates, asks about remedies against them, about the open-ended alternatives to Belastingdienst data sharing, and about data protection for all tenants.
The SP members ask the government what possibilities for objection exist against this catch-up rent increase.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering welke mogelijkheden tot verzet bestaan voor deze inhaalhuurverhoging.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised against proceeding with a bill granting a one-off right to rent reduction for low-income tenants paying high rents at housing corporations, citing unequal treatment, weak nut en noodzaak, unreliable income data, implementation risks and financial strain on corporations. The minister's reply largely adopts the advice by moving to a 2019 income-category check via the Belastingdienst and a notification duty, while defending the core policy and the corporate burden.
concerns: The Afdeling found necessity and the choice of higher income limit and deeper rent cut unjustified given the Sociaal Huurakkoord; the government defended the measure as needed given the corona crisis without fully accepting the critique.
The Afdeling saw permanent rent reduction for temporary income loss as arbitrary and unequal; the government narrowed the scope to 2019 incomes and a lower-income category check.

The Afdeling flagged missing reliable income data and no Huurcommissie impact assessment; the government now requires corporations to obtain Belastingdienst income categories and reports a positive Huurcommissie assessment.
The Afdeling flagged financial risks for housing corporations and uneven effects across corporations; the government argued the burden is acceptable but did not fully resolve the uneven distribution.
The Afdeling asked for a correction mechanism for incorrect income data; the government will examine options and inform parliament.
The Afdeling questioned giving the rent-to-income tax reduction to private landlords who are not covered by the rent reduction; the government rejected exempting them as too complicated.
The Afdeling asked for alignment between the permanent rent reduction and the temporary rent reduction scheme; the government made redactional changes.

35587.s: The bill amends the Dutch Medical Research Involving Human Subjects Act to allow consent to be given electronically under safeguards and to give Inspectie gezondheidszorg en jeugd (IGJ) inspectors power to inspect, copy, temporarily take away and demand information from medical health data of research subjects without consent where necessary for supervision. It also changes evaluation and reporting periods and the minister's response to the evaluation report.
35587.j: The memorandum justifies the new inspection powers by the evaluation committee's recommendation and the need to verify the reliability and completeness of research data, stressing that powers are used only when necessary and consent is not obtainable.
q: For supervision of compliance with the WMO it is necessary that the IGJ can, without consent, inspect the patient file of research subjects in order to check whether the data used are correct.

Voor het toezicht op de naleving van de WMO is het noodzakelijk dat de IGJ, zonder toestemming, het patiëntendossier van proefpersonen in kan zien om te kunnen contoleren of de gebruikte data correct zijn
d: electronic consent method as prescribed in the research protocol
p: Inspectors may access, copy and temporarily take away health data of research subjects and demand information, overriding medical confidentiality and the Awb witness privilege without the subject's consent, limited to what is necessary for supervision and subject to the same confidentiality duty.

parties: Asks whether electronic consent could create a divide between participants and exclude those without digital skills, and how comprehension and fraud risks are checked.
Does the government see a risk of a divide between participants who are and are not offered the option of giving digital consent?
Ziet de regering een risico in het ontstaan van een tweedeling tussen proefpersonen die wel en proefpersonen die niet de mogelijkheid krijgen om digitaal toestemming te verlenen?
Asks why the IGJ should act on participant consent as far as possible and only use statutory powers when necessary, and asks about the timing of the METC guidance and the regulatory burden.

They therefore would like to know what is meant by the passage in section 5 of the explanatory memorandum that the participant information form to be used after the proposal enters into force will be brought into line with this.

Derhalve vernemen deze leden graag wat bedoeld wordt met de passage in paragraaf 5 van de toelichting, «het na inwerkingtreding van het onderhavige voorstel te gebruiken proefpersoneninformatieformulier (PIF) zal hiermee in overeenstemming worden gebracht».

Doubts that the retained option of oral consultation sufficiently protects participants, and argues the recommendation to limit electronic consent to exceptional cases was broadened without justification.
Should care not take precedence over simplicity in this matter?
Gaat zorgvuldigheid in dezen niet vóór eenvoud?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the WMO (medical research with humans), which allows electronic written consent and gives the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) powers to inspect and copy health data of trial participants. The advice asked for clarification of the retention period of medical data the IGJ receives, and the minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented and that retention is limited to what is necessary under the GDPR.
concerns: Clarify the retention period for medical data of trial participants that the IGJ may hold, given their sensitive nature and the requirement not to keep data longer than strictly necessary.
Further motivate, in light of article 8(2) ECHR, that the IGJ's powers are necessary in a democratic society.

35596.s: This sixth supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by adding funds, mainly for catch-up and support programmes for schools and vocational education affected by COVID-19 closures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and only changes budget figures.
35596.j: The memorandum justifies the extra funding by the need to fund catch-up and support programmes for students affected by COVID-19 school closures, with no delegation of new powers.
q: This supplementary budget concerns increasing the subsidy scheme for catch-up and support programmes.
Deze Incidentele Suppletoire Begroting heeft betrekking op het ophogen van de subsidieregeling Inhaal- en ondersteuningsprogramma's.

35659.s: The bill amends the Belastingplan 2021 provisions on the investment wage-tax reduction (BIK), clarifying that it applies to investments used in the Netherlands and changing how fiscal units and administrative duties are treated. It also adjusts the BIK percentages in the Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie volksverzekeringen and sets commencement by royal decree.
35659.j: The memorandum justifies the scope limitation by the risk that the European Court could find that refusing the reduction for foreign-based investments breaches freedom of establishment, and the amended administrative duty by RVO needing access to records before issuing a BIK declaration.
q: If a stakeholder could successfully invoke EU law for investments made by or for a foreign company, the BIK could be applied in situations the cabinet explicitly does not intend.

Als een belanghebbende zich met succes zou kunnen beroepen op het EU-recht voor investeringen die worden gedaan door of ten behoeve van een buitenlandse vennootschap, zou de BIK kunnen worden toegepast in situaties die het kabinet nadrukkelijk niet voor ogen heeft.
d: commencement of articles XXVIAa and XXVIAb, possibly retroactive
p: Lets a royal decree set the commencement date of the amended articles, allowing different dates per article and possible retroactive effect, without a fixed statutory date.

parties: Asks why EC notification was delayed, how long approval takes, and how businesses and tax-unity groups are being informed about the change.
The VVD members ask the government to state when the measure was submitted for notification and when it expects a ruling from the European Commission.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven wanneer de maatregel ter notificatie is voorgelegd en wanneer zij uitsluitsel van de Europese Commissie verwacht.
Raises the risk that investments are later moved abroad or to third parties after commissioning, and asks for an ongoing claw-back provision and a RVO/Tax Authority guideline to control this.

Questions the implementation burden on RVO, asks why no new implementation test was requested, and asks about the budgetary effect and why the BIK cannot be stopped by royal decree when the estimated loss is exceeded.
The D66 members ask why no new implementation assessment was requested from RVO.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen waarom aan RVO geen nieuwe uitvoeringstoets is gevraagd.
Asks how certain the government is that other BIK aspects will not face Commission objections, and about retroactive rate increases and deadweight loss.
The GroenLinks members ask how certain the government is that the other aspects of the BIK will not lead to major objections from the European Commission.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen hoe zeker de regering is dat de andere aspecten van de BIK niet tot grote bezwaren zullen leiden bij de Europese Commissie.

Criticises the late notification and the favouring of large firms, questions the CPB's conclusion on the temporary BIK's effect, and asks about the implications of the notification obligation for future legislation.
They ask the government why the BIK was not notified at an earlier stage.
Zij vragen de regering waarom de BIK niet in een eerder stadium is genotificeerd.

Criticises the inadequate preparation of the original bill and the lobbying influence of VNO-NCW, asks whether the BIK should only take effect after European approval, and questions the reallocation of funds.
The whole process seems more driven by the wish to please the VNO-NCW lobby than by a desire to produce decent legislation.
Het hele proces lijkt meer gedreven door de wil de lobby van VNO-NCW te plezieren dan te komen tot fatsoenlijke wetgeving.

Supports the aim of excluding investments abroad, and asks about the effect on the SME/large-firm split, whether foreign companies can claim the deduction via a permanent establishment, and the timing of the EC decision and the 1 September 2021 opening date.
They endorse the aim of the amendment and welcome that it ensures the BIK scheme cannot be used for investments made outside the Netherlands.

Zij onderschrijven het doel van de novelle en zijn positief over het feit dat deze wijziging ervoor zorgt dat de BIK-regeling niet kan worden gebruikt voor investeringen die buiten Nederland worden aangewend.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the notification of the BIK investment discount to the European Commission be clarified in the explanatory memorandum, including its legal framework and procedure, and that entry into force be made conditional on Commission approval. The government replied that it made the fiscal unity connection conditional on Commission approval, limited to that component, and clarified the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the notification's legal framework (state aid rules) must be clarified, since state aid measures may not be implemented before Commission approval.
The Afdeling advises making entry into force of the whole BIK scheme depend on Commission approval, as the scheme as a whole appears to be submitted for approval.
The explanatory memorandum and bill received redactional changes and clarifications.

35668.s: The bill amends the Wet verbod op kolen bij elektriciteitsproductie to cap CO2 emissions from coal-fired power plants at 35% of their full-capacity emissions per calendar year, enforced by the NEa with administrative fines and a compensation scheme. It implements the Urgenda ruling, with the caps lapsing on 1 January 2025.
35668.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the binding Urgenda court order and the short timeline for CO2 reduction, and the fines by the need for proportionality and a forthcoming policy rule.
q: Given the short timeframe in which CO2 reduction is needed, it was chosen to include in this bill a range within which the production restriction is expected to lie.
Gelet op de korte termijn waarop CO 2 -reductie nodig is, is ervoor gekozen in dit wetsvoorstel voorlopig een bereik op te nemen waarbinnen de productiebeperking naar verwachting zal liggen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 4, derde lid)
rules on compensation request, calculation and payment
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 6, tweede lid)
administrative fines imposed by the minister for exceeding the cap
p: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 6, tweede lid)
The minister may impose administrative fines up to the sixth-category criminal fine or 20% of net turnover on operators exceeding the cap, with a policy rule to guide use.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to the earlier call for proposals for voluntary closure and how supply reliability is ensured.
The VVD members ask how it is ensured that enough electricity remains available at all times despite the production limit.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen op welke wijze ervoor wordt gezorgd dat er ondanks de productiebeperking voldoende stroom beschikbaar blijft op alle momenten.
Asks for clarity on compensation rules by general administrative order and on whether the production cap can be adjusted if emissions fall for other reasons such as the coronavirus crisis.
These members ask the government to make clear the expected amount of this compensation and what rules it intends to set for compensating damage.

Deze leden vragen de regering om duidelijk te maken wat naar verwachting de hoogte van deze vergoeding zal zijn en welke regels zij voornemens is om te stellen met betrekking tot de vergoeding van de schade.
Asks how state subsidies relate to damage compensation, how over-subsidisation is prevented, and whether TenneT's adequacy analysis covers closing all plants.
These members ask how this government subsidy relates to the damage compensation. How is over-subsidisation prevented?
Deze leden vragen hoe deze overheidssubsidie zich verhoudt tot de nadeelcompensatie. Hoe wordt oversubsidiëring voorkomen?
Argues the 25 percent cap is insufficient under the Urgenda ruling and legally vulnerable, and asks for safeguards on compensation calculation and independent advice.
A reduction percentage of 25 percent after 2020 is therefore not enough.
Een reductiepercentage van 25 procent na 2020 is daarmee niet genoeg.
Regrets that the government does not choose to close all plants by 2022 and asks what would be needed to ensure supply without coal.
The SP members find it very disappointing that the government does not choose to close all plants by 2022.
De leden van de SP-fractie vinden het zeer teleurstellend dat de regering niet kiest voor het sluiten van alle centrales per 2022.
Supports the cap as necessary to comply with the Urgenda judgment, while questioning the reliance on compensation and the treatment of biomass emissions.
These members want to emphasise that this proposed amendment, which provides a production cap on coal-fired electricity, is a good and necessary step.
Deze leden willen benadrukken dat deze voorgestelde wetswijziging, welke voorziet in een productiebeperking op elektriciteit uit kolen, een goede en noodzakelijke stap is.
Calls for immediate closure of all coal plants, questions the temporary nature of the cap and the compensation as a hidden fossil subsidy, and asks for evaluation and verification of emissions.
The proposal of these members is to close all coal plants immediately.
Het voorstel van deze leden is om onmiddellijk alle kolencentrales te sluiten.
Asks about the net effect on European CO2 emissions and whether enough regulable capacity exists for 2030.
The SGP members would like to hear what the expected net effect of the proposed measure is on European CO2 emissions.
De leden van de SGP-fractie horen graag wat naar verwachting het netto effect van de voorgestelde maatregel is op de Europese CO 2 -emissie.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft bill capping CO2 emissions from coal plants in 2021-2023 to implement the Urgenda order, raising issues on duration, EU law (Industrial Emissions Directive and Article 193 TFEU), and enforcement penalties. The minister's reply accepted the points: the cap period was extended to 2024, the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on EU law, and the maximum fine was raised from 10% to 20% of turnover.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for explanation of how the temporary coal emission cap relates to the Industrial Emissions Directive's ban on CO2 limits and to the effet utile of the ETS Directive, and whether Article 193 TFEU conditions were met; the reply supplemented the memorandum arguing compatibility.

The Afdeling noted that the 2023 enforcement possibilities were limited and the 10% turnover fine might not deter overshoot in extreme cases; the bill was amended to allow fines up to 20% of turnover.

The Afdeling questioned how structural compliance with the Urgenda order would be ensured after 2023 given the measure's end date; the government extended the measure to 2024 based on updated projections.

The Afdeling noted the NEa's implementation assessment warned that the fine maximum may be insufficient in extreme cases; the government improved motivation for not assigning enforcement to the NEa board.

35677.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding 560 million euro in commitments and expenditure to the business innovation and entrepreneurship article as an incidental supplementary budget for the economic support and recovery package linked to COVID-19. It sets the budget in thousands of euros, applies from 1 January 2021 with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later, and contains no delegation of rule-making power.

35686.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security by adding 1.574 billion euro in COVID-19 related spending authorisations and 60 million euro in outlays, mainly for temporary corona jobs in enforcement and counter-terrorism/national security. It takes effect on 1 January 2021 or the day after publication of the Staatsblad, retroactively if needed.
35686.j: The memorandum justifies the supplementary budget by the COVID-19 related need to fund temporary enforcement capacity for municipalities, without delegating new powers.
q: To support supervision and enforcement organisations, 60 million euro is made available to municipalities for temporary corona jobs.
Om toezicht- en handhavingsorganisaties te ondersteunen wordt € 60 mln. beschikbaar gesteld aan de gemeenten voor tijdelijke coronabanen.

35695.s: The bill clarifies the temporary legal basis in the Public Health Act (Wpg) so that a ministerial regulation can require travellers entering the Netherlands from designated areas to show a negative SARS-CoV-2 test, and that carriers ensure they only transport such travellers. It also extends the same test obligation to travel between the European Netherlands and the Caribbean public bodies and provides an exemption for Dutch nationals.
35695.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to limit spread of a more contagious variant, citing OMT and RIVM advice and the state's duty to protect public health.
d: rules on offering, access to and use of passenger transport services
negative test obligations for carriers and travellers from designated areas
p: The bill lets a ministerial regulation impose test requirements on travellers and carriers, restricting freedom of movement and privacy, with the statutory basis clarified but the content left to executive rulemaking.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill clarifying the temporary legal basis in the Public Health Act for requiring negative test results for travellers entering the Netherlands by commercial passenger transport, raising concerns on purpose, the right to return of Dutch nationals, application to the Caribbean public bodies, and facultative delegation. The minister's reply (nader rapport) largely accepts the points, adding a fifth paragraph exempting Dutch nationals and expanding the explanatory memorandum, and changes the delegation to imperative.
concerns: The Afdeling said the legal basis must be concrete enough to cover bodily integrity and the explanatory memorandum must justify that only clarification is involved; the memorandum was supplemented.
The conditions must not make the right of Dutch nationals to return practically impossible, so they must be proportionate in concrete cases; a fifth paragraph exempting Dutch nationals was added.
The explanatory memorandum should explain how the provision for the Caribbean public bodies relates to article 132a of the Constitution; the memorandum was supplemented.
Facultative delegation is inappropriate since rules on test timing and other elements are necessary for effectiveness, so the Afdeling advised imperative delegation; this was adopted.
A redactional annex corrected the entry-into-force date of the temporary covid-19 measures act from 1 December 2019 to 1 December 2020; adopted.

35749.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to ensure timely decisions on immigration applications by allowing extensions of decision periods, introducing quarterly reporting to parliament on timeliness, and excluding penalty payments (dwangsommen) for late decisions in immigration cases. It replaces the penalty regime with a court-ordered decision deadline in appeals against failure to decide on time.
35749.j: The memorandum justifies removing penalty payments by arguing that they burden the budget, divert staff, and do not speed decisions, and that a temporary law is needed given the asylum backlog.
q: Declaring Articles 4:17 to 4:19 of the Awb inapplicable closes the route of collecting a penalty payment after a notice of default.
Het buiten toepassing verklaren van de artikelen 4:17 tot en met 4:19 van de Awb sluit de route af om na het uitbrengen van een ingebrekestelling een dwangsom te incasseren
d: extension of decision deadlines in justified cases
categories of applications and rules for quarterly reporting
rules on publication of monthly progress reports and indicators
p: Excludes penalty payments for late decisions on immigration applications, removing a financial sanction that previously enforced timely decisions against the executive, though appeal against failure to decide remains available.
Replaces the court's power to impose a penalty on the authority with a non-binding order to decide within a reasonable term, weakening judicial enforcement against the minister.
Introduces quarterly reporting to parliament on decision timeliness, strengthening parliamentary oversight of the executive.

parties: Asks how the government will improve IND effectiveness and capacity given that the bill removes penalty payments; accepts the goal of timely decisions but doubts penalties are the right tool.
They attach great importance to effective decision-making on asylum cases, but share the government's view that forfeiting penalty payments is not a suitable means of guaranteeing a timely decision.

Zij hechten groot belang aan het effectief besluiten over asielzaken, maar delen de mening van de regering dat het verbeuren van dwangsommen geen passend middel is om het nemen van een tijdige beslissing te waarborgen.
Worries the bill removes a citizen instrument against the government without a replacement, questions equal treatment, the missing safety valve, and the extension beyond asylum cases.
By introducing this law, the government takes this instrument out of the hands of citizens, without anything being put in its place.
Door het invoeren van deze wet ontneemt de regering dit instrument uit handen van burgers, zonder dat daarvoor wat in de plaats komt.
Strongly supports abolishing the penalty payment scheme for asylum seekers and asks whether the bill definitively ends it.
The PVV members are strong supporters of abolishing the penalty payment scheme for asylum seekers.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn een groot voorstander van het afschaffen van de dwangsomregeling voor asielzoekers.
Finds the justification for extending the exemption to all Vreemdelingenwet cases insufficient, since exceptions to the general rule should be as narrow as possible.
Together with the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division, the CDA members believe exceptions to a main rule should be as limited as possible.
Met de Afdeling zijn de leden van de CDA-fractie van mening dat uitzonderingen op een hoofdregel zo beperkt mogelijk dienen te zijn.
Questions whether abolishing penalty payments gives administrative bodies a free pass on court rulings, and whether the bill conflicts with equality and rights protections.
This therefore raises the question of whether abolishing penalty payments is a free pass for administrative bodies regarding court rulings.
Dit roept dan ook de vraag op of het afschaffen van dwangsommen een vrijbrief zijn aan bestuursorganen van rechtelijke uitspraken.
Sees a permanent exemption as discriminatory on grounds of nationality and unjustified, arguing penalty payments remain a useful incentive once the IND is properly equipped.
Excluding precisely these applications is, according to these members, indeed a distinction on grounds of nationality that is insufficiently justified.
Het uitzonderen van juist deze aanvragen is volgens deze leden dan inderdaad een onderscheid op grond van nationaliteit, dat onvoldoende gerechtvaardigd is.
Asks why no safety valve was chosen, what alternatives were considered, and whether the proposed measures give enough incentive for fast decisions.
For what reason was this not chosen in the final bill?
Om welke reden is hiervoor niet gekozen in het uiteindelijke wetsvoorstel?

Argues that periodic reporting is no real alternative for individual asylum seekers, that the bill may be unconstitutional under Article 1 of the Constitution, and that the government ignores side effects such as damages claims.

Furthermore, these members find that the alternative intended by the government, periodic reporting, is wholly insufficient to enforce timely decision-making, since an individual foreigner cannot derive any rights from it.

Daarnaast vinden deze leden dat het door de regering beoogde alternatief, periodieke rapportage, volstrekt onvoldoende is om tijdige besluitvorming te kunnen afdwingen, aangezien een individuele vreemdeling hier geen rechten aan kan ontlenen.
Shares the PvdA concerns: no real alternative, possible conflict with Article 1 of the Constitution, and an overly broad scope covering all immigration procedures.
Why has the government chosen to abolish the stick behind the door, namely penalty payments, without coming up with a realistic alternative?
Waarom heeft de regering ervoor gekozen om de stok achter de deur, namelijk dwangsommen, te willen afschaffen, zonder daarbij met een reëel alternatief te komen?

Finds the necessity and proportionality of abolishing penalty payments insufficiently justified and possibly an unjustified distinction in conflict with the Constitution and EU Charter, and questions effects on trust in government.
The necessity and proportionality are insufficiently substantiated.
De noodzakelijkheid en proportionaliteit is onvoldoende onderbouwd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against making the permanent exemption from the dwangsom (penalty payment for late decisions) for all Vreemdelingenwet cases without a sufficiently reasoned justification, arguing that structural delays are not inherent in immigration decision-making and that the extension to all immigration cases was unmotivated. The government's nader rapport defends the exemption on the nature of immigration decision-making, accepts the redactional points, but largely maintains its position without further narrowing the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the permanent exemption from the dwangsom not adequately justified and considers temporary suspension, rather than permanent exclusion, the only defensible option.
The exemption indirectly distinguishes on grounds of nationality, which must be objectively justified; the government denies discrimination arises from the exemption.
Procedural rules implementing EU law must not be less favourable than comparable national claims; the government argues no comparable national claims exist.
Extending the exemption from asylum cases to all Vreemdelingenwet cases is insufficiently motivated and should be justified or dropped.
Redactional points on aligning reporting periods, ensuring the Tijdelijke wet lapses visibly, adding a citation title, and correcting the IND's status as acting under mandate were addressed.

35767.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by increasing the commitment amount for general and supplementary grants by 117 million euro as a third supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures, and sets integration and decentralisation grant amounts. It takes effect on 1 January 2021 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35776.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by adding EUR 10 million for arts and culture initiatives for vulnerable groups in connection with COVID-19. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 17 March 2021, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35785.s: The bill proposes a constitutional amendment to article 55 that adds a separate electoral college, chosen directly by Dutch nationals who are not residents, to elect members of the Senate (Eerste Kamer). It also adds a transitional provision keeping the 2017 text of article 55 in force for five years, extendable by law by up to five years.
q: This additional article lapses on the day on which the term referred to in the first paragraph ends.
Dit additionele artikel vervalt op de dag waarop de termijn, bedoeld in het eerste lid, eindigt.

parties: Welcomes giving Dutch citizens abroad influence over the Eerste Kamer and asks about how the implementing electoral law will set vote weight.
By establishing a separate electoral college for the election of the Eerste Kamer, Dutch nationals living abroad also gain influence over the composition of the Eerste Kamer.

Met het instellen van een apart kiescollege voor de verkiezing van de Eerste Kamer der Staten-Generaal krijgen ook Nederlanders die in het buitenland woonachtig zijn invloed op de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer.
Supports the proposal but objects to the government's preferred vote weight as democratically unequal and asks for alternatives such as registered voter counts.
That does not change the fact that the aforementioned preference would lead to such a large difference that they consider it undesirable from a democratic point of view and an equality perspective.
Dat neemt echter niet weg dat de voornoemde voorkeur tot een zodanig groot onderling verschil zou leiden, dat zij dit onwenselijk achten vanuit democratisch oogpunt en een perspectief van gelijkheid.
Supports the proposal and asks how the Kieswet amendment will set vote weight and optimise proportionality.

What options are there to optimise proportionality when determining the vote weight of the new electoral college, for example by applying a correction factor to the vote weight of its members, these members ask.

Welke mogelijkheden zijn er om bij het bepalen van de stemwaarde van het nieuwe kiescollege de evenredigheid te optimaliseren, bijvoorbeeld door een nader te bepalen correctiefactor toe te passen op de stemwaarde van de leden van het nieuwe kiescollege, zo vragen deze leden.
Questions abandoning the residence principle for Eerste Kamer elections and the vote ratio relative to provincial votes, and the unreliable registration of voters abroad.
The SP members ask again why the residence principle is being abandoned for the election of the Eerste Kamer.
De leden van de fractie van de SP vragen nogmaals waarom het ingezetenenbeginsel wordt losgelaten voor de verkiezing van de Eerste Kamer.
Asks the government for an update on possible vote-weight calculations for the future Kieswet amendment.
These members would like the government to provide an update on the conceivable calculations for determining the vote weights.
Deze leden zouden graag van de regering vernemen of zij een update kan geven inzake de denkbare berekeningen voor het bepalen van de stemwaarden.
Asks about the timing of the Kieswet changes and whether the government still prefers vote weight based only on votes cast.

Does the government still believe that, all things considered, it is preferable to determine the vote weight of the members of an electoral college for Dutch nationals abroad solely on the basis of votes cast?

Is de regering nog steeds van mening dat het, alles afwegende, de voorkeur verdient om alleen de stemwaarde van de leden van een kiescollege voor Nederlanders in het buitenland te bepalen op basis van het aantal uitgebrachte stemmen?

Questions the government's claim that the proposal is a constitutional right under Article 50 and whether it fits the constitutional system, and asks whether a non-resident vote should weigh more than residents' votes.
Why does the government believe there is no essential guidance in this which makes an election of the Eerste Kamer partly by non-residents not immediately obvious?
Waarom meent de regering dat hierin geen wezenlijke richtingwijzer te vinden is die een verkiezing van de Eerste Kamer mede door niet-ingezetenen niet meteen voor de hand liggend maakt?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises the Tweede Kamer to proceed with a bill amending the Constitution to provide for an electoral college of non-residents for Eerste Kamer elections, raising no remarks. The minister's reply (nader rapport) is not present in the text beyond the transmittal note.

35794.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security through a second supplementary budget, adding €2.5 million to article 34 (Straffen en Beschermen) for victim support tied to a scheme compensating businesses damaged in riots. It takes effect the day after publication and retroactively from 1 March 2021.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security for the year 2021
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid voor het jaar 2021

35866.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by adding 99 million euros in commitments and expenditure, mainly for debt forgiveness for private debts of childcare-benefit (toeslagen) victims and for extra staff for the compensation commissions. It is an incidental supplementary budget that also amends the budget schedule for article 13 Toeslagen.
35866.j: The memorandum justifies the extra funding by the sharp rise since February 2021 in requests to and appeals before the Commissie Werkelijke Schade and the Bezwaarschriftenadvies Commissie, which requires more personnel support.
q: Since February 2021 the number of requests and appeals to the Commissie Werkelijke Schade and the Bezwaarschriftenadvies Commissie (both Toeslagenherstel) has increased sharply.
Sinds februari 2021 is het aantal verzoeken aan en beroepen op de Commissie Werkelijke Schade en de Bezwaarschriftenadvies Commissie (beiden Toeslagenherstel) sterk toegenomen.

35884.s: This 9th supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, mainly for COVID-19 measures, with amounts stated in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum also covers government guarantees for a COVID-19 testing foundation and for laboratory analysis capacity, with a €2.5 million liability ceiling and a 5-year horizon.
35884.j: The memorandum justifies the guarantees as necessary to give board members comfort against personal liability and to ensure sufficient laboratory testing capacity during the COVID-19 crisis.
q: The scheme has an overall ceiling (€151.6 million) and, barring an additional decision by the Minister of VWS, will not be extended.
De regeling kent een totaalplafond (€ 151,6 miljoen) en wordt, behoudens een aanvullend besluit door de Minister van VWS, niet verlengd.

35893.s: The bill extends the existing option for vocational education on Bonaire to offer programmes and their examinations in Papiamentu beyond the two lowest levels, so that it can also cover mbo levels 3 and 4 for targeted groups. It also amends article 7.1.1 of the WEB BES accordingly and leaves the Saba and Sint Eustatius provisions effectively limited to the existing wording.
35893.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the needs of the local labour market and of students with insufficient Dutch, with the choice of language left to the competent authority.
q: For certain target groups, the competent authority may decide to also offer education at mbo levels 3 and 4 in Papiamentu.
Het bevoegd gezag kan voor bepaalde doelgroepen besluiten ook op de mbo-niveaus 3 en 4 het onderwijs in het Papiaments aan te bieden.

parties: Asks how the ministry tests the school's decision to use the exception and how the Inspectorate can judge quality of Papiamento-language programmes given its expertise.
In what way is this assessment tested by the Ministry of OCW?
Op welke manier wordt deze afweging getoetst door het Ministerie van OCW 3 ?
Supportive of broader access to Papiamento exams but concerned students lose admission rights to Dutch-European education and asks about later options.
These members note that this however means students lose admission rights to education in European Netherlands.
Deze leden lezen dat dit echter wel ervoor zorgt dat studenten hiermee toelatingsrecht verliezen tot het onderwijs in Europees Nederland.
Asks why level 2 Papiamento programmes are currently offered cautiously and whether the request came from the SGB.
To what extent did the request to extend the exception option for Papiamento come from the SGB, the members ask.
In hoeverre is het verzoek tot het uitbreiden van de uitzonderingsmogelijkheid voor het Papiaments gekomen vanuit de SGB 2 , zo vragen de leden.
Positive about the bill but asks whether students were consulted, how loss of admission rights will be communicated, and whether the law will be evaluated.
Finally, the GroenLinks members ask whether the government intends to carry out an evaluation of the legislative amendment.
Tot slot vragen de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie of de regering van plan is om een evaluatie van de wetswijziging uit te voeren.
Asks whether the criterion that students must not have had a Dutch-language prior education is workable and whether the discretionary criteria should be stricter.
Has consideration been given to formulating the criteria for deviating from Dutch more strictly now that the scope of the deviation is growing, the members ask.
Is overwogen om de criteria voor afwijking van het Nederlands stringenter te formuleren nu het bereik van de afwijking groter wordt, zo vragen de leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a Verzamelwet OCW 20## that made minor technical changes but also included Papiamentu-medium MBO extensions on Bonaire, removal of an evaluation clause for special primary education, and additional EU directive implementation; it advised separate bills for these points. The government's nader rapport accepted the advice by splitting these elements into separate bills and clarifying the Bonaire exception's scope and limiting it to Bonaire.
concerns: Inclusion of a substantive change allowing Papiamentu-medium MBO education on Bonaire in an omnibus bill is not appropriate; a separate bill is needed given policy content.
Scope of the Papiamentu exception for all MBO levels on Bonaire needs better justification regarding labour market need and Dutch language proficiency.
The provision for Sint Eustatius and Saba was unclear; the text was amended so the exception applies only to Bonaire.
Removing the evaluation clause for special primary education without an evaluation having taken place needs justification or a separate evaluation.
Additional implementation of EU directives in an omnibus bill conflicts with legislative policy; a separate bill should be used.

35929.s: The bill amends the Dutch wage tax act (Wet LB 1964) to change when employee stock option benefits are taxed, moving the taxation point to when acquired shares become tradable and removing the start-up S&O exemption. It also adds a ministerial regulation delegation to set rules for shares whose tradability depends on factors outside the employee's control.
35929.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the fact that tradability of shares in non-listed companies differs from listed companies and that deemed tradability in buy-out situations needs tailored rules.
q: By ministerial regulation a fiction will be introduced aimed at establishing in such situations whether and to what extent the shares are deemed not, partly or fully tradable.

Bij ministeriële regeling zal een fictie worden opgenomen die tot doel heeft om in dergelijke situaties vast te leggen of en in welke mate de aandelen worden geacht niet, deels of geheel verhandelbaar te worden.
d: ARTIKEL I, B, 14 (art. 10a lid 14 Wet LB 1964)
rules on situations where acquired shares are deemed not, partly or fully tradable

parties: Asks about the scope of the bill, the meaning of tradability as the tax moment, and why the employee rather than employer and employee jointly holds the election.
These members ask how this relates to the aim of the bill, namely improving the liquidity position of start-ups and scale-ups.
Deze leden vragen hoe dit zich verhoudt tot het doel van het wetsvoorstel, te weten het bevorderen van de liquiditeitspositie van start-ups en scale-ups?
Asks who benefits and who loses, how tradability is tested and controlled by the Tax Administration, and whether an evaluation horizon and data collection are included.
These members ask how the Tax Administration checks whether stock options are freely tradable and how it can verify this.
Deze leden vragen hoe de Belastingdienst toetst of aandelenopties vrij verhandelbaar zijn en hoe de Belastingdienst dit kan controleren.
Supports the aim but worries about the complexity and enforceability of the scheme, citing the red flag on enforceability and the Council of State's criticism.
The CDA members are concerned about the feasibility of implementing the scheme.
De leden van de CDA-fractie maken zich zorgen over de uitvoerbaarheid van de regeling.
Questions tax neutrality across forms of pay, tax arbitrage from deferral, and what alternatives such as payment arrangements were considered.
The PvdA members ask to what extent this scheme will induce tax arbitrage in wage payment.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen in hoeverre deze regeling fiscale arbitrage in loonbetaling zal uitlokken.
Fears new tax avoidance constructions, inequality between employees paid in shares and others, and a possible enforcement shortfall given the very negative implementation assessment.
Far-reaching complexity consequences and an increase in legal procedures are mentioned.
Ingrijpende complexiteitsgevolgen en een toename van juridische procedures worden genoemd.
Welcomes making employees co-owners in principle but asks whether directors benefit and whether they could choose favourable timing; asks about the enforcement staffing cost.
Can it be ruled out that directors get the opportunity to pay tax at a favourable moment?
Kan worden uitgesloten dat bestuurders de mogelijkheid krijgen om op een gunstig moment belasting te betalen?
Asks for a clear legal explanation of tradability and notes the Dutch tax advisers' criticism of the vague concept.
To prevent uncertainty in this area, it is important to clearly set out legally when shares are exactly tradable at a market-conform price.
Om onduidelijkheden op dit gebied voor te zijn, is het van belang helder juridisch uiteen te zetten op welk moment aandelen precies verhandelbaar zijn tegen een marktconforme prijs.
Notes the implementation assessment finds serious effects on enforceability and fraud resistance and asks whether simplification was considered and whether benefits outweigh costs.
The SGP members ask the government whether the large effects on complexity, enforceability and fraud resistance outweigh the benefits the bill offers.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering of de grote gevolgen voor de complexiteit, handhaafbaarheid en fraudebestendigheid opwegen tegen de voordelen die het wetsvoorstel biedt.
Asks whether minority shareholdings without a buy-back arrangement count as tradable and why tax is not tied to conversion into liquid funds.
Why was it not chosen to tie tax liability to the moment of converting shares into liquid funds rather than the moment of tradability?
Waarom is er niet gekozen om belastingverschuldigdheid te koppelen aan het moment van omzetten in liquide middelen in plaats van het moment van «verhandelbaarheid» van aandelen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the Belastingplan 2022 package unless adapted, raising concerns about its size and composition, the use of goedkeurende beleidsbesluiten, the stock option scheme, the voorheffingenbeschikking and the overdrachtsbelasting evaluation timing. The government's nader rapport accepted detaching the stock option change into a separate bill and clarified several points, while retaining the others in the package.
concerns: The package combines many unrelated measures in one omnibus bill, which the Afdeling considers unsuitable and risky for parliamentary scrutiny; the government detached the stock option change but kept the package largely intact.

Increasing use of goedkeurende beleidsbesluiten that deviate from statute, sometimes with broad legal bases, undermines the legality principle and parliamentary role; the government's reply does not meaningfully address this call for restraint.

The stock option measure's objectives, effectiveness, efficiency and relation to existing schemes were insufficiently explained; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented and an evaluation announced.
The choice option for stock option taxation adds complexity and fraud risk; the government defended it as limited and added a section on taxpayer capacity.
The delegation basis for non- or partly-tradable shares was vague; the text and explanation were narrowed to specified uncertain factors.
The new voorheffingenbeschikking system is complex, and the Afdeling asked why alternatives were not considered given the heavy IV-organisation burden; the reply is not present in the text.
The Afdeling asked for the overdrachtsbelasting evaluation to occur in 2022 rather than 2024 given criticism and housing market tensions; the reply is not present in the text.

35983.s: The bill establishes a permanent national advisory council on sport, the Nederlandse Sportraad, consisting of a chair and up to nine other members, tasked with advising the government and both chambers of parliament on sport policy and societal issues related to sport. It enters into force by royal decree and is governed by the general framework of the Kaderwet adviescolleges.
35983.j: The memorandum justifies the council's establishment by reference to the Constitution (art. 79) and the Kaderwet adviescolleges, without a specific justification for the delegation of the entry-into-force date.
q: Article 3: This law enters into force at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Artikel 3 Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks how the NLsportraad's advice was handled, why the ministry sometimes departed from it, and whether event-subsidy advice should move entirely to the ministry.
Why has the ministry with some regularity departed from the NLsportraad's advice, for example on the Gymnaestrada?
Waarom is er met enige regelmaat afgeweken van het advies van de NLsportraad, zoals bijvoorbeeld bij de Gymnaestrada?
Supports a permanent advisory council but asks whether the statute should cover exercise and whether the council will be asked for targeted advice.
Asks for justification of the claim that advisory status helps bridge-building, and about overlap with the Gezondheidsraad and RVS.
However, the government does not substantiate this position.
De regering onderbouwt dit standpunt echter niet.
Welcomes the statutory basis and broad remit covering grassroots and top sport and events, with no further questions.
They think it is good that the NLsportraad receives a statutory basis and thereby becomes a permanent advisory council.
Zij vinden het goed dat de NLsportraad een wettelijke basis krijgt en daarmee een permanent adviescollege wordt.
Values the council's advice and asks for its status, follow-up actions, and an overview of recommendations and how composition ensures expertise.
Broadly positive on a sport advisory council but questions proportionality of costs and whether it could be integrated into another council.
The BBB member recognises the importance of sport and an advisory council in this area, but questions the establishment of various advisory councils and the associated expenditure.

Daarbij onderkent het lid van de BBB-fractie het belang van sport en een adviesraad op dit gebied, maar plaatst zij wel vraagtekens bij het instellen van diverse adviesraden en de daar aan gekoppelde uitgaven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill establishing a permanent Dutch Sports Council (Nederlandse Sportraad) as a statutory advisory body, questioning the motivation given its general restraint on new advisory bodies and its overlap with the Health Council and RVS. The government's reply (nader rapport) states the memorandum was supplemented, that the Sports Council's independent position preserves its bridge-building role, and that consultation with the Gezondheidsraad and RVS was addressed.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether establishing a separate permanent advisory body is necessary given the restraint principle and the overlap with the Health Council and RVS, and the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum on positioning and consultation.

The Afdeling notes the evaluation suggests the Sports Council's value lies in bridge-building, which may be sidelined as a pure advisory body; the government replied that its independent position reinforces this role.

36250-IV.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES fund (H) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and receipts by amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2022.

36250-VI.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statement for its agencies, in a second supplementary budget. It changes expenditure and revenue figures across policy articles and agencies such as DJI, IND, CJIB and NFI, with effect from 1 December 2022.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36379.s: The bill adds a legal basis to the Housing Act allowing designated housing associations and housing allocators to process citizens' BSN (citizen service number) when applicants consent to a digital income check. It sets retention limits, lets the minister designate associations for the digital procedure, and allows lower-level rules on BSN processing by general administrative order.
36379.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for a legal basis for BSN processing, reducing errors and unlawful allocation, and notes that an evaluation will follow.
q: A legal basis for processing the BSN is a restriction on the fundamental right under Article 8 of the European Convention on Human Rights.
Een grondslag voor het mogen verwerken van het BSN is een beperking op het grondrecht uit artikel 8 van het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens
d: further rules on processing of BSN
designation of associations for digital income procedure
p: Introduces processing of citizens' BSN and income data for housing allocation, limited by consent, withdrawal rights, and retention periods of at most three years.

parties: Asks how the income test could extend to higher incomes paying higher rents, focusing on allocation to those in need rather than checks on government.
These members ask the government how a system to carry out the income test for higher incomes would exactly look.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe een systeem om de inkomenstoets uit te voeren voor de hogere inkomens er precies uit zou gaan zien.
Stresses protecting applicants' privacy and asks whether the BSN may be used for nothing other than this income test and how pseudonymisation tools will be enforced.
They therefore ask whether it can be confirmed that the BSN may not be used for anything other than the present income test.
Daarom vragen zij zich af of bevestigd kan worden dat het BSN nergens anders voor gebruikt mag worden dan de onderhavige inkomenstoets.
Asks how the voluntary character of digital data sharing will be preserved and how covert mandatory use by corporations is prevented.
How is it prevented that housing corporations and housing allocators covertly make a digital procedure mandatory (for example to prevent housing fraud)?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat woningcorporaties en woonruimteverdelers heimelijk een digitale procedure verplicht stellen (bijvoorbeeld om woonfraude te voorkomen)?
Asks whether income-dependent rent increases may be applied without informing the tenant of the income check.
To what extent may the income-dependent rent increase be implemented without informing the tenant of the income inquiry?
In hoeverre mag de inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging doorgevoerd worden zonder de huurder van de inkomensnavraag in kennis te stellen?
Questions the need for BSN use over improving BRP data, the impact on people without DigiD, excluding applicants who refuse to share BSN, and the long three-year retention period.
They ask why such a long period was chosen and why six months would not be sufficient.
Zij vragen waarom voor zo’n langdurige periode is gekozen en waarom een halfjaar niet voldoende is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill letting housing corporations use citizens' BSN for digital income checks, raising concerns that the BSN use is not clearly necessary or legally grounded under the Wabb and that retention periods should be set in statute rather than delegated. The government's reply accepted the retention-period point by adding a statutory maximum retention period and narrowing the delegation to an AMvB, and defended the necessity and proportionality of the digital procedure, without changing the core design.
concerns: The Afdeling doubted that using the BSN is necessary given the existing option for citizens to upload an income statement, and asked for the deviation from the Wabb to be justified; the government defended necessity and proportionality at length but added the Wabb relationship to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling noted the voluntary, two-tier design may mean there is no statutory obligation to use the BSN as the Wabb requires for non-governmental bodies; the government responded that designated corporations are obliged to follow the procedure once the citizen opts in.
The Afdeling advised excluding subdelegation of retention periods to a ministerial regulation and allowing delegation only to an AMvB; the government adopted this change.

Retention periods for the BSN should be set clearly given the privacy sensitivity of the number; the government added a statutory maximum retention period in the bill text instead of only referring to the GDPR in the explanatory memorandum.

36388.s: The bill removes covid-19 from the list of group A infectious diseases in article 1(e) of the Public Health Act (Wpg), ending its A-status. The explanatory memorandum notes this ends reporting duties for doctors and lab heads and removes the minister's and safety region chair's specific powers over covid-19 control.
36388.j: The memorandum justifies the de-scaling by noting that covid-19 remaining a group A2 disease is undesirable according to RIVM advice, and that the bill is expected to take effect within two years.
q: In article 1, subsection e, of the Public Health Act, "covid-19," is removed.
In artikel 1, onderdeel e, van de Wet publieke gezondheid vervalt «covid-19,».
p: Removing covid-19 from the Wpg list eliminates the specific statutory powers the minister and safety region chairs could use to impose covid-19 measures.

parties: Asks why the A-status was kept on WHO's judgment even after the notification duty and other measures had already lapsed in practice.
What is the reason for adhering to the World Health Organization's (WHO) judgment even though both the notification duty and all other measures in the Netherlands had already lapsed?

Wat is de reden dat werd vastgehouden aan het oordeel van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) ondanks dat zowel de meldingsplicht als alle andere maatregelen in Nederland reeds waren komen te vervallen?
Asks about the schedule of the Wpg amendments, vaccination coverage, and outreach to target groups, and about how a possible re-escalation procedure would work.
These members believe that offering vaccinations as low-threshold as possible is essential.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het zo laagdrempelig mogelijk aanbieden van vaccinaties essentieel is.
Strongly supports the bill and has no further questions.
These members wholeheartedly support this bill and have no further questions on it.
Deze leden steunen dit wetsvoorstel van harte en hebben hier verder geen vragen bij.
Supports the bill and has no further questions at this time.
They support this bill and currently have no further questions about it.
Zij steunen dit wetsvoorstel en hebben hier momenteel geen verdere vragen over.

Positive about the downgrade but asks about continued monitoring by hospitals and nursing homes, the Coronadashboard, vaccination outreach, and follow-up on Onderzoeksraad recommendations including reform of state emergency law.
Can the government give an overview of the follow-up to these recommendations and also address how the government intends to revise state emergency law?
Kan de regering een overzicht geven van de opvolging van deze aanbevelingen en daarin ook ingaan op de manier waarop de regering het staatsnoodrecht wil herzien?
Welcomes the downgrade and relaxed notification duty but insists the powers of safety regions in crises must be narrowly delimited to prevent creeping expansion.
In situations of disasters and crises the safety region has a role, but it is of great importance to delineate its tasks and powers precisely to prevent them from creeping expansion.
In situaties van rampen en crises heeft de veiligheidsregio een rol, maar het is van groot belang de taken en bevoegdheden nauwkeurig af te bakenen om te voorkomen dat deze sluipend uitdijen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet publieke gezondheid to scale down the A-status of covid-19, and raised no remarks and advised submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply (nader rapport) only clarifies one point in the explanatory memorandum and forwards the bill.

36410-IX.s: This bill sets the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (article IXB) and the national debt budget (IXA), fixing amounts in thousands of euros and taking effect on 1 January 2024. The explanatory memorandum describes policy and budget items for tax, customs, financial markets, child benefits and the Btw-compensation fund, but contains no explicit delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this law for the year 2024 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion dated 11 September 2023 on the draft 2024 budget bill for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), finding no remarks. The Minister of Finance submitted a nader rapport on 18 September 2023 forwarding the advice to the King.
