36469.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to convert shareholder dispute procedures (expulsion, transfer of voting rights, withdrawal) from summons proceedings to petition proceedings before the Enterprise Chamber of the Amsterdam Court of Appeal as sole first-instance court, with the Enterprise Chamber given wider judicial discretion and a new ground for expulsion covering conduct outside the shareholder capacity. It also clarifies standing for certificate holders and extends the regime to listed companies with changed thresholds.
36469.j: The memorandum justifies the wider expulsion ground and single-instance Enterprise Chamber by faster, more efficient access to the court and specialised judicial expertise.
q: The bill provides that conduct of a shareholder in another capacity (for example as director or as a private person) may also be taken into account by the court in its balancing of interests.

Het wetsvoorstel regelt dat ook gedragingen van een aandeelhouder in andere hoedanigheid (bijvoorbeeld als bestuurder of als privépersoon) door de rechter kunnen worden meegenomen in zijn belangenafweging.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 2:336a lid 1 BW)
The court may expel a shareholder for conduct outside its shareholder capacity, widening judicial discretion in private shareholder disputes.

parties: Asks whether the broader expulsion ground could allow malicious shareholders to rely on past conduct, such as acts as director of a competitor, at any time.
The aforementioned members ask whether this could also be interpreted as conduct in the past, such as acts performed as a director of a competitor.
Voornoemde leden vragen of dit ook geïnterpreteerd kan worden als gedragingen in het verleden, zoals handelingen die uitgevoerd zijn als bestuurder van een concurrent.
Asks why the government does not give the Enterprise Chamber a fuller role or extend the enquiry procedure instead of improving the dispute scheme, and whether the scheme will actually be used.
Can the government explain why it chose to improve the now deficient and little-used dispute scheme, while it could instead supplement the already working enquiry scheme?

Kan de regering nader aangeven waarom ervoor gekozen wordt om de nu gebrekkige en weinig gebruikte geschillenregeling te verbeteren terwijl het ook mogelijk is om in plaats daarvan de wel al werkende enquêteregeling aan te vullen?

Supports the aims of modernising access to courts and checks and balances in company law, but asks about coordination between the district court and the Enterprise Chamber, the scope for listed companies, the exclusion of some certificate holders, the lack of a hardship clause, EU notification, and an evaluation clause.
The aforementioned members also attach great value to checks and balances in company law.
Voornoemde leden hechten ook veel waarde aan checks and balances in het vennootschapsrecht.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code on the shareholder dispute settlement scheme and the admissibility requirements for the enquiry procedure of listed companies. It asked the explanatory memorandum to address the expulsion provision's relation to the property right under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR (including ECtHR case law) and to free movement of capital under EU law, and the government's reply supplemented the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should refer to relevant ECtHR case law on the property right under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR, which the government added.
The expulsion scheme's restriction on free movement of capital under EU law should be explained and justified, which the government did in the explanatory memorandum.
A savings provision on overlap with the Wet implementatie richtlijn grensoverschrijdende omzettingen, fusies en splitsingen was removed as superfluous since that law has entered into force.

36470-III.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statements (second supplementary budget) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Supervisory Committee on Intelligence and Security Services, adjusting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2023.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36478.s: This reparation bill makes many technical and redactional corrections to education laws under the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, including updating cross-references, extending legal protection provisions to mbo students, and restoring powers lost in earlier reforms. It also changes some delegations, such as allowing a ministerial regulation to designate relevant certificates and allowing a ministerial regulation to set accountant protocols under the NWO law.
36478.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to ministerial regulation on the ground that it allows the relevant certificates for mbo educational support to be designated in one regulation, which benefits clarity.
q: By broadening the statutory basis, the relevant certificates for educational support work in mbo can be designated in a single ministerial regulation, which benefits clarity.

Door deze verruiming van de grondslag in de wet kunnen – na wijziging van het Besluit bekwaamheidseisen onderwijspersoneel – in één ministeriële regeling de relevante getuigschriften voor onderwijsondersteunende werkzaamheden in het mbo worden aangewezen.
d: ARTIKEL V, onderdeel H (artikel 4.2.2, eerste lid, onderdeel d, WEB)
rules on certificates for educational support work in mbo
ARTIKEL V, onderdeel J (artikel 7.4.6b, vijfde lid, WEB)
requirements for documents and procedure for replacement certificates
ARTIKEL XII, onderdeel C (artikel 27 Wet NWO)
budget, annual report and accountant protocol rules for NWO
ARTIKEL XV, onderdeel L (artikel 180 WPO, zevende lid)
which WPO/WEC/WVO rules apply to school cooperation
ARTIKEL XVII, onderdeel C (artikel 140 WPO BES)
experiments deviating from WPO BES provisions
ARTIKEL XXIII, onderdeel X (artikel 8.15 WVO 2020, derde lid)
school board must hear pupil and parents before definitive expulsion
p: ARTIKEL XIX, onderdeel B (artikel 3.2, vijfde lid, WSF BES)
Designation of institutions for student finance is moved from the minister to a ministerial regulation.
ARTIKEL XIX, onderdeel E (artikel 7.4, vierde lid, WSF BES)
Corrects the competent supervisory body for privacy-related licensing from the Minister of Justice to the Commissie toezicht bescherming persoonsgegevens BES.

parties: Asks whether the government should acknowledge that a plain-language watchdog (Taalpolitie) would have prevented the need for this repair bill, and how it evaluates past responses to that proposal.
To what extent must the government now acknowledge that this bill would have come sooner had the proposed Taalpolitie been established?
In hoeverre moet de regering nu erkennen dat dit wetsvoorstel er eerder was gekomen, als de beoogde Taalpolitie er wel was gekomen?
Asks about the effects of the physical education norm, cooperation with VNG, and whether the start-up allowance change raises costs.
Does this in practice lead to an expansion of this scheme?
Leidt dit in de praktijk tot een verruiming van deze regeling?
Has no substantive questions about the bill.
The NSC members have no substantive questions regarding the bill.
De leden van de NSC-fractie hebben geen inhoudelijke vragen met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel.
Praises the extension of NWO's task for the BES islands and asks about purchasing-power effects of changing the lowest to highest assessed income in student finance.
Does this legislative change have negative purchasing-power effects for students and, if so, what order of magnitude and how many students are involved?
Heeft deze wetswijziging negatieve koopkrachteffecten voor studenten en zo ja, welke ordegrootte koopkracht en over hoeveel studenten gaat dit dan?
Has no substantive questions on the bill but asks about the status of applying the WNWO to mbo 4.
The CDA members have no substantive questions regarding the bill.
De leden van de NSC-fractie hebben geen inhoudelijke vragen met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel.
Warns that the amended information right in the WMS may cause confusion and weaken medezeggenschap compared with the WHW, and asks the government to align the wording.
The SGP members ask whether the government is willing to anchor the text of Article 9.32(6) WHW identically in the WMS.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of de regering bereid is de tekst van artikel 9.32, zesde lid, WHW op identieke wijze in de WMS te verankeren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the omnibus education repair bill should not include a mandatory VOG for supplementary education staff or the reinterpretation of the physical education hours norm, as these require substantive legislative deliberation unsuited to a repair law, and recommended revising or separating them. The government's reply accepts splitting off the VOG provision into a separate bill and defends the physical education provision as a restoration of earlier law, with clarifications added to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The VOG requirement for supplementary education staff intrudes on privacy, equal treatment, freedom of education and occupational choice, and the explanatory memorandum lacked proper necessity and proportionality reasoning, which the government partly addressed by expanding it.

The Afdeling questioned whether statutory regulation of the VOG was necessary now, given the pending monitor on supplementary education and unclear scope of the problem; the government did not await the monitor but added further justification.

The bill is a technical repair law and the substantive VOG and physical education hours changes do not fit that character, so they should be removed; the government split the VOG provision into a separate bill.

The physical education hours norm reinterpretation of the Heerema/Van Nispen amendment and the new distinction between regular and special education lacked clear justification and implementability, prompting a request for a clear norm and adequate transition period; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum but kept the provision as restoration.
Uncertainty about feasibility of the physical education norm given an evaluation of the subsidy scheme not yet carried out and accommodation shortages in a third of municipalities.
Redactional corrections and removal of amendments relating to the Wet taal en toegankelijkheid were made in response to the Afdeling's drafting remarks.

36487.s: The bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by a supplementary budget increasing commitments and expenditure for a loan to TenneT. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect retroactively from 1 March 2024 if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2024
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2024

36496.s: The bill extends rent regulation to the middle rental segment by introducing a new category of 'middeldure huurwoonruimte' with a rent-points ceiling and a limited annual rent increase, and makes the maximum rents under the Woningwaarderingsstelsel binding by prohibiting landlords from charging above them. It assigns municipalities supervisory and enforcement powers, broadens tenants' access to the Huurcommissie, and requires landlords to disclose point scores in rental contracts.
36496.j: The memorandum justifies the binding rent norm and municipal enforcement by the constitutional duty to promote adequate housing and by the need to protect tenants who cannot rely on the Huurcommissie route alone.
q: Making the WWS binding sets a clear norm on maximum rents and prevents a grey area in the relationship between landlord and tenant.
Het dwingend maken van het WWS stelt een duidelijke norm over de maximale huurprijzen en voorkomt een grijs gebied in de relatie tussen verhuurder en huurder.
d: ARTIKEL V, A (Artikel 3, derde lid Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte)
detailed rules distinguishing self-contained and non-self-contained dwellings
ARTIKEL III, B (Artikel 10, vierde lid Huisvestingswet 2014)
annual adjustment of income thresholds for middle-income households
ARTIKEL V, D (Artikel 5, tweede lid Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte)
fee amount and rules for declarations by public-law bodies to the Huurcommissie
p: ARTIKEL I, B (Artikel 2a Wet goed verhuurderschap)
Makes the maximum rent binding and prohibits landlords from charging above it, backed by municipal enforcement, shifting protection from tenants' own initiative to state supervision.
ARTIKEL I, D and Articles on municipal enforcement (gemeentelijk toezicht)
Assigns municipal college of mayor and aldermen the supervisory and sanctioning role over rent levels, with administrative enforcement tools including fines subject to appeal.
ARTIKEL V, F (Hoofdstuk IIA Uitvoeringswet, verhuurderbijdrage)
Introduces a levy on social landlords to fund the Huurcommissie, with amounts set through the budget and collection by dwangbevel.

parties: Asks about the size of the affected tenant group, housing demand and supply, and the impact on landlords, with concern about investor unrest.
how large is the group of tenants who do not qualify for a social rental home and cannot or do not want to buy a home in the coming years?
hoe groot is de groep huurders, die niet in aanmerking komen voor een sociale huurwoning en de komende jaren geen woning kunnen of willen kopen?
Supports regulation to protect tenants but questions the unequal treatment of existing versus new tenants and the generous new-build surcharge.
Why does landlords' property right weigh so heavily against the equal treatment of tenants?
Waarom weegt het eigendomsrecht van verhuurders zo sterk op tegen de gelijke behandeling van huurders?
Questions the legal basis and procedure, including whether the Raad van State should have been consulted again on substantial changes, and raises property rights and proportionality concerns.
the Council of State's advisory division explicitly assumed the bill would be submitted to it again for advice
de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State expliciet overwoog ervan uit te gaan dat het wetsvoorstel nog opnieuw aan haar zou worden voorgelegd voor advies
Welcomes more regulation but fears the bill is weakened, criticising the raised WOZ cap and extra new-build surcharge that push tenants into the middle segment.
They do note, however, that the currently proposed bill has been considerably weakened.
Zij constateren echter wel dat de huidige voorgestelde wet erg afgezwakt is.
Asks about landlords' exit options and effects on small business owners using rental property as pension provision.
what instruments does the landlord then have to dispose of a loss-making rental property?
welke instrumenten heeft de verhuurder dan om een (verlieslijdend) huurpand van de hand te doen?
Strongly supports the bill as putting tenants' interests central and asks several clarifying questions on how to prevent gaming of the 186-point threshold.
These members express their great appreciation that this legislation is now before parliament.
Deze leden spreken hun grote waardering dat deze wetgeving nu voorligt.
Supports the aim but questions whether small municipalities can enforce the rules and suggests an independent body such as the Huurcommissie for enforcement.
ask whether it would not be more desirable for such municipalities to assign the (enforcement) tasks to an independent organisation with great expertise, such as the Huurcommissie.
vragen of het voor dergelijke gemeenten niet wenselijker is de (handhavende) taken te beleggen bij een onafhankelijke organisatie met grote expertise, zoals de Huurcommissie.
Endorses the importance of the bill and asks technical questions about WOZ caps, the new-build surcharge and monument treatment.
These members endorse the importance of this legislative amendment.
Deze leden onderschrijven het belang van deze wetswijziging.
Seeks balance between investment in rental housing and protection of tenants against malicious landlords, asking about service-cost circumvention.
These members realise that the aim is to find a balance between these goals.
Deze leden realiseren dat het daarbij zoeken is naar een balans tussen deze doelen.
Stresses moderate rents but also the supply of rental homes and landlords' willingness to invest; asks about the start-date cutoff for the surcharge and monument and energy-label effects.
These members attach importance to moderate rents, but also ask for attention to the supply of rental homes and landlords' willingness to invest.
Deze leden hechten aan het belang van gematigde huren, maar vragen eveneens aandacht voor het aanbod huurwoningen en de investeringsbereidheid van verhuurders.
Asks whether a 1 July start date is realistic for landlords and whether the government considered deregulation alternatives and the effects of the threshold.
The VVD members ask the government whether introduction on 1 July is realistic, given that it is not yet even clear to landlords what the law will look like.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering of invoering per 1 juli wel realistisch is, gezien het feit dat voor verhuurders nog niet eens duidelijk is hoe de wet er precies uit komt te zien.
Supports the need for the law and asks for swift plenary treatment.
These members endorse the need for this law and look forward to further treatment.
Deze leden onderschrijven de noodzaak van deze wet en kijken uit naar de verdere behandeling.

Raises concerns about retroactive (ex nunc) testing of existing contracts, disproportionate fines without suspensive effect, changes to the household definition, and interference with property rights and existing legal relations.
With the amendment to the Good Landlordship Act, the Minister interferes with existing legal relationships.
Met de wijziging van de Wet goed verhuurderschap maakt de Minister inbreuk op bestaande rechtsverhoudingen.
Welcomes a shift toward tenant rights and urges quick plenary treatment, with no further questions.
In these members' view it is time for a change of perspective, with much more attention to tenants' rights.
Het is in de ogen van deze leden tijd voor een perspectiefwisseling waarbij er veel meer aandacht komt voor de rechten van huurders.
Has serious concerns, including the new-build surcharge, the lack of transitional protection for sitting tenants and the restriction of property rights.
They are not convinced by the government's explanation for not applying the renewed WWS to sitting tenants yet.
Zij zijn niet overtuigd van de uitleg van de regering om voor zittende huurders het vernieuwde WWS nog niet in te stellen.
Asks for the housing-stock simulations to be rerun with alternative definitions of affordability.
These members endorse the importance of affordable rental housing but have some questions about the simulations in the reply.
Deze leden onderschrijven het belang van betaalbare huurwoningen maar hebben enkele vragen over de simulaties in de beantwoording.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet betaalbare huur, which extends the WWS rent regulation to the mid-rental segment and makes WWS maximum rents mandatory, raising serious concerns about supply effects, investment willingness, property rights and the evidence base. The government's nader rapport responds point by point, largely disputing the Afdeling's effectiveness concerns, adding monitoring and adjustments (higher new-build allowance, longer start-build date, revised WWS valuation) while maintaining the core proposal.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness and suitability of mid-rental regulation given persistent scarcity, and the government adds analysis of scarcity, supply and monitoring but disputes that regulation reduces supply.
Risk that regulation triggers sell-offs and reduced new construction, which the government addresses with a higher new-build allowance and monitoring but largely maintains its position.
Regulation of mid-rental rents interferes with landlords' property rights under ECHR and Charter, requiring fuller justification; the government adds a more detailed proportionality motivation.
Restriction of free movement of services and capital needs independent justification under EU law; the government adds a separate motivation via dwingende redenen van algemeen belang.
Removing the six-month limit for tenant challenges before the Huurcommissie restricts landlords' legal certainty; the government adds justification and notes limited scope.
Lack of clarity on whether mid-rental regulation is temporary; the government clarifies five-yearly evaluation of the liberalisation limit in the Besluit.

36560-III.s: This bill (Slotwet) adopts the final budget adjustments for the 2023 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, the Commission for Oversight of Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD), and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie. It sets out the amounts budgeted, actual spending and final differences, and it sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) for the year 2023 (final budget act)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2023 (Slotwet)

36577.s: The bill extends decision deadlines and claim windows in the Dutch childcare benefits (toeslagen) restoration operation, lengthens the objection period to sixteen weeks, and extends eligibility and a new compensation scheme to surviving partners and children of deceased applicants. It also transfers decision authority for supplementary compensation from the minister to the Dienst Toeslagen and adds a power for the minister to establish advisory commissions.
36577.j: The memorandum justifies longer decision deadlines by the unrealistic current six-month term, rising waiting times, and the resulting flood of appeals for failure to decide, which it says only the legislature can solve collectively.
q: The Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State concluded that only the legislature, not the administrative judge, can provide a collective solution to unrealistic decision deadlines in the childcare benefits restoration operation.

De Afdeling bestuursrecht van de Raad van State heeft geconcludeerd dat niet de bestuursrechter, maar alleen de wetgever een collectieve oplossing kan bieden voor onrealistische beslistermijnen bij de hersteloperatie toeslagen.
d: establishing advisory commissions for verifying deceased applicant status
establishing commissions for overige aanvullende regelingen
p: I, onderdeel N and O (artikel 5.3 Wht)
Gives the minister discretion to set up advisory commissions that verify whether an applicant counts as deceased, with access rules for the dossier largely mirrored from existing provisions.
I, onderdeel S and Y (artikel 6.2, 6.10a Wht)
Extends the Dienst Toeslagen decision period and the objection period for claimants, lengthening the time citizens must wait for decisions and objections to be resolved.

parties: Asks whether extending decision deadlines is still necessary now that the SGH route continues, and asks for budgetary quantification.

Can the government indicate to the PVV members to what extent it is still necessary to extend the decision deadlines for applications for supplementary compensation for actual damage now that the SGH route is being continued?

Kan de regering aan de leden van de PVV-fractie aangeven in hoeverre het alsnog noodzakelijk is om de beslistermijnen op aanvragen voor aanvullende compensatie van werkelijke schade te verlengen nu de SGH-route wordt gecontinueerd?
Worries that longer deadlines erode legal protection and legal certainty, may set a precedent for other laws, and asks how affected parents will be informed.
Could this not lead to a sliding scale in restricting legal protection and legal certainty, if statutory deadlines are not met due to government policy?

Kan dit niet zorgen voor een glijdende schaal met betrekking tot het inperken van rechtsbescherming en rechtszekerheid, als door toedoen van beleid van de overheid geldende termijnen niet worden gehaald?
Supports the longer deadlines for clarity and to avoid appeals, but asks about safeguards against objections made solely to obtain settlement offers and about the scope of coulance.
This provides more clarity for parents and prevents appeal procedures.
Hiermee komt er meer duidelijkheid voor ouders en worden beroepsprocedures voorkomen.

Says the twelve-month extension weakens applicants' legal position and asks for constitutional and ECHR analysis, specifically Article 17 of the Constitution and Article 6 ECHR, and the advisory opinions of ministries.
These members note that this is a substantial extension of the decision deadline, which may also lead to more legal uncertainty for applicants and weakens applicants' legal position.

Deze leden merken op dat dit een substantiële verlenging is van de beslistermijn, die bovendien mogelijk tot meer rechtsonzekerheid leidt bij de aanvragers en de rechtspositie van aanvragers verzwakt.
Asks why a fixed statutory date was chosen rather than one set by policy decision, and how late objections after sixteen weeks will be handled.
These members ask the government how it will handle objections submitted after 16 weeks.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering hoe zij om zal gaan met bezwaarschriften die na 16 weken ingediend worden.
Fears the proposals will not restore parents' trust in the operation, questions the rights impact of the measures, and asks whether the Bezwaarschriftenadviescommissie's role is being narrowed.

These members understand from the current course of the restoration operation why the government included such proposals, but fear they will not contribute to affected parents' trust in the operation.

Deze leden begrijpen vanuit het huidige verloop van de hersteloperatie dat de regering dergelijke voorstellen in het wetsvoorstel heeft opgenomen, maar vrezen dat de voorstellen niet zullen bijdragen aan het vertrouwen van gedupeerden in de hersteloperatie.
States the amendment infringes citizens' legal protection, asks the government to justify its lawfulness, and asks whether the extension can be made temporary with statutory reversal conditions.
The SGP members note that the proposed amendment infringes on citizens' legal protection.
De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat de voorgestelde wijziging inbreuk maakt op de rechtsbescherming van burgers.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against the proposed extension of benefit-restoration decision deadlines and objection periods because of legal risks under the reasonable-time requirement of Article 17 of the Constitution and Article 6 ECHR, urging faster processing instead. The government's reply withdraws the extension of objection decision deadlines and retains existing deadlines, drops retroactive application to pending cases, and describes operational measures to speed up processing.
concerns: Extension of pending decision deadlines has retroactive effect to the detriment of applicants, which requires compelling justification; the government dropped application to pending cases.

Longer decision periods risk breaching the reasonable-time requirement under Article 17 Constitution and Article 6 ECHR; the government withdrew the objection-decision deadline extension for this reason.
Deadline extensions do not accelerate the process; the Council urged other measures to speed up handling, and the government added operational measures while keeping the rationale for extension.

The objection period extension to sixteen weeks may be unnecessary and could enable pro forma objections, and the start of decision periods should be reconsidered; the government adjusted the start date mechanism.

36586.s: The bill replaces the existing recidivism regime for serious traffic offences with criminal-law measures: courts may declare driving bans immediately enforceable, impose substitute detention for breaches of a driving ban, and invalidate driving licences for all categories and the remaining validity period. It also extends alcohol-related invalidation and invorderingsbevoegdheden and adds a data-protection link for criminal data held by the CBR.
36586.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for better compliance with driving bans and road safety, citing rising serious traffic casualties and notorious offenders.
q: To put a stop to this behaviour, this bill provides for substitute detention in all cases where a driving ban is imposed.
Om dit gedrag een halt toe te roepen voorziet dit wetsvoorstel in vervangende hechtenis in alle gevallen waarin een ontzegging van de rijbevoegdheid wordt opgelegd
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 111, zevende lid, WVW)
conditions for assessing driver fitness and criminal personal data use
Artikel I, onderdeel M (artikel 179b, tweede lid, WVW)
manner of proving proficiency and fitness when applying for a new licence after invalidation
p: Artikel I, onderdeel M (artikel 180, tweede lid, WVW)
Courts may order driving bans immediately enforceable outside default proceedings, with a court-decided necessity test and possible lifting on appeal.
Substitute detention of at least three days per breach, capped at six months, decided by the rechter-commissaris for breaches of driving bans.
Extends rechter-commissaris powers to order full or partial enforcement of substitute detention for breach of driving bans.

parties: Asks how substitute detention will work in practice and why six months is considered sufficient, and what legal and financial consequences damages claims will have.
The PVV members ask what the government bases its view on that the maximum six-month duration of this substitute detention will be sufficient.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen waar de regering op baseert dat de maximale duur van zes maanden van deze vervangende hechtenis afdoende zal zijn.
Accepts immediate enforceability of driving bans but insists judges need serious grounds and asks whether it should be limited to recidivists.
In the view of these members, the judge must have serious grounds to deprive someone of driving rights immediately.
Naar de mening van de aan het woord zijnde leden moet de rechter dan wel zware gronden hebben om meteen de rijbevoegdheid te ontnemen.
Opposes a statutory minimum for substitute detention because it limits judicial discretion, and raises court capacity and detention capacity concerns.
These members are not in favour of this minimum in the law. It limits judicial freedom, whereas these members believe judges can be trusted to deliver tailored outcomes.

Deze leden zijn geen voorstander van dit minimum in de wet. Het beperkt de rechterlijke vrijheid, terwijl er volgens deze leden op vertrouwd kan worden dat rechters op de juiste wijze maatwerk leveren.
Asks why implementation tests were postponed and why the advice of 1 June 2023 was not published or included in the decision notes.
These members ask why that advice has not been included in the decision memoranda.
Deze leden vragen waarom dat advies niet is opgenomen in de beslisnota's.
Asks whether the six-month cap on substitute detention is enough to deter, and whether the invalidation is part of the ban rather than a separate measure.

These members ask the government whether it expects that after those six months the driver, where the ban was imposed for longer than six months, will still comply with the ban once the substitute detention has ended.

Deze leden vragen aan de regering of zij verwacht dat na die zes maanden de bestuurder, wanneer de rijontzegging voor een langere periode dan zes maanden is opgelegd, zich na de vervangende hechtenis wel aan de rijontzegging zal houden.
Asks for an evaluation provision and a timetable for implementation tests, and questions whether drug use alone suffices to withdraw a licence.
These members ask the government why it did not choose to introduce an evaluation provision and whether it intends to do so after all.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom zij er niet voor heeft gekozen om een evaluatiebepaling in te voeren en of zij voornemens is dit alsnog te doen.
Supports tougher treatment of offenders and asks how the public prosecutor can be encouraged to use both substitute detention and separate prosecution.
The question these members have is how it can be encouraged that the public prosecution service deals with the offender using both instruments.
De vraag die deze leden hebben is hoe kan worden bevorderd dat het OM de overtreder met beide instrumenten aanpakt.
Supports a more effective approach and asks about repeat dangerous drivers and how the Public Prosecution Service's objections to overlapping prosecution are handled.
Can the government explain how this is now arranged in the law?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe dit nu in de wet geregeld wordt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet verbetering aanpak rijden onder invloed, raising major concerns about extending driving-ban consequences to all traffic offences, the mandatory substitute detention (minimum two weeks), ne bis in idem, and the lack of implementation analysis. The minister's reply largely adopts the advice: the minimum is lowered to three days, a complaint route for the defendant is added, and the Afdeling's points are addressed in the explanatory memorandum, while the minister keeps the core extension and the substitute detention.
concerns: The extension of the measures to all traffic offences carrying a driving ban lacks justification of necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity; the minister added justification but kept the broader scope.

Substitute detention restricts liberty under Constitution, EVRM and EU Charter and needs reasoned justification and consideration of less intrusive alternatives; the minister added a new section on this.
The mandatory minimum of two weeks substitute detention limits judicial sentencing freedom; the minister lowered it to three days and kept judicial room for individual adjustment.
The defendant lacked a right of appeal against the rechter-commissaris decision on substitute detention; the minister added an appeal option.
Substitute detention coupled to a sentence for a different offence risks conflict with the ne bis in idem principle; the minister argues the procedures are not the same offence and adds motivation.

The bill lacks analysis of implementation consequences and communication about the new measures; the minister argues implementation tests come after parliamentary adoption and provides preliminary estimates.
Overlap between judicial and administrative invalidation of driving licences is not clarified; the minister added a new section explaining the relationship.
Scope ambiguity for foreign driving licences held by residents in the Netherlands; the minister added a provision extending the rule.
The transitional provision could make more favourable new rules unavailable; the minister removed the clause for offences committed before entry into force.

36649.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer, Wet havenstaatcontrole, Wet voorkoming verontreiniging door schepen and Wet luchtvaart to implement EU regulations FuelEU Maritime and ReFuelEU Aviation, establishing enforcement powers, fines and penalty payments for shipping companies, aircraft operators, fuel suppliers and airport operators. It designates the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit and the ILT as competent authorities and grants the ILT powers to detain ships and issue removal orders.
36649.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the EU regulations, which mandate member states to set sanctions and designate competent authorities, and notes the ILT's inspectorate has assessed enforceability.
q: Under Article 25 of FuelEU Maritime, member states must lay down rules on the penalties applicable to infringements of this Regulation.
Op grond van artikel 25 van FuelEU Maritiem moeten lidstaten regels vaststellen ten aanzien van de sancties die van toepassing zijn op overtredingen van deze Verordening.
d: ARTIKEL I, A.2 (Wet milieubeheer art. 1.1, lid 17)
designation of further entities as fuel suppliers
p: Gives the emissions authority power to impose administrative fines up to EUR 1,030,000 and penalty payments on shipping companies for breaches of the EU regulation, with fine amounts tied to formulas in the regulation.
Adds administrative fines of up to EUR 1,030,000 for breaches of the ReFuelEU Aviation regulation by airport operators and related actors, appealable through objection and appeal.
ARTIKEL II, B (Wet havenstaatcontrole art. 11d, lid 3)
Allows the ILT to issue a removal order against a foreign-flagged ship lacking a FuelEU conformity document for at least two consecutive reporting periods.
ARTIKEL III, B (Wet voorkoming verontreiniging door schepen art. 20, lid 4)
Gives the ILT power to detain a ship for missing required certificates under the EU regulation only after two or more consecutive reporting periods of non-compliance.

parties: Worries the ILT lacks enforcement capacity and that enforcement is not linked to criminal law, and questions whether the maximum fine of over 1 million euro is high enough to deter fraud.
These members are very concerned about a possible increase in tasks without additional enforcement capacity.
Deze leden maken zich grote zorgen over een mogelijke taakverzwaring, zonder extra uitvoeringscapaciteit.
Asks whether the Netherlands deviates from the European sanctioning landscape and what that means for the competitiveness of maritime and aviation firms.
Is the Netherlands in step or out of step in this regard, both for the penalty payment order and the administrative fine?
Loopt Nederland in of juist uit de pas hieromtrent, zowel bij de last onder dwangsom als bij de bestuurlijke boete?

Asks why the ILT inspector-general's proposal for criminal-law enforcement was not adopted, asks for justification of administrative enforcement, and asks how fuel sustainability controls work and whether capacity is sufficient.
These members ask for further explanation of why this was not chosen, and whether the pros and cons can be mapped out.
Deze leden vragen om een nadere toelichting waarom hier niet voor gekozen is, en of in kaart gebracht kan worden wat hier de voor- en nadelen van zijn.

Asks how sustainable fuels are defined and verified, how often checks occur, and what measures prevent fraud and deforestation, and questions the use of animal fat and the slow ramp-up of the blending obligation.

These members ask what measures are taken to guarantee that the sustainable aviation fuels falling under this regulation are truly sustainable and do not lead to unintended negative effects such as increased deforestation or fraud with feedstocks.

Deze leden vragen welke maatregelen worden getroffen om te garanderen dat de duurzame vliegtuigbrandstoffen die onder deze verordening vallen daadwerkelijk duurzaam zijn en niet leiden tot onbedoelde negatieve effecten zoals verhoogde ontbossing of fraude met grondstoffen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion on the draft Uitvoeringswet FuelEU Maritiem en ReFuelEU Luchtvaart, stating it has no remarks and advises submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management replied that the opinion gave no reason for substantive comments and that only minor additions and corrections were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36667.s: The bill extends the duty of schools and vocational institutions to offer career guidance during and after education, and extends the municipal support for young people without a startkwalificatie from age 23 to 27. It also creates municipal powers to offer employment support, shifts data processing and reporting duties, and leaves detailed rules to ministerial regulation and AMvB.
36667.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by arguing that technical detail and regional arrangements are better set by ministerial regulation or AMvB, allowing flexibility for changing circumstances.
q: Several measures require amending the Education and Vocational Education Act (WEB) and the Secondary Education Act 2020 (WVO 2020).
Voor deze maatregelen is een wijziging van de Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs (hierna: WEB), de Wet voortgezet onderwijs 2020 (hierna:
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 1.1.1) / artikel 9.1.1 WEB
further rules on municipal regional cooperation tasks
calculation and payment of specific grant
content and submission of effect report
content of career guidance policy and its implementation
Artikel II, onderdeel B (artikel 7a, vierde lid Participatiewet)
rules on central municipalities' regional tasks for youth support
Artikel III, onderdeel C (artikel 44, zesde lid WEC)
content of school career guidance policy
rules on reporting removal of non-compulsory learners
Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikel 9.2.5, zesde lid WEB)
further rules on municipal support tasks for young people without startkwalificatie
p: Municipal executives gain discretion to support under-27s toward education or work and to process sensitive personal data for that purpose, subject to consent and purpose limits.
Municipalities may process health and criminal-law personal data of young people for support purposes, with storage and access limits but no judicial or parliamentary check.
Municipalities may offer employment support to under-27s and steer them into work arrangements, widening the group reachable by the executive.

parties: Asks about the age limit of 27, sustained funding against future budget cuts, and the split between first and second year aftercare, without raising checks on the executive directly.
These members welcome the goal of the bill, namely to give all young people opportunities to develop and find sustainable work.
Deze leden juichen het doel van het wetsvoorstel, namelijk om alle jongeren kansen te geven om zich te ontwikkelen en duurzaam aan werk te komen, toe.
Asks about data-sharing legal basis raised by municipalities, involvement of employers, and the reasoning for one year of aftercare.
These members strongly endorse the importance of a sustainable place on the labour market and encourage a continuous approach for young people up to 27.
Gevolgen De leden van de VVD-fractie onderschrijven zeer het belang van een duurzame plek op de arbeidsmarkt en moedigen een doorlopende aanpak voor jongeren tot 27 jaar aan.

Questions whether new legislation is necessary and proportionate, whether the bill is effective, and the regulatory burden; asks for minimum requirements in lower regulation and inspection of school-level consultation.
New legislation is not always the best solution to a social problem.
Nieuwe wetgeving is niet altijd de beste oplossing voor een maatschappelijk probleem.
Worried about municipal feasibility amid budget pressure and a 10% cut on specific grants, and asks why the second aftercare year for pro schools is unfunded.
Positive about the bill but doubts whether municipalities can provide integrated support for youth with multiple problems and whether regional boundaries hinder cooperation.
These members understand that this bill does not address that, but they do see the problem.
Deze leden begrijpen dat dit wetsvoorstel daar niet over gaat, maar zij zien wel het probleem.
Questions why schools must support youth no longer enrolled and why municipalities are not the obvious party; asks whether expansion of tasks is appropriate amid budget cuts.
These members ask why it is not first examined for some years how this responsibility takes shape before new changes are introduced.
Deze leden vragen waarom niet eerst gedurende een aantal jaren wordt bezien hoe deze verantwoordelijkheid gestalte krijgt alvorens nieuwe wijzigingen door te voeren.
Asks how partners will be supported in their new tasks, how overlap with other policy is managed, and about the two-year aftercare for pro schools.
These members welcome that the government wants to improve guidance in the transition from school to work for young people at a distance from the labour market.
Deze leden juichen toe dat de regering de begeleiding bij de overgang van school naar werk van jongeren met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt wil verbeteren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet van school naar duurzaam werk, supporting its goal of better guiding youth toward work but raising concerns about support for youth with multiple simultaneous problems, the regional cooperation design, and insufficient specific safeguards for processing health and criminal-law personal data. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted the data-protection and multiproblem points by adding safeguards to the bill and explanatory memorandum, and explained why it did not change the regional boundaries.
concerns: Processing of special personal data (health and criminal-law data) requires additional specific and appropriate safeguards, which the government added to the bill, such as a ban on sharing and a maximum retention period.

The bill does not adequately ensure that youth with simultaneous problems across life domains receive integrated support; the government pointed to other initiatives and clarified the explanatory memorandum rather than extending the bill.
The advice to align the regional boundaries with the findings of the research was not followed, as the research indicated that changing the regional division was not currently desirable.

36676.s: The bill amends the Dutch Security Screening Act to allow location-bound declarations of no objection for positions at designated sensitive locations, with designation by the minister in agreement with the Interior Minister and a register of screened personnel. It also adds a bailiff-style payment collection power, an identification duty, a basis for using the citizen service number, a power to impose administrative enforcement orders, and a basis for mutual recognition of declarations between the Interior and Defence ministries.
36676.j: The memorandum justifies the location-bound declarations by the need for more flexible deployment of security-sensitive staff and the impracticality of repeated screening, and cites the Council of State's advice and the availability of administrative appeal.
q: To enable the desired flexibility in the (changing) filling of functions currently designated as trust positions on this basis, article 3a introduces a location-bound declaration of no objection.

Om de gewenste flexibiliteit mogelijk te maken bij de (wisselende) vervulling van functies die thans op deze grond zijn aangewezen als vertrouwensfunctie, wordt in artikel 3a een locatiegebonden VGB geïntroduceerd.
d: mutual recognition of security declarations between Interior and Defence ministries
designation of sensitive locations and access managers
extension of location-bound screening to secure cargo and supply chain functions
p: Minister may designate locations and thereby make positions sensitive, with screening valid across successive posts and periodic review every five years as the only constraint.
Minister may collect debts by enforcement order without involving the civil court, bypassing judicial enforcement.</description_en
Minister may impose administrative enforcement orders and penalty payments for violations of screening obligations.
Minister may disclose screening information on persons not in sensitive positions at the request of the Economic Affairs minister for investment screening.

parties: Asks how designation of locations is decided, whether ministers have adequate security information, how the register is protected against hacking and misuse, and whether small businesses face unfair burdens.
Who gets access to the register and how is unauthorised access prevented?
Wie krijgt er toegang tot het register en hoe wordt ongeoorloofde toegang voorkomen?

Finds the legal delimitation insufficiently clear and asks that criteria and procedures for designation decisions be written more specifically into the bill, with proportionality safeguards for clearances.
Should the creation and criteria of a designation decision not be specified more precisely in the bill?
Moeten de totstandkoming en criteria van een aanwijsbesluit niet specifieker in het wetsvoorstel worden opgenomen?
Questions why sensitive personal data from security screenings must be retained for ten years after the person no longer holds a security function, invoking privacy.
These members ask why this data must be kept so long when the person no longer holds a security function and the data are no longer relevant.
Deze leden vragen zich af waarom deze gegevens zo lang bewaard moeten worden als de persoon in kwestie geen veiligheidsfunctie meer bekleedt en de gegevens niet langer van belang zijn.

Supports the shift from criminal to administrative enforcement and the phased voluntary notification process, but questions the five-week deregistration period, the timing of implementation and who monitors employer compliance.
Do they understand correctly that after dismissal for cause, where the reason is unrelated to national security, a trusted person can remain in the register for five weeks?

Begrijpen zij het goed dat na een ontslag op staande voet, indien de reden voor ontslag niet te maken heeft met nationale veiligheid, een vertrouwensfunctionaris nog voor een periode van vijf weken in het register kan blijven staan?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet verbetering uitvoering Wet veiligheidsonderzoeken, raising concerns about extending security screening to non-security-function persons and about the privacy and security risks of a register of active trust officials, with remarks rather than outright objections. The minister's reply accepts the main points: the screening extension is limited to economic security, the delegation provision is dropped, and risks are added to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Security screening of non-security-function persons intrudes substantially on privacy and must be clearly limited and justified as necessary and proportionate; the government limited it to economic security.
The law should contain criteria the Minister of BZK applies when assessing requests for screening of non-security-function persons; the government added these to the bill text.

Necessity and proportionality of the broader scope should be better motivated, with examples beyond economic security and attention to less intrusive alternatives; the government largely addressed this by restricting scope.
The delegation basis allowing additional data in the register by ministerial regulation was questioned; the government deleted it.
The explanatory memorandum should address the risks of the register and the security measures taken; the government expanded the memorandum accordingly.

36725-X.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (first supplementary budget), adjusting expenditure and commitment appropriations across policy and non-policy articles, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2025. The explanatory memorandum attributes extra funding to contributions from the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and of the Interior for Marechaussee border and security tasks.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2025 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd

36740-III.s: This bill is a Slotwet that amends the 2024 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Office of the King, the Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten, and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie, to record final realisation figures. It makes no changes to powers, rules, or institutional arrangements beyond the budget amounts.
36740-III.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes by reporting underspending, such as the CTIVD's underspending of about 0.7 million euro due to delayed capacity expansion, rather than by any new power.
q: At the Office of the King there is very minor underspending of 73 thousand euros.
Bij het Kabinet van de Koning is sprake van een zeer geringe onderuitputting van € 73 duizend.

36748.s: The bill replaces the current forfaitaire box 3 wealth tax with a tax on actual returns from savings and investments, including new definitions, valuation rules, and a deemed-disposal/conservation regime for emigrants. It also restructures exemptions for net annuities and pensions and introduces an administrative and record-keeping obligation for box 3 assets not reported by third parties.
36748.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detailed technical rules on valuation and administration that cannot be fixed in the statute itself.
q: By general administrative measure, situations will be described of real estate that is not under construction but for other reasons is practically unsuitable for use.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur zullen situaties worden omschreven van onroerende zaken die niet in aanbouw zijn, maar die om andere redenen feitelijk niet geschikt zijn om in gebruik te nemen.
d: treating practically unusable real estate as under construction
Artikel 5.24, derde en vierde lid (Wet IB 2001)
acquisition price rules on return to the Netherlands and reducing conservatory assessments
Artikel 5.27, zesde lid, en 5.59, zevende lid (Wet IB 2001)
determining the term of usufruct and other genotsrechten
conditions for providers of net annuities and rules for net annuity application
Artikel 10.8a, tweede en derde lid (Wet IB 2001)
exclusion of assets from administration obligation and ministerial rules on record keeping
p: Introduces an administration and record-keeping duty for box 3 assets, and a partial reversal of the burden of proof once an informatiebeschikking becomes final.
Conservatory assessments on emigration and acquisition price determination are left largely to general administrative measures.

parties: Asks for the reasons behind the hybrid design, the budgetary and cost effects, and the justification for exemptions and loss-carryforward rules.

Warns that the accrual wealth tax, the property add-on and the lack of carry-back may be legally unsound under the draagkrachtbeginsel and EVRM, and that the bill creates liquidity and legal-certainty problems for family firms and NSW estates.
Can the government reflect on the NOB's view that this system may conflict with the ability-to-pay principle and the ECHR?
Kan de regering reflecteren op het oordeel van de NOB dat deze systematiek mogelijk strijdig is met het draagkrachtbeginsel en het EVRM?

Supports taxing actual returns but questions the consistency of the accrual-based rule, administrative burden, the flexibility of the system for future case law, and the treatment of owner-occupied homes.
These members ask why the government did not choose a clear and consistent system.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering niet heeft gekozen voor een heldere en consequente systematiek.
Accepts the bill as imperfect but the best option; raises legal certainty and feasibility concerns and asks whether a realisation-based system would be better.
Can the government explain what legal risks may attach to distinguishing between investors in homes subject to the capital-gains system and investors in shares subject to the annual accrual tax?

Kan de regering toelichten welke juridische risico's er mogelijk kleven aan het maken van onderscheid tussen beleggers die investeren in woningen en te maken krijgen met de vermogenswinstsystematiek en beleggers in aandelen die te maken krijgen met een jaarlijks te voldoen vermogensaanwasbelasting?
Prefers a realisation-based gains tax, sees legal and EVRM risks in accrual taxation, and asks how the NOB's technical and Union-law objections to the absence of carry-back are answered.
These members ask the government to respond to the NOB's comments on the absence of carry-back, which may not be compatible with EU law.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om in te gaan op het commentaar van de NOB inzake ontbreken van carry-back, dat zich mogelijk niet verhoudt tot het Unierecht.
Worries about complexity and feasibility for taxpayers and the Belastingdienst, and about the lack of filing obligations leaving the tax authority without records needed for later loss offsetting.
These members see the risk that at sale insufficient records will exist to determine the result needed for the capital-gains tax.
Deze leden zien het risico dat dan bij verkoop onvoldoende gegevens zijn vastgelegd om het voor de vermogenswinstbelasting benodigde resultaat vast te stellen.
Asks about distributional effects, tax avoidance opportunities, hidden wealth of the top decile, and how the Belastingdienst's information position will be strengthened.
In what specific way is work being done to map hidden wealth of the richest ten percent?
Op welke manier wordt er specifiek gewerkt om verhulde vermogens van de top tien procent meest vermogenden in kaart te brengen?
Asks for details on the forfait for own use of rental property and whether the property percentage should be adjusted to recent rent and WOZ trends.
Would it not, in the government's view, be more logical and realistic to lower the percentage, corrected for rent and WOZ developments?
Zou het wat de regering betreft niet logischer en realistischer zijn om het percentage naar beneden bij te stellen, gecorrigeerd voor de ontwikkelingen in huur en WOZ?
Raises liquidity problems for illiquid assets and NSW estates, asks whether the payment arrangement can be made broader, and questions whether fluctuating-income taxpayers are treated unequally.
Is the government willing to examine how the payment arrangement can be made broader?
Is de regering bereid om te bezien hoe de betalingsregeling ruimer vormgegeven kan worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory board advises against the proposed box 3 bill based on actual returns, citing high complexity, serious implementation burdens for the Belastingdienst, weak coherence with other boxes, and the lack of an integrated vision on taxing wealth. The government's reply (nader rapport) defends the hybrid accrual/gain system as legally necessary after the Hoge Raad rulings, accepting higher complexity while adding mitigating measures.
concerns: The Belastingdienst's negative implementation assessment and staffing risks are acknowledged, with communication and transition measures promised but the core design retained.
The Afdeling asks for an integrated vision on taxing wealth and the belastingmix before choosing a box 3 design, which the government answers only in part.
Inconsistent definitions of draagkracht and coherence between boxes 1, 2 and 3 for the same assets, leading to risk of box arbitrage.
The net property add-on was replaced by a gross add-on so actual costs are deductible, addressing proportionality and process risks.
Burdens of the administratie- en bewaarplicht and the three-year retention period for ordinary citizens, including foreign currency account calculations, are questioned.

36757.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget schedule of the Mobiliteitsfonds (A) by adding supplementary budget amounts for the ViA15 infrastructure project. It also sets the budget unit in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 July 2025 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget schedule of the Mobility Fund (A) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds (A) voor het jaar 2025

36766.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act and the Excise Act to implement EU Directive 2023/2413 on renewable energy in transport, restructuring the renewable energy transport obligation into sector-based rules (land, inland waterways, sea) based on CO2 lifecycle emission reductions and adding a refinery reduction system for renewable non-biological fuels. It extends NEa supervision and enforcement powers, introduces new registers and verification duties, and delegates detailed rules to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
36766.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set detailed technical rules and to keep the register and enforcement workable under the EU directive.
q: The Besluit energie vervoer sets out which types of supplied renewable energy lead to the crediting of an emission reduction unit, and the type that is rewarded can differ per sector.

Het Besluit energie vervoer legt vast welke soorten geleverde hernieuwbare energie tot de bijschrijving van een emissiereductie-eenheid leiden, waarbij de soort geleverde hernieuwbare energie die met de bijschrijving van een emissiereductie-eenheid beloond wordt, per sector kan verschillen.
d: rules on maritime-sector fuel supply and obligated suppliers
data entry and verification in EU databank
sector percentages, emission-unit types and usage limits for the annual obligation
calculation rule converting energy to CO2 emission reduction
rules on importers, aggregating service providers and minimum electricity volumes
exemptions from mass-balance requirement for imported liquid biofuels
greenhouse gas reduction thresholds and other requirements for synthetic fuels
CO2 reduction calculation and correction factors for emission units
requirements for verifiers and verification of biomass
rules on savings of emission units and their order
further rules on hydrogen and synthetic fuel producers
calculation and proof of synthetic fuel used in refineries
register operation, access conditions and refusal/blocking/closure of accounts
rules on saving of refinery reduction units
p: NEa may unilaterally re-determine past refinery reduction unit entries up to five years back, with no explicit procedural safeguards beyond general rules.
NEa may refuse, block or close accounts on suspicion of fraud or misuse, with details left to general administrative order.
NEa may impose fines and bar a refinery operator from registering synthetic fuel after three violations for a period it determines.
NEa may ex officio determine the amount of energy entered where entry requirements are not met, with a three-month deficit correction.
NEa gains a power to request customer ownership information from grid operators on request.

parties: Asks about the independence of the NEa given combined implementation and supervisory responsibilities, and about the ATR's view on feasibility and regulatory burden.
These members are concerned that the combination of implementing and supervisory responsibility could undermine the independent position of the NEa.
Deze leden zijn bezorgd dat de combinatie van uitvoeringsverantwoordelijkheid en toezichthoudende verantwoordelijkheid de onafhankelijke positie van NEa kan aantasten.
Raises fraud risks in CO2 chain steering and asks the government to consider putting material norms in the statute rather than delegating them to lower regulation.
These members ask the government whether it has considered including material parts of the law in the statute itself and, if so, which ones.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij heeft overwogen materiële onderdelen van de wet op te nemen in de wet en, zo ja, welke.
Supports decarbonisation but worries about administrative burden, fraud sensitivity and costs for SMEs and farmers from verification requirements.
They support decarbonisation but guard against regulatory burden, market distortion and burdens for SMEs and regions.
Zij steunen verduurzaming, maar waken voor regeldruk, marktverstoring en lasten voor mkb en regio.
Asks about preventing leakage effects in inland, coastal and sea shipping and about supporting production of renewable fuels.
These members point out that leakage effects must be prevented.
Deze leden wijzen er daarbij op dat weglekeffecten moeten worden voorkomen.
Asks about the EU framework for sector steering, the sensitivity analysis on cost prices, and a level playing field with neighbouring countries.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a draft bill implementing the transport-sector parts of RED III, asking for a clearer assessment of whether CO2 chain-emission steering is robust enough given fraud risks and the incomplete Union database. The minister's reply accepts the need for more explanation, adds motivation on the robustness of supervision and on transposition, and states changes to the bill including dropping aviation from the scheme.
concerns: The Afdeling asked whether supervision of CO2 chain-emission steering is robust enough, given fraud risks and the Union database not yet fully operational, and asked for an analysis of remaining risks and possible additional supervision.
The Afdeling asked for fuller insight into how timely and complete implementation of RED III is achieved, including non-Wet milieubeheer legislation and overdue provisions.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of the implementation of the calculation rules of Articles 27 and 31 RED III, given the statutory delegation basis in the bill.
The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum and transposition table be amended, including removing uncertain descriptions of implementation methods.

36784.s: The bill extends the temporary Innovatiewet Strafvordering provisions (Title X of the Fourth Book of the Code of Criminal Procedure) until the new Code of Criminal Procedure enters into force, and makes several changes, including removing the hulpofficier van justitie powers for scanning equipment and vorderingsbevoegdheden and extending mediation to appeal proceedings. It also removes the sunset-style pilot character of several provisions and keeps the prejudicial procedure, digital seizure powers and audiovisual recording as evidence.
36784.j: The memorandum justifies extending the powers by pointing to evaluation findings of an improved criminal procedure, the need for normative clarity, and requests from criminal justice partners.
q: That is why it is important that clear policy on this is developed.
Daarom is het belangrijk dat hierover duidelijk beleid tot stand komt.
p: Allows the hulpofficier van justitie, designated by order, to exercise certain powers that were previously reserved to the officier van justitie, such as decisions on return of seized objects.
Extends the prejudicial procedure, digital seizure powers and mediation provisions without new pilot-based powers, with the judicial role largely maintained through rechter-commissaris authorisation.

parties: Asks how the amendment on mediation adopted by parliament is protected from later changes via an amending act, and how victims are supported if suspects do not comply with mediation agreements.
Does the government share the view that, since a large majority of the House adopted that amendment, it takes precedence over any other changes via an amending act?
Deelt de regering de mening dat, aangezien een ruime meerderheid van de Kamer dat amendement heeft aangenomen, dat voorrang heeft boven andere eventuele wijzigingen via een aanvullingswet?
Doubts the feasibility of the 1 April 2029 date for the new Code of Criminal Procedure and wants to speed up experimentation with new technologies in criminal procedure.
Given the extensive legislative programme and the implementation trajectory that follows, these members no longer consider this date realistic.
Gelet op het omvangrijke wetgevingsprogramma en het implementatietraject dat daarop volgt, achten deze leden deze datum niet langer realistisch.
Questions why a statutory option to start a new pilot is needed now, since no concrete plans exist, and prefers a future targeted amendment instead.
The government bases this extension on speculation; a new pilot may be set up, but concrete plans do not yet exist.
De regering baseert deze verlenging op een speculatie; het is denkbaar dat er een nieuwe pilot wordt opgezet, maar concrete plannen zijn er (nog) niet.

Raises concerns that audiovisual recordings as standalone evidence function poorly without judicial assessment, victims' privacy is at risk, and the Rvdr finds mediation can only continue in pilot districts.
These members also see that scientific evidence is cited showing it does not work well as standalone evidence and that the judge's observation is needed for a basically sound assessment.

Ook zien deze leden dat er wetenschappelijk bewijs voor wordt aangehaald dat het niet goed functioneert als zelfstandig bewijsmiddel en dat ook de waarneming van de rechter nodig is voor in de basis een goede afweging.
No questions raised on the bill.
These members currently see no reason to ask questions about the bill.
Deze leden zien op dit moment geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen over het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Verlengingswet Innovatiewet Strafvordering, which extends experimental criminal procedure provisions until the new Code of Criminal Procedure takes effect, raising concerns about extending audiovisual recording provisions with no concrete pilot plans and about the necessity of the judge's power to order recordings of hearings, and advising reflection on lessons for future experimental legislation. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the advice by adding explanation on technological developments justifying retaining the AVR provisions, by deleting the hearing recording power (artikel 562 Sv) together with article 566 Sv, and by adding reflections on the experiment design and its timeframe.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether extending the audiovisual registration provisions from the failed pilots is necessary given no concrete new pilot plans; the government retained them, citing possible future speech-to-text pilots, and expanded the memorie van toelichting instead.

The Afdeling asked whether a statutory basis for the judge's power to order audio or video recording of hearings is needed, and advised deleting it if not shown necessary; the government deleted article 562 Sv and article 566 Sv.

The Afdeling advised reflecting in the explanatory memorandum on lessons from the Innovatiewet for future experimental legislation, including methodology, parliamentary involvement and the short evaluation period; the government added these reflections.

36793.s: The bill transfers from the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management to the Minister of Defence the power to decide on restriction areas, consent declarations, noise and safety rules and regional consultation committees for foreign military airports, and removes the Brüggen airport from the list. It also makes related technical and wording changes to title 8A.6 of the Aviation Act.
36793.j: The memorandum justifies the shift as a correction of competence allocation so that the minister responsible for military airports, consistent with chapters 8 and 10, also decides on these matters, and as a means to align rules for civil and military airports.
q: This amendment of the Aviation Act is intended to explicitly provide that the Minister of Defence, whether or not in agreement with the Minister of IenW, is competent to take the decisions referred to in title 8A.6 where these concern a foreign military airport.

Deze wijziging van de Wet luchtvaart is bedoeld om expliciet te regelen dat de Minister van Defensie, al dan niet in overeenstemming met de Minister van IenW, bevoegd is om de in titel 8A.6 bedoelde besluiten te nemen als deze een buitenlandse militaire luchthaven betreffen.
d: consent declaration deviating from restriction area decision for foreign military airports
rules on measuring and registering noise load and possibly external safety risk at foreign military airports
rules on task, composition, working method, secretariat and cost contribution of regional consultation committee
p: Authority to grant consent declarations for deviations from restriction areas of foreign military airports moves from the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, acting with the Minister of Defence, to the Minister of Defence alone.
Authority to set noise measurement rules and possible external safety rules for foreign military airports moves to the Minister of Defence, in agreement with the other minister.
Power to establish and appoint, suspend or dismiss the chair of regional consultation committees for foreign military airports moves to the Minister of Defence.

parties: Asks why the Defence Minister alone, rather than jointly with the IenW Minister, may issue noise-related and no-objection decisions, and asks for an advisory opinion from the Inspectorate and the military aviation authority.
These members ask why the government did not choose a variant in which the Minister of Defence could do this in agreement with the Minister of IenW.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering niet gekozen heeft voor een variant waarin de Minister van Defensie dit kan doen in overeenstemming met de Minister van IenW.

Asks how a lack of disclosure for military reasons is prevented from causing structural opacity toward residents, municipalities and provinces, and why residents of foreign military airports get no improvement in legal position.

These members understand the importance of military confidentiality, but ask how it is prevented that not disclosing data leads to a structural lack of transparency toward residents, municipalities and provinces.

De leden van de PVV-fractie begrijpen het belang van militaire vertrouwelijkheid, maar zij vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat het niet openbaar maken van gegevens leidt tot structureel gebrek aan transparantie richting omwonenden, gemeenten en provincies.
Has no questions or comments on the bill at this time.
The members of the GroenLinks-PvdA group have taken note of the proposal with interest and have no questions or comments on it at this time.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het voorstel en hebben hier op dit moment geen vragen of opmerkingen bij.
Has taken note of the bill and has no further questions.
The members of the CDA group have taken note of the bill and have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet luchtvaart on the division of competences for foreign airports, raising no substantive remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport reports only redactional changes to the bill and memorandum, a schema added, outdated enforcement passages removed, and a corrected cross-reference.

36847.s: The bill amends article 15a of the Nuclear Energy Act so that the Borssele nuclear plant may continue producing nuclear energy after 31 December 2033, conditional on a licence change granted by the Autoriteit Nucleaire Veiligheid en Stralingsbescherming. The article itself is to lapse by royal decree once the change is in effect.
36847.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a necessary first step for extending the plant's operating life and explains the alternative drafting variants considered.
q: In order to continue the release of nuclear energy at the Borssele nuclear power plant after 31 December 2033, the licence holder of the Borssele plant submits an application to the Authority for amending the licence.

Om het vrijmaken van kernenergie van de in 1973 in werking gebrachte kernenergiecentrale Borssele na 31 december 2033 te kunnen voortzetten, doet de vergunninghouder van de kernenergiecentrale Borssele een aanvraag bij de Autoriteit voor het wijzigen van de vergunning
d: entry into force by royal decree
p: The regulator assesses the licence change against statutory interests and the operator may continue operation once the change is granted, while the bill itself does not set out a public participation procedure.

parties: Asks how long Borssele can safely operate and what the maximum operating period is under the permit system and international safety frameworks.
For what period can the ANVS, given that the Nuclear Energy Act permit itself applies for an indefinite period, issue an amended permit?
Voor welke periode kan de ANVS – gezien het feit dat de Kernenergiewetvergunning op zichzelf voor onbepaalde tijd geldt – een gewijzigde vergunning afgeven?
Worries that removing a statutory end date weakens democratic legitimacy and control, and asks why a fixed end date per plant is not chosen and why the decision stays with the ANVS.
These members find it important that the expansion of nuclear plant operation in the Netherlands is subject to strong democratic control and legitimacy.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat de uitbreiding van exploitatie van kerncentrales in Nederland aan stevige democratische controle en legitimatie onderhevig is.
Asks whether the government could still refuse or withdraw an extension permit after an ANVS decision, and whether Eerste and Tweede Kamer will be involved in the final decision.
Asks technical and financial questions about the EPZ shareholding takeover and the Borssele covenant, without raising checks on the executive.
In this context these members ask the government whether a takeover of EPZ without buying out the other shareholder in EPZ would be conceivable.
Deze leden vragen in dit kader aan de regering of een overname van EPZ zonder uitkoop van de andere aandeelhouder in EPZ denkbaar zou zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum how the 2006 covenant on Borssele nuclear plant (shutdown by 31 December 2033, and the benchmark safety obligation) will be adapted or terminated to enable lifetime extension and what safety level applies after 2033. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum has been amended accordingly, explaining the covenant will be adapted or ended once negotiations with shareholders conclude, and the benchmark commission is being abolished as no longer adding value.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clarify how the 2006 covenant will be adapted or terminated, since it still obliges the plant's operator to shut down by 2033 regardless of the amended law.
