The explanatory memorandum should clarify the safety level the Borssele plant must meet after 2033, given the uncertainty created by the abolished benchmark obligation.

36865.s: The bill abolishes the municipality of Wijdemeren and adds its territory to Hilversum, with transitional rules for taxes, joint arrangements and utilities, and consequential amendments to the electoral law, judicial districts and the safety region act. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
36865.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by Wijdemeren's financial distress, under provincial preventive financial supervision since 1 January 2023, and the failure to produce a recovery plan.
q: From 1 January 2023 the municipality of Wijdemeren was therefore placed under preventive financial supervision by the province of North Holland.
Per 1 januari 2023 werd de gemeente Wijdemeren door de provincie Noord-Holland dan ook onder preventief financieel toezicht gesteld.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks the government to check whether the merger process was sound and to address residents' concerns about local identity and communication after the merger.
They stress that the central government must then check whether the process was carried out properly and whether the merger will ultimately serve its goal.
Zij benadrukken dat het Rijk vervolgens dient te toetsen of het proces goed is verlopen en of de fusie uiteindelijk bij zal dragen aan het doel.
Asks how resident participation was organised and whether it was sufficient, and how the identity of the villages will be preserved.
These members ask the government to explain how the involvement of Wijdemeren residents in this merger has proceeded.
Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven hoe de betrokkenheid van de inwoners van de gemeente Wijdemeren bij deze herindeling is verlopen.
Views the merger as bottom-up and broadly supported, but asks how village character and service levels can be safeguarded after the merger.
They understand the concerns of Wijdemeren residents that their village character may be affected and that services could eventually disappear.
Zij begrijpen de zorgen van inwoners uit Wijdemeren dat hun dorpse karakter mogelijk wordt aangetast en dat voorzieningen op termijn zouden kunnen verdwijnen.
Asks whether a purely administrative merger was considered and whether a democratic deficit arises since anti-merger parties won the 2022 election.
These members ask whether, in the government's view, there is a democratic deficit here.
Deze leden vragen of er naar inzicht van de regering hier sprake is van een democratisch tekort.
Criticises the absence of a local referendum, the risk of token participation, and questions whether the administrative merger should be evaluated before a formal merger.
They ask the government whether it acknowledges that this creates a risk of so-called sham participation.
Zij vragen de regering of zij erkent dat hiermee het risico bestaat op zogenoemde schijninspraak.
Opposes mergers in general, questions the basis of support, and argues residents should be able to vote in a referendum.
Questions the claimed draagvlak, the absence of a referendum, the financial incentive of the general fund, and the choice of Hilversum as the only partner.
These members have serious questions about the government's conclusion that there is sufficient public support for this merger.
De leden van de BBB-fractie hebben grote vragen bij de conclusie van de regering dat er voldoende maatschappelijk draagvlak bestaat voor deze herindeling.
Says the explanatory memorandum does not reflect the facts accurately, that the 2022 election signalled opposition, and that the process was not formally conducted by the council.
These members are not satisfied with how the merger is explained.
Deze leden zijn niet tevreden over de wijze waarop de herindeling wordt toegelicht.
Asks what the participation results were, how they were weighed, how bestuurlijke nabijheid will be ensured, and whether a referendum is needed.
However, the explanatory memorandum does not make clear what the aggregated substantive results of this participation process were.
Uit de memorie van toelichting wordt echter niet duidelijk wat de geaggregeerde inhoudelijke resultaten van dit participatieproces waren.
Argues the merger is pushed through with weak democratic legitimacy, unconvincing draagvlak, and doubtful financial and bestuurskracht assumptions.
The impression arises that an administrative solution is being forced through, while democratic legitimacy is shaky.
De indruk dringt zich op dat hier een bestuurlijke oplossing wordt doorgedrukt, terwijl de democratische legitimatie wankel is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division has no remarks on the bill redrawing the municipal boundaries of Hilversum and Wijdemeren and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The minister's letter forwards the bill and transmits the advice without any substantive reply because none was needed.

36874.s: The bill amends the Aanbestedingswet 2012 to strengthen legal protection in public procurement by requiring contracting authorities to maintain complaint desks, setting response deadlines and suspension periods, and making the Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts' advice on complaints a mandatory consideration with a comply-or-explain duty. It also adds annual public accountability on complaint handling and motivation duties for procurement decisions.
36874.j: The memorandum justifies the new complaint procedures as strengthening legal protection of businesses and avoiding the need to go to court, citing an earlier study and parliamentary motions.
q: A complaint desk is an important instrument for addressing problems that businesses experience at an early stage of the procurement process, which also helps avoid going to court.

Een klachtenloket is een belangrijk instrument om problemen die ondernemers ervaren op een vroeg moment in het aanbestedingsproces te adresseren, waarmee tevens een gang naar de rechter kan worden voorkomen.
d: Artikel I, D-H (art. 4.26a-4.27a and related provisions)
procedures and tasks of complaint desks and the Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts
p: Contracting authorities may proceed without the statutory suspension for compelling overriding public interest reasons, which they must motivate.
Transitional provision keeps prior law applicable to procurements already announced or started before entry into force.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill strengthening legal protection in public procurement (Aanbestedingswet 2012) needs further motivation on effectiveness, proportionality, necessity, feasibility and the Commission of Procurement Experts, and advised against submitting it unless adapted. The minister's reply largely disagrees with the objections on effectiveness, proportionality and feasibility, but accepts several changes such as dropping the amendment to article 4.27 and adding financial and implementation information.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the proposed measures will effectively solve the identified problems and may even have the opposite effect, asking for further motivation or dropping parts of the bill.
The Afdeling asks for motivation that the added standstill and suspension periods, lengthening procurement by at least 27 days, are proportionate.
The Afdeling finds the necessity of a statutory complaints desk and procedure insufficiently shown, given many authorities already have one and non-binding instruments have not been evaluated.
The Afdeling asks for implementation tests by representative groups of contracting authorities, especially public-law bodies, and for the complaint procedures' feasibility to be shown.
The Afdeling asks for a feasibility test by the Commission of Procurement Experts and for the financial consequences of its expanded tasks to be made clear before submission.

The Afdeling advises setting out the Commission's composition and independence in the statute and leaving operational details to a general administrative order, but the bill removes the delegation basis.
The Afdeling asks that the legal form of the Commission of Procurement Experts be stated, including ministerial responsibility, independence and incorporation requirements.

36892.s: The bill introduces a mandatory integrity risk analysis for prospective aldermen, provincial deputies, island deputies and water board executive members, carried out under the mayor/commissioner/chair's supervision, with limited disclosure of conclusions and public release of management measures. It also adds a general prohibition on financial interests and securities transactions for these officials and clarifies that courts do not review the grounds for appointment or non-appointment.
36892.j: The memorandum justifies the risk analysis as protecting administrative integrity and the new limits on judicial review as reflecting that appointment is a political decision for the council.
q: Finally, the level at which the implementation of a risk analysis is regulated has been fixed in the law, in view of the constitutional restriction system of article 10 of the Constitution.
Tot slot is op het niveau van de wet vastgelegd waarop de uitvoering van een risicoanalyse ziet, gelet op de grondrechtelijke beperkingssystematiek van artikel 10 van de Grondwet.
d: integrity risk analysis of prospective alderman, supervised by mayor
p: Artikel I, A (art. 36c, lid 8); Artikel II, A; Artikel III, A; Artikel IV, A

Integrity risk analyses are carried out by the mayor or commissioner without council involvement, and the council receives only conclusions and measures, with the candidate and third parties given a right to respond.
Artikel I, C (art. 50 Gemeentewet); Artikel II, C; Artikel IV, D
Courts are expressly barred from reviewing the grounds on which a council appoints or refuses to appoint an alderman, narrowing judicial review of appointment decisions.

parties: Asks the government to reflect on the tension between privacy and integrity and on the chilling effect on candidates, and on the mayor's role in an analysis that should be kept away from political considerations.
This does, however, mean a limitation of the right to protection of personal privacy.
Dit betekent wel een beperking van het recht op bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.

Asks how the attractiveness of public office is preserved given the extra obligations on candidates, and raises questions about who conducts the 'goede gesprek' and the consequences if third parties refuse to cooperate.
The bill imposes additional obligations on candidate administrators.
Het wetsvoorstel legt extra verplichtingen op aan kandidaat-bestuurders.

Notes the government did not adopt the Council of State's concerns about the mayor's position and asks for clear criteria and quality requirements for the analysis, as well as data protection by external bureaus.

Questions the necessity of a statutory obligation since 96 percent of responding municipalities already use the instrument, and asks how objectivity is guaranteed so the analysis is not used politically by mayors to exclude candidates.
Does the government not consider this law superfluous given this fact?
Vindt de regering deze wet gezien dit gegeven niet overbodig?

Asks who decides on and conducts the analysis, whether the mayor should be barred from performing it personally, how external bureaus' quality is ensured, and how scope and quality criteria will be set.
ask for further explanation of who decides by whom the risk analysis will be carried out and how this is recorded.
vragen om een nadere toelichting over wie bepaalt door wie de risicoanalyse uitgevoerd gaat worden en hoe dit is vastgelegd.
Asks what problem the mandatory analysis solves that existing instruments cannot, how it relates to regional initiatives, and how the mayor can act as data controller without political pressure.
which problem is solved by making this risk analysis mandatory that cannot already be addressed through existing instruments.
welk probleem met het verplicht stellen van deze risicoanalyse wordt opgelost dat niet reeds via bestaande instrumenten kan worden ondervangen.

Demands careful justification of the statutory obligation given existing voluntary practice and asks what concrete problem it solves, including whether scope could widen beyond legal norms and whether the analysis is proportionate.
These members explicitly ask the government to justify why statutory anchoring is necessary if the instrument is already widely applied in practice.
Zij vragen de regering daarom nadrukkelijk te motiveren waarom een wettelijke verankering noodzakelijk is, indien het instrument in de praktijk al breed wordt toegepast.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill introducing an integrity risk analysis for candidate aldermen and related financial-interest rules, raising concerns about who conducts the analysis, quality standards, secrecy versus the Woo and the Gemeentewet, third-party data rights, and the scope of gedragscodes. The government's nader rapport accepts several points, including separating the council from conducting the analysis, adding a rule on secrecy and clarifying the AVG basis, while rejecting binding quality standards for now.
concerns: The council should not conduct the integrity analysis itself; the bill should legally exclude this, which the government adopted.
The burgemeester should be separated from carrying out the analysis versus supervising it; the government kept the option open and only sharpened the explanatory memorandum.
Statutory quality requirements for the execution of and executors of the integrity analysis should be set; the government declined for now pending separate study.
The relationship between the new secrecy rule and the existing Gemeentewet secrecy regime, and the openness of deliberations, needed clarification; the government clarified in the memorandum.
The rights of third parties whose personal data are processed were unclear under the AVG right to object; the government amended the grounds for processing and the explanatory note.
The relationship between gedragscodes and verordeningen and the limited scope of the analysis needed clarification; the bill was changed to allow such norms if expressly designated.

36928.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wft to implement EU Directive 2024/790 revising MiFID II, covering trading venues, transparency, order execution reporting, commodity and emission-allowance derivatives position controls, and AFM powers to suspend trading in emergencies. It largely changes reporting duties and gives the AFM a new power to take appropriate measures to restore orderly markets when a trading venue fails to halt trading.
36928.j: The memorandum justifies the new AFM powers as necessary to implement the directive and to restore orderly markets, with the AFM's existing enforcement tools reused.
q: The AFM is granted the power to take appropriate measures to restore the orderly functioning of markets.
Aan de AFM wordt de bevoegdheid verleend om passende maatregelen te nemen om de ordelijke werking van de markten te herstellen
d: information to non-professional investors on order execution policy
p: Extends position-control and reporting obligations to emission-allowance derivatives and changes weekly reporting to ESMA, largely technical alignment with EU rules.
Gives the AFM power to take appropriate measures, using existing enforcement instruments, to restore orderly markets when a market operator does not suspend trading during an emergency."

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum to the bill implementing MiFID II revision (Richtlijn 2024/790) insufficiently explains the consequences of the missed transposition deadline and of not yet implementing the amended MiFIR. The Minister's reply adds a new section on the consequences of the late transposition, notes that the consequences are limited, and makes several technical amendments to the bill.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should explain in more depth the consequences of exceeding the implementation deadline for the directive, including for market operators' emergency halt powers and emissions-derivatives position controls.
The explanatory memorandum should address the consequences of not yet implementing the amended MiFIR, including possible enforcement gaps for infringements.
Technical drafting corrections were made, including a new paragraph 7 in the memorandum, a new second paragraph in article 4:91ea Wft, and a corrected cross-reference in article 5:89f.

36937.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to make electronic applications for driving licences (renewal and replacement, and first applications with a digitally captured photo at the municipal counter) a permanent nationwide option, ending the experiment and tolerance phase. It assigns the RDW new tasks on photo control and fotograaf recognition, sets fees, and allows detailed rules to be set by AMvB and ministerial regulation.
36937.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new photo-control powers by the successful experiment, fraud resistance, identity protection, and the need to set detailed technical procedures in lower regulation.
q: For these reasons the activities of the photographers are not regarded as participation in public service or the exercise of public authority.
Om deze redenen worden de activiteiten van de fotografen niet beschouwd als deelname aan de betrekkingen in overheidsdienst dan wel uitoefening van openbaar gezag.
d: authentication rules for electronic licence applications
licence fee for electronic applications routed via municipality
rules on fee compensation between RDW and municipalities
p: Gives the RDW a new task of performing and recording photo control, including 1:N comparison of a applicant's photo against all photos in the licence register, a biometric check that the memorandum justifies by fraud prevention and proportionality.
Authentication of electronic applicants is left to rules set by AMvB, and photographer recognition is extended under a broadened delegation basis.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill making permanent the digital application of driving licences, raising concerns about an overly broad delegation basis and EU free-establishment implications of the photographer recognition scheme. The government's reply adopted the narrowing of the delegation clause and added a justification in the explanatory memorandum, plus transitional rules for existing photographers.
concerns: The delegation basis in the proposed article 121(3) Wvw 1994 was too broad and had to be narrowed to specific provisions in the first and second paragraphs.
The photographer recognition scheme restricts EU free establishment, so the explanatory memorandum needed a justification in the general interest, which was added.

36945-IIB.s: This Slotwet amends the 2025 budget of the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council by adopting supplementary and final budget figures, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date and retroactive application to the budget year and asks ministries to implement it.
q: The departmental budget statement of the other High Colleges of State, Governors' Cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) for the year 2025 is amended.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad (IIB) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd
